+# --- Lean source helpers (unit-tested in scripts/test_tidy_sweep.py) ----------------------------
+
+OPENERS, CLOSERS = "([{⦃⟨‹", ")]}⦄⟩›"
+IDENT = re.compile(qr.IDENT.pattern)
+KEYWORDS = {"by", "fun", "λ", "with", "at", "using", "from", "then", "else", "do", "in", "if",
+            "match", "show", "have", "let", "calc", "only", "generalizing", "says", "where",
+            "deriving", "termination_by", "decreasing_by", "obtain", "rcases", "refine", "exact"}
+COMMAND_KEYWORD = re.compile(r"#?[A-Za-z_]+")
+NAME_ONLY_COMMANDS = {"#print", "#check", "#guard_msgs", "attribute", "open", "export", "#eval",
+                      "#reduce", "#synth", "add_decl_doc", "#lint", "#help"}
+LEMMA_LIST_TACTIC = re.compile(
+    r"\b(?:simp|simp_all|dsimp|simp_rw|rw|rwa|rewrite|erw|nth_rewrite|nth_rw|simpa|fun_prop|"
+    r"aesop|norm_num|field_simp|grind|polytime|positivity|unfold|delta|gcongr|subst_vars|"
+    r"continuity|measurability|bound|decide|omega|linarith|nlinarith|exact\?|apply\?|"
+    r"rw_mod_cast|push_cast|norm_cast|simp_arith|conv)\b[^\[\]\n]*$")
+
+
+def match_bracket(mask: str, i: int, limit: int | None = None) -> int:
+    """The index of the bracket closing the one at `mask[i]`, or -1."""
+    depth, end = 0, len(mask) if limit is None else limit
+    for j in range(i, end):
+        char = mask[j]
+        if char in OPENERS:
+            depth += 1
+        elif char in CLOSERS:
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                return j
+    return -1
+
+
+def find_top_level(mask: str, start: int, end: int, token: str) -> int:
+    """The first `token` at bracket depth 0 in `mask[start:end]`, or -1. `:` excludes `:=`."""
+    depth = 0
+    for j in range(start, end):
+        char = mask[j]
+        if char in OPENERS:
+            depth += 1
+        elif char in CLOSERS:
+            depth -= 1
+        elif depth == 0 and mask.startswith(token, j):
+            if token == ":" and (mask.startswith(":=", j) or mask.startswith("::", j)
+                                 or (j and mask[j - 1] == ":")):
+                continue
+            return j
+    return -1
+
+
+def line_indent(text: str, offset: int) -> int:
+    start = text.rfind("\n", 0, offset) + 1
+    return len(text[start:]) - len(text[start:].lstrip(" "))
+
+
+def column(text: str, offset: int) -> int:
+    return offset - (text.rfind("\n", 0, offset) + 1)
+
+
+def atom_end(mask: str, i: int, limit: int) -> int:
+    """The end of the atom (identifier, number, `?_`, bracket group, `.ident`) at `i` together
+    with directly attached projections (`.field`, `.1`), or `i` when no atom starts there."""
+    if i >= limit:
+        return i
+    char = mask[i]
+    if char in OPENERS:
+        end = match_bracket(mask, i, limit)
+        if end < 0:
+            return i
+        j = end + 1
+    elif char == "." and i + 1 < limit and IDENT.match(mask, i + 1):
+        j = IDENT.match(mask, i + 1).end()
+    elif char == "?" and mask.startswith("?_", i):
+        j = i + 2
+    elif char == "@" and i + 1 < limit and IDENT.match(mask, i + 1):
+        j = IDENT.match(mask, i + 1).end()
+    elif char.isdigit():
+        j = i
+        while j < limit and (mask[j].isalnum() or mask[j] == "."):
+            j += 1
+    else:
+        match = IDENT.match(mask, i)
+        if not match or match[0].rstrip(".") in KEYWORDS:
+            return i
+        j = match.end()
+    while j < limit and mask[j] == "." and j + 1 < limit and (
+            mask[j + 1].isdigit() or IDENT.match(mask, j + 1)):
+        j = IDENT.match(mask, j + 1).end() if IDENT.match(mask, j + 1) else j + 2
+    return min(j, limit)
+
+
+NAMED_ARG = re.compile(r"\(\s*[^\W\d][\w'₀-₉]*\s*:=")
+
+
+def parse_args(mask: str, pos: int, limit: int, count: int, base_indent: int,
+               named: list[tuple[int, int]] | None = None) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
+    """Up to `count` positional application arguments after `pos`: atoms separated by blanks,
+    continuing onto lines indented more than `base_indent`. Named arguments `(x := e)` are
+    skipped and, when `named` is given, appended to it."""
+    args = []
+    i = pos
+    while len(args) < count and i < limit:
+        j = i
+        while j < limit and mask[j] in " \t":
+            j += 1
+        if j < limit and mask[j] == "\n":
+            k = j
+            while k < limit and mask[k] in " \t\n":
+                k += 1
+            if k >= limit or line_indent(mask, k) <= base_indent:
+                break
+            j = k
+        if j == i and args:
+            break  # no blank after the previous argument
+        end = atom_end(mask, j, limit)
+        if end == j:
+            break
+        if NAMED_ARG.match(mask, j):
+            if named is not None:
+                named.append((j, end))
+        else:
+            args.append((j, end))
+        i = end
+    return args
+
+
+def strip_space(mask: str, start: int, end: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    while start < end and mask[start].isspace():
+        start += 1
+    while end > start and mask[end - 1].isspace():
+        end -= 1
+    return start, end
+
+
+def is_atomic_application(mask: str, start: int, end: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    """For text `P args` in `mask[start:end]` made of atoms only, the span of `P`; else None."""
+    start, end = strip_space(mask, start, end)
+    head = atom_end(mask, start, end)
+    if head == start:
+        return None
+    args = parse_args(mask, head, end, 10 ** 6, -1)
+    last = args[-1][1] if args else head
+    return (start, head) if strip_space(mask, last, end)[0] == end else None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Binder:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    bracket: str
+    names: list[str]
+    type_start: int
+    type_end: int
+    default: bool
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DeclText:
+    start: int
+    sel_start: int
+    sel_end: int
+    end: int
+    binders: list[Binder]
+    colon: int  # the `:` before the type, or -1
+    assign: int  # the `:=` before the body, or -1
+    problems: list[str]
+
+
+def parse_decl(mask: str, start: int, sel_start: int, sel_end: int, end: int) -> DeclText:
+    """Binders, type and body of the declaration whose name ends at `sel_end`."""
+    assign = find_top_level(mask, sel_end, end, ":=")
+    stop = assign if assign >= 0 else end
+    binders, problems, colon = [], [], -1
+    i = sel_end
+    if mask.startswith(".{", i):
+        i = match_bracket(mask, i + 1, stop) + 1
+    while i < stop:
+        char = mask[i]
+        if char.isspace():
+            i += 1
+        elif char in "([{⦃":
+            close = match_bracket(mask, i, stop)
+            if close < 0:
+                problems.append("unbalanced binder")
+                break
+            inner = find_top_level(mask, i + 1, close, ":")
+            default = find_top_level(mask, i + 1, close, ":=")
+            if inner < 0:
+                names, type_start = mask[i + 1:close].split(), close
+            else:
+                names, type_start = mask[i + 1:inner].split(), inner + 1
+            type_end = default if default >= 0 else close
+            binders.append(Binder(i, close + 1, char, names, type_start, type_end,
+                                  default >= 0))
+            i = close + 1
+        elif char == ":":
+            colon = i
+            break
+        else:
+            problems.append("binder without brackets")
+            break
+    if assign < 0:
+        problems.append("no `:=` (pattern-matching definition)")
+    return DeclText(start, sel_start, sel_end, end, binders, colon, assign, problems)
+
+
+def proof_parts(text: str, assign: int, end: int) -> tuple[str, bool]:
+    """The text after `:=` and whether it is a tactic block."""
+    body = text[assign + 2:end]
+    return body, re.match(r"\s*by(?:\s|$)", body) is not None
+
+
+def collapse(text: str) -> str:
+    return " ".join(text.split())
+
+
+# --- Scopes and names ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+SCOPE_COMMAND = re.compile(
+    r"^(?P<mods>(?:@\[[^\]\n]*\]\s*)?(?:(?:public|private|noncomputable|protected|meta)\s+)*)"
+    r"(?P<kw>namespace|section|end|open|mutual)\b(?P<rest>[^\n]*)", re.M)
+
+
+def namespaces_of(names) -> set[str]:
+    """Every name and every proper prefix of a name, as namespaces."""
+    out = set()
+    for name in names:
+        parts = name.split(".")
+        for i in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
+            out.add(".".join(parts[:i]))
+    return out
+
+
+class Scopes:
+    """The current namespace and opened namespaces at each offset of a masked source."""
+
+    def __init__(self, mask: str, namespaces: set[str]):
+        self.points: list[tuple[int, str, tuple[str, ...]]] = [(0, "", ())]
+        self.once: list[tuple[int, int, tuple[str, ...]]] = []
+        stack: list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]] = []
+        starts = [m.start() for m in qr.COMMAND_START.finditer(mask)] + [len(mask)]
+        for match in SCOPE_COMMAND.finditer(mask):
+            kw, rest = match["kw"], match["rest"].split()
+            namespace = ".".join(n for k, n, _ in stack if k == "namespace" and n)
+            opens = [o for _, _, os in stack for o in os]
+            if kw == "namespace" and rest:
+                stack.append(("namespace", rest[0], []))
+            elif kw in ("section", "mutual"):
+                stack.append((kw, rest[0] if rest and kw == "section" else "", []))
+            elif kw == "end":
+                if stack:
+                    stack.pop()
+            elif kw == "open":
+                one_shot = bool(rest) and rest[-1] == "in"
+                words = [w for w in (rest[:-1] if one_shot else rest)
+                         if w not in ("scoped", "hiding", "renaming", "→", "private")
+                         and not w.startswith("(") and IDENT.fullmatch(w)]
+                resolved = []
+                for word in words:
+                    prefixes = [".".join(namespace.split(".")[:i])
+                                for i in range(len(namespace.split(".")), -1, -1)] if namespace \
+                        else [""]
+                    found = [p + "." + word if p else word for p in prefixes + opens + resolved
+                             if (p + "." + word if p else word) in namespaces]
+                    resolved += found or [word]
+                if one_shot:
+                    after = next((s for s in starts if s > match.end()), len(mask))
+                    following = next((s for s in starts if s > after), len(mask))
+                    self.once.append((match.start(), following, tuple(resolved)))
+                    continue
+                if not stack:
+                    stack.append(("file", "", []))
+                stack[-1][2].extend(resolved)
+            namespace = ".".join(n for k, n, _ in stack if k == "namespace" and n)
+            opens = [o for _, _, os in stack for o in os]
+            self.points.append((match.end(), namespace, tuple(opens)))
+
+    def at(self, offset: int) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
+        namespace, opens = "", ()
+        for point, ns, os in self.points:
+            if point > offset:
+                break
+            namespace, opens = ns, os
+        extra = tuple(o for start, end, os in self.once if start <= offset < end for o in os)
+        return namespace, opens + extra
+
+    def prefixes(self, offset: int) -> list[str]:
+        """Namespaces a written name may be relative to, innermost first (`""` is the root)."""
+        namespace, opens = self.at(offset)
+        parts = namespace.split(".") if namespace else []
+        return [".".join(parts[:i]) for i in range(len(parts), -1, -1)] + list(opens)
+
+
+def written_name(target: str, prefixes: list[str], known: set[str]) -> str:
+    """The shortest suffix of `target` that resolves to it, and to nothing else, from a position
+    whose namespace prefixes and opened namespaces are `prefixes`."""
+    parts = target.split(".")
+    for k in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
+        suffix = ".".join(parts[-k:])
+        hits = {p + "." + suffix if p else suffix for p in prefixes}
+        resolved = {h for h in hits if h in known or h == target}
+        if resolved == {target}:
+            return suffix
+    return target
+
+
+def renamed_token(token: str, old: str, new: str) -> str | None:
+    """`token` (a written form of `old`) with the renamed part, when the written prefix still
+    resolves the same way (`old = P.token` and `new = P.result`); otherwise None."""
+    at = "@" if token.startswith("@") else ""
+    bare = token[len(at):]
+    root = "_root_." if bare.startswith("_root_.") else ""
+    bare = bare[len(root):]
+    if not (old == bare or old.endswith("." + bare)):
+        return None
+    prefix = old[:len(old) - len(bare)]
+    if not new.startswith(prefix):
+        return None
+    result = new[len(prefix):]
+    if not result or (prefix and result.startswith(".")):
+        return None
+    return at + root + result
+

+# --- Edits --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@dataclass
+class Replace:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    text: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Wrap:
+    """Text inserted before `open` and after `close`; `site` orders wraps with equal spans (the
+    wrap of the site that starts first is outermost)."""
+    open: int
+    close: int
+    before: str
+    after: str
+    site: int
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Region:
+    """A span whose edited text is then transformed by `build`."""
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    build: object
+    decl: str
+
+
+def render(text: str, replaces: list[Replace], wraps: list[Wrap], lo: int, hi: int) -> str:
+    """`text[lo:hi]` with the replacements and wraps inside it applied. At one position, wraps
+    close (innermost first) before others open (outermost first), then a replacement starts."""
+    reps = sorted((r for r in replaces if lo <= r.start and r.end <= hi),
+                  key=lambda r: (r.start, r.end))
+    ws = [w for w in wraps if lo <= w.open and w.close <= hi]
+    points = sorted({r.start for r in reps} | {w.open for w in ws} | {w.close for w in ws})
+    starting = defaultdict(list)
+    for r in reps:
+        starting[r.start].append(r)
+    out, cur = [], lo
+    for p in points:
+        if p < cur:
+            continue  # inside a replaced span
+        out.append(text[cur:p])
+        out += [w.after for w in sorted((w for w in ws if w.close == p),
+                                        key=lambda w: (-w.open, -w.site))]
+        out += [w.before for w in sorted((w for w in ws if w.open == p),
+                                         key=lambda w: (-w.close, w.site))]
+        cur = p
+        for r in starting.get(p, []):
+            out.append(r.text)
+            cur = max(cur, r.end)
+    out.append(text[cur:hi])
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+def apply_edits(text: str, replaces: list[Replace], wraps: list[Wrap],
+                regions: list[Region]) -> str:
+    out, cur = [], 0
+    for region in sorted(regions, key=lambda r: r.start):
+        out.append(render(text, replaces, wraps, cur, region.start))
+        out.append(region.build(render(text, replaces, wraps, region.start, region.end)))
+        cur = region.end
+    out.append(render(text, replaces, wraps, cur, len(text)))
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+# --- Round trips --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+OF_TIDY = re.compile(r"(?<![\w.'])(?:(?:[\w.']*\.)?Computable(?:In(?:PolyTime|PolySpace|Space|O|"
+                     r"FPTTime))\.|\.)of_tidy\b")
+DOT_ROUND_TRIP = re.compile(r"\.tidy\.computableIn(?:PolyTime|PolySpace|Space|O|FPTTime)\b")
+
+
+def cancel_round_trips(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
+    """Remove `of_tidy (x.tidy)`, `of_tidy <| x.tidy` and `x.tidy.computableIn…` round trips,
+    where `x` is an atom. Returns the new text and the number of removals."""
+    count = 0
+    while True:
+        mask = masks(text)[1]
+        change = None
+        for match in DOT_ROUND_TRIP.finditer(mask):
+            change = (match.start(), match.end(), "")
+            break
+        if change is None:
+            for match in OF_TIDY.finditer(mask):
+                i = match.end()
+                while i < len(mask) and mask[i] in " \t":
+                    i += 1
+                pipe = mask.startswith("<|", i)
+                if pipe:
+                    i += 2
+                    while i < len(mask) and mask[i] in " \t":
+                        i += 1
+                end = atom_end(mask, i, len(mask))
+                if end == i:
+                    continue
+                inner = (i, end)
+                if mask[i] == "(" and match_bracket(mask, i) == end - 1:
+                    inner = strip_space(mask, i + 1, end - 1)
+                start, stop = inner
+                if not mask[start:stop].endswith(".tidy") or atom_end(mask, start, stop) != stop:
+                    continue
+                core_end = stop - len(".tidy")
+                if atom_end(mask, start, core_end) != core_end:
+                    continue
+                if pipe:
+                    after = end
+                    while after < len(mask) and mask[after] in " \t":
+                        after += 1
+                    if after < len(mask) and mask[after] not in CLOSERS + "\n,":
+                        continue
+                change = (match.start(), end, text[start:core_end])
+                break
+        if change is None:
+            return text, count
+        start, end, new = change
+        new_mask = masks(new)[1]
+        if (start > 0 and text[start - 1] == "(" and end < len(text) and text[end] == ")"
+                and atom_end(new_mask, 0, len(new)) == len(new) and not new.startswith("@")):
+            start, end = start - 1, end + 1
+        text = text[:start] + new + text[end:]
+        count += 1
+
+
+# --- Wrapping -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@dataclass
+class Hyp:
+    names: list[str]
+    old_type: str  # one line
+    simple: bool
+
+
+def reindent(lines: list[str], delta: int) -> list[str] | None:
+    """Shift lines by `delta` columns; None when that would remove non-blank text."""
+    out = []
+    for line in lines:
+        if not line.strip():
+            out.append("")
+        elif delta >= 0:
+            out.append(" " * delta + line)
+        elif len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" ")) >= -delta:
+            out.append(line[-delta:])
+        else:
+            return None
+    return out
+
+
+def wrap_proof(body: str, body_column: int, decl_indent: int, hyps: list[Hyp],
+               conclusion: str | None, simple_conclusion: bool, iffs: str) -> str | None:
+    """The new text after `:=` for a proof `body` of the old (tidy) statement, now stated plainly:
+    tidy hypotheses are recovered, and the old conclusion converted. `body_column` is the column
+    of the first character of `body`. None when the layout cannot be preserved."""
+    stripped = body.lstrip()
+    lead = body[:len(body) - len(stripped)]
+    first_col = body_column + len(lead) if "\n" not in lead else len(lead.rsplit("\n", 1)[1])
+    stripped = stripped.rstrip()
+    tactic = re.match(r"by(?=\s|$)", stripped) is not None
+    if not hyps and simple_conclusion and not tactic:
+        return f"{lead}.of_tidy ({stripped})"
+    k = decl_indent + 2
+    rebind = []
+    for hyp in hyps:
+        for name in hyp.names:
+            rebind.append(f"have {name} := {name}.tidy" if hyp.simple else
+                          f"have {name} : {hyp.old_type} := by simpa only [{iffs}] using {name}")
+    if tactic:
+        rest = stripped[2:]
+        if rest.lstrip(" \t").startswith("\n") or not rest.strip():
+            lines = rest.lstrip(" \t")[1:].split("\n")
+            nonblank = [ln for ln in lines if ln.strip()]
+            if not nonblank:
+                return None
+            k = min(len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip(" ")) for ln in nonblank)
+        else:
+            first_line, _, tail = rest.lstrip(" \t").partition("\n")
+            tactic_col = first_col + 2 + (len(rest) - len(rest.lstrip(" \t")))
+            shifted = reindent(tail.split("\n"), k - tactic_col) if tail else []
+            if shifted is None:
+                return None
+            lines = [" " * k + first_line] + shifted
+        pad = " " * k
+        out = [pad + line for line in rebind]
+        if conclusion is None:
+            out += lines
+        elif simple_conclusion:
+            out += [pad + "refine .of_tidy ?_"] + lines
+        else:
+            inner = reindent(lines, 2)
+            out += [pad + f"have this : {conclusion} := by"] + inner + \
+                [pad + f"simpa only [{iffs}] using this"]
+        return " by\n" + "\n".join(out)
+    first, _, tail = stripped.partition("\n")
+    tail_lines = tail.split("\n") if tail else []
+    nonblank = [ln for ln in tail_lines if ln.strip()]
+    shift = 0
+    if nonblank:
+        least = min(len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip(" ")) for ln in nonblank)
+        shift = max(0, k + 2 - least)
+    tail_lines = reindent(tail_lines, shift) or tail_lines
+    pad = " " * k
+    out = [pad + line for line in rebind]
+    term = "\n".join([first] + tail_lines)
+    if conclusion is None:
+        out.append(pad + "exact " + term)
+    elif simple_conclusion:
+        out.append(pad + "exact .of_tidy (" + term + ")")
+    else:
+        out += [pad + f"have this : {conclusion} :=", pad + "  " + term,
+                pad + f"simpa only [{iffs}] using this"]
+    return " by\n" + "\n".join(out)
+
+
+# --- Planning -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@dataclass
+class Manual:
+    path: str
+    line: int
+    decl: str
+    kind: str
+    detail: str = ""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Ref:
+    name: str
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    decl: str | None
+
+
+class SourceFile:
+    def __init__(self, path: Path, namespaces: set[str]):
+        self.path = path
+        self.text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        self.code, self.mask = masks(self.text) if path.suffix == ".lean" else (self.text,) * 2
+        self.lines = self.text.split("\n")
+        self.starts = [0]
+        for line in self.lines:
+            self.starts.append(self.starts[-1] + len(line) + 1)
+        self.commands = [m.start() for m in qr.COMMAND_START.finditer(self.mask)]
+        self._namespaces = namespaces
+        self._scopes: Scopes | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def scopes(self) -> Scopes:
+        if self._scopes is None:
+            self._scopes = Scopes(self.mask, self._namespaces)
+        return self._scopes
+
+    def at(self, line: int, column16: int) -> int:
+        """The offset of a 0-based line and UTF-16 column (`.ilean` positions)."""
+        return self.starts[line] + qr.utf16_index(self.lines[line], column16)
+
+    def at_range(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
+        """The offset of a 1-based line and code-point column (declaration ranges)."""
+        return self.starts[line - 1] + column
+
+    def line_of(self, offset: int) -> int:
+        """The 1-based line of an offset."""
+        return self.text.count("\n", 0, offset) + 1
+
+    def command_keyword(self, offset: int) -> str:
+        starts = [s for s in self.commands if s <= offset]
+        if not starts:
+            return ""
+        match = COMMAND_KEYWORD.match(self.mask, starts[-1])
+        return match[0] if match else ""
+
+    def comment_spans(self) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
+        if self.path.suffix != ".lean":
+            return [(0, len(self.text))]
+        spans, i = [], 0
+        while i < len(self.text):
+            if self.code[i] != self.text[i]:
+                j = i
+                while j < len(self.text) and self.code[j] != self.text[j] or (
+                        j < len(self.text) and self.text[j] == "\n" and j + 1 < len(self.text)
+                        and self.code[j + 1] != self.text[j + 1]):
+                    j += 1
+                spans.append((i, j))
+                i = j
+            else:
+                i += 1
+        return spans
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FileEdits:
+    replaces: list[Replace] = field(default_factory=list)
+    wraps: list[Wrap] = field(default_factory=list)
+    regions: list[Region] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class Planner:
+    """The edits of one area's batch: case 2 declarations restated and renamed, the references
+    to them converted, and case 1 twins used in proofs that become plain.
+
+    No edit is made at a span whose text does not spell the referenced constant, and a
+    replacement is written only when it resolves to its intended target, and nothing else, from
+    its position. A declaration with a reference that cannot be converted completely is deferred
+    (left tidy), so that skipped references stay unchanged."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model: Model, entries: list[Entry], twins: dict[str, str], area: str,
+                 force_wrap: frozenset[str] = frozenset()):
+        self.model, self.area, self.force_wrap = model, area, force_wrap
+        self.entries = {e.name: e for e in entries}
+        self.batch = {e.name: e for e in entries if e.area == area and e.case == "2"}
+        self.twins = {o: p for o, p in twins.items() if p in model.constants}
+        self.privates = private_by_module(model.constants)
+        self.known = model.known | {e.target for e in self.batch.values()}
+        self.namespaces = namespaces_of(self.known)
+        self.sources: dict[Path, SourceFile] = {}
+        self.deferred: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+        self._refs: dict[str, list[Ref]] = {}
+        self._locals: dict[tuple[str, int, int], set[str]] = {}
+        self.reset()
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        """Forget the edits of a planning pass."""
+        self.renames = {n: e.target for n, e in self.batch.items() if n not in self.deferred}
+        self.files: dict[Path, FileEdits] = defaultdict(FileEdits)
+        self.manual: list[Manual] = []
+        self.decls: dict[str, dict] = {}
+        self.spans: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int, str]]] = defaultdict(list)
+        self.needs: dict[str, dict[str, bool]] = defaultdict(dict)
+        self.sites: Counter = Counter()
+        self.twin_refs: Counter = Counter()
+        self.imports: list[tuple[str, str, bool]] = []
+        self.blockers: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
+        self.round_trips = 0
+
+    # Sources and references.
+
+    def source(self, path: Path) -> SourceFile:
+        if path not in self.sources:
+            self.sources[path] = SourceFile(path, self.namespaces)
+        return self.sources[path]
+
+    def refs(self, module: str) -> list[Ref]:
+        if module not in self._refs:
+            src = self.source(qr.source_path(module))
+            out = []
+            for name, _, info in self.model.lib.references(module):
+                for u in info["usages"]:
+                    out.append(Ref(name, src.at(u[0], u[1]), src.at(u[2], u[3]),
+                                   u[4] if len(u) == 5 else None))
+            self._refs[module] = sorted(out, key=lambda x: x.start)
+        return self._refs[module]
+
+    def ref_kind(self, name: str) -> str:
+        owner = qr.owner_of(name, self.model.owners) or name
+        if name in BY_TIDY:
+            return "pred"
+        if owner in self.renames:
+            return "renamed"
+        if name in self.twins:
+            return "twin"
+        if name in BRIDGES:
+            return "bridge"
+        const = self.model.constants.get(name, {})
+        if const.get("tidy") or const.get("tb") or is_tidy_constant(name):
+            return "tidy"
+        return "plain"
+
+    def new_name(self, name: str) -> str:
+        if name in BY_TIDY:
+            return BY_TIDY[name].plain
+        owner = qr.owner_of(name, self.model.owners) or name
+        if owner in self.renames and (name == owner or name.startswith(owner + ".")):
+            return self.renames[owner] + name[len(owner):]
+        return self.twins.get(name, name)
+
+    def note(self, path: Path, offset: int, decl: str | None, kind: str, detail: str = ""):
+        src = self.source(path)
+        self.manual.append(Manual(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), src.line_of(offset), decl or "",
+                                  kind, detail))
+
+    def where(self, path: Path, offset: int) -> str:
+        return f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}:{self.source(path).line_of(offset)}"
+
+    def need(self, module: str, constant: str, public: bool) -> None:
+        defining = self.model.constants.get(constant, {}).get("m")
+        if defining and defining != module:
+            self.needs[module][defining] = self.needs[module].get(defining, False) or public
+
+    def notions_of(self, name: str) -> list[Notion]:
+        const = self.model.constants.get(name, {})
+        return [BY_TIDY[t] for t in const.get("tidy", []) if t in BY_TIDY]
+
+    # Names.
+
+    def local_names(self, module: str, src: SourceFile, offset: int) -> set[str]:

That issue requests `BH encBits (k+1) = BH encBits k` (or `coBH encBits k ⊆ BH encBits k`) as the collapse premise. Here, and in the full consecutive-level/DP wrappers, the premise instead quantifies over every type and every injective encoding. The fixed-level theorem additionally asks for the paired encoding; Tests/Kadin:61,66,71 repeat paired/universal assumptions rather than checking the canonical-only client. Existing Decoder and BH reduction-closure APIs transport canonical collapse to decodable encodings, including paired bit strings, but do not by themselves supply a Decoder or the required collapse premise for arbitrary encodings in this quantifier or PH/Collapse:212. Please provide a checked public corollary/client whose only collapse hypothesis is the encBits one (including general k), or make this an explicitly scoped milestone and retain #683's canonical endpoint as unfinished in the PR/ROADMAP instead of Closes #683. +public import Complexity.Computability.Complexity.Problems.SATUNSAT
+import Complexity.Computability.Complexity.Classes.NP.Witness

+/-!
+# Kadin's Theorem
+
+If the Boolean hierarchy over `NP` collapses at any finite level `k` (`coBH k ⊆ BH k`, or
+equivalently `BH (k + 1) = BH k`), then the polynomial hierarchy collapses to its third level
+`Σ₃ᴾ ∩ Π₃ᴾ` (`PH = Σ₃ᴾ`) [Kadin][Kadin1988]. In particular, if `DP = coDP` (or `SATUNSAT ∈ coDP`),
+then `PH = Σ₃ᴾ`.
+
+## Proof overview
+
+To place a language `A ∈ Π₃ᴾ` in `Σ₃ᴾ`, peel off its first two quantifier blocks of lengths `p₁`
+and `p₂`; the negated inner quantifier defines a language `E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)` such that
+`a ∈ A ↔ ∀ u₁ (|u₁| = p₁(n)), ∃ u₂ (|u₂| = p₂(n)), (a, u₁ ++ u₂) ∉ E`, where every queried word
+`u₁ ++ u₂` has fixed length `m(n) = (p₁ + p₂)(n)`.
+
+For each `r ≤ k`, an `r`-tuple of words of length `m(n)` is represented as a single concatenated
+bit string `s` of length `r * m(n)` paired with `a` under `encPair enc encBits`. The canonical
+alternating languages `kadinChain enc m E r ∈ BH (encPair enc encBits) r` satisfy
+`(a, s ++ y) ∈ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) ↔ (a, y) ∈ E ∧ (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r` whenever
+`|s| = r * m(n)`. Assuming `coBH (encPair enc encBits) k ⊆ BH (encPair enc encBits) k`, the
+complement `(kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ` lies in `BH (encPair enc encBits) k`. Stepping down the nested
+difference representation of `(kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ` from `r = k` to `r = 0` yields at each level
+either a hard prefix `s` of length `r * m(n)` that reduces `(a, y) ∉ E` on words of length `m(n)`
+to an existential check over `NP`, or completeness for the next level down. Taking the union of
+these `k` hard-prefix branches places `A` in `Σ₃ᴾ`.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.kadinChain`: the canonical `BH r` language on concatenated `r`-tuples of fixed
+  polynomial word length.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.allWordsIn`: the `NP` language checking that `d` concatenated words of fixed
+  polynomial length all belong to a given language.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.PiP_three_subset_SigmaP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH`:
+  `coBH (encPair enc encBits) k ⊆ BH (encPair enc encBits) k → PiP 3 enc ⊆ SigmaP 3 enc`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SigmaP_three_eq_PiP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH`:
+  `coBH (encPair enc encBits) k ⊆ BH (encPair enc encBits) k → SigmaP 3 enc = PiP 3 enc`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH`: Kadin's theorem for `coBH k ⊆ BH k`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_BH_succ_eq`: Kadin's theorem for `BH (k + 1) = BH k`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_DP_eq_coDP`: Kadin's theorem for `DP = coDP`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.DPComplete.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_mem_coDP` and
+  `Cslib.Complexity.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_SATUNSAT_mem_coDP`: collapse from a single `DP`-complete
+  language in `coDP`.
+
+## References
+
+* [J. Kadin, *The Polynomial Time Hierarchy Collapses if the Boolean Hierarchy
+  Collapses*][Kadin1988]
+* [J.-Y. Cai et al., *The Boolean Hierarchy I: Structural Properties*][CaiEtAl1988]
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Complexity
+
+open Turing.MultiTapeTM ComputableTidilyInPolyTime Polynomial
+
+variable {α β : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool}
+
+/-! ### Alternating verifiers on fixed-length bit-string slices -/
+
+/-- The encoded length of `(a, s)` under `encPair enc encBits` when `s` has length `q |enc a|`. -/
+private noncomputable def pairPoly (q : Polynomial ℕ) : Polynomial ℕ := 2 * X + 1 + q
+
+private theorem length_encPair_eq_eval_pairPoly {q : Polynomial ℕ} {a : α} {s : List Bool}
+    (hs : s.length = q.eval (enc a).length) :
+    (encPair enc encBits (a, s)).length = (pairPoly q).eval (enc a).length := by
+  simp [pairPoly, hs]
+
+/-- Shift the first `p |enc a|` certificate bits from the quantifier stream onto the accumulated
+bit-string prefix `s`. -/
+private def shiftVerifier (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (p : Polynomial ℕ)
+    (V : (α × List Bool) × List Bool → Bool) (x : (α × List Bool) × List Bool) : Bool :=
+  let n := p.eval (enc x.1.1).length
+  V ((x.1.1, x.1.2 ++ x.2.take n), x.2.drop n)
+
+@[simp]
+private theorem shiftVerifier_append {p : Polynomial ℕ} {V : (α × List Bool) × List Bool → Bool}
+    {a : α} {s u v : List Bool} (hu : u.length = p.eval (enc a).length) :
+    shiftVerifier enc p V ((a, s), u ++ v) = V ((a, s ++ u), v) := by
+  simp [shiftVerifier, ← hu]
+
+private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_shiftVerifier (p : Polynomial ℕ)
+    {V : (α × List Bool) × List Bool → Bool}
+    (hV : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encBool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (shiftVerifier enc p V)
+      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encBool := by
+  have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun x : (α × List Bool) × List Bool => p.eval (enc x.1.1).length)
+      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encUnary :=
+    (unary_eval p).comp ((encoding_length enc).comp (fst _ _).fst')
+  exact hV.comp (((fst _ _).fst'.prod
+    (bitsAppend (fst _ _).snd' (bitsTakeWithInput (snd _ _) hn))).prod
+    (bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) hn))
+
+private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_splitAlternatingBlocks' {γ : Type}
+    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} (ps : List (Polynomial ℕ × Polynomial ℕ)) {N : γ → ℕ}
+    (hN : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime N encIn encUnary) {W : γ → List Bool}
+    (hW : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime W encIn encBits) :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun x => splitAlternatingBlocks (ps.map fun pq => (pq.1.eval (N x), pq.2.eval (N x)))
+        (W x)) encIn (encPair encBits encBits) := by
+  induction ps generalizing W with
+  | nil => exact .const ([], [])
+  | cons pq ps ih =>
+    have hp := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval pq.1).comp hN
+    have hq := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval pq.2).comp hN
+    have ht := ih (hW.bitsDropWithInput (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp
+      (hp.prod hq)))
+    exact ((hW.bitsTakeWithInput hp).bitsAppend ht.fst').prod
+      (((hW.bitsDropWithInput hp).bitsTakeWithInput hq).bitsAppend ht.snd')
+
+/-- `R : α → List Bool → Prop` is verified at `(b, k)` on prefixes `s` of length `q |enc a|` by a
+polynomial-time alternating verifier whose certificate block lengths are polynomials in
+`|enc a|`. -/
+private def OnSliceAlt (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (b : Bool) (k : ℕ) (q : Polynomial ℕ)
+    (R : α → List Bool → Prop) : Prop :=
+  ∃ (ps : List (Polynomial ℕ)) (V : (α × List Bool) × List Bool → Bool),
+    ps.length = k ∧
+    ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encBool ∧
+    ∀ a : α, ∀ s : List Bool, s.length = q.eval (enc a).length →
+      (R a s ↔ Alternation b (ps.map fun p => p.eval (enc a).length) fun v => V ((a, s), v) = true)
+
+namespace OnSliceAlt
+
+variable {b : Bool} {k : ℕ} {p q : Polynomial ℕ} {R R₁ R₂ : α → List Bool → Prop}
+
+private theorem congr (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₁)
+    (hR : ∀ a s, s.length = q.eval (enc a).length → (R₁ a s ↔ R₂ a s)) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₂ := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hA⟩ := h
+  exact ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, fun a s hs => (hR a s hs).symm.trans (hA a s hs)⟩
+
+private theorem congr_poly (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R) {q' : Polynomial ℕ}
+    (hq : ∀ n, q.eval n = q'.eval n) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k q' R := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hA⟩ := h
+  exact ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, fun a s hs => hA a s (hs.trans (hq _).symm)⟩
+
+/-- At slice length `0`, an existential `OnSliceAlt` relation defines a `SigmaP k` language on
+`α`. -/
+private theorem mem_SigmaP (h : OnSliceAlt enc true k 0 R) : {a | R a []} ∈ SigmaP k enc := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine mem_SigmaP_iff_tidy.mpr ⟨ps, fun x => V ((x.1, []), x.2), hk, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
+  · exact hV.tidy.comp (((fst enc encBits).prod (.const [])).prod (snd enc encBits))
+  · exact hR a [] (by simp)
+
+/-- Negating the verifier swaps quantifier polarities. -/
+private theorem not (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R) : OnSliceAlt enc (!b) k q (fun a s => ¬R a s) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨ps, fun x => !V x, hk, by fun_prop, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  dsimp only
+  rw [hR a s hs, not_alternation]
+  exact alternation_congr fun v => by simp
+
+/-- Prepending a length-zero block flips the leading quantifier polarity and increments the
+level. -/
+private theorem zero_cons (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R) : OnSliceAlt enc (!b) (k + 1) q R := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨0 :: ps, V, by simp [hk], hV, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  rw [hR a s hs, List.map_cons, Polynomial.eval_zero, alternation_zero_cons, Bool.not_not]
+
+/-- Appending a length-zero block increments the level without changing the leading polarity. -/
+private theorem append_zero (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R) : OnSliceAlt enc b (k + 1) q R := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨ps ++ [0], V, by simp [hk], hV, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  rw [hR a s hs, List.map_append, List.map_singleton, Polynomial.eval_zero, alternation_append_zero]
+
+/-- Conjoining two `OnSliceAlt` relations at the same polarity and level. -/
+private theorem and (h₁ : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₁) (h₂ : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₂) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k q (fun a s => R₁ a s ∧ R₂ a s) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hp, hV, hR₁⟩ := h₁
+  obtain ⟨qs, W, hq, hW, hR₂⟩ := h₂
+  have hlen : ps.length = qs.length := hp.trans hq.symm
+  let pqs := ps.zip qs
+  refine ⟨pqs.map fun pq => pq.1 + pq.2,
+    fun x =>
+      let w := splitAlternatingBlocks
+        (pqs.map fun pq => (pq.1.eval (enc x.1.1).length, pq.2.eval (enc x.1.1).length)) x.2
+      V (x.1, w.1) && W (x.1, w.2),
+    by simp [pqs, hp, hq], ?_, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  · have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+        (fun x : (α × List Bool) × List Bool => (enc x.1.1).length)
+        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encUnary :=
+      (encoding_length enc).comp (fst _ _).fst'
+    have hs := computableTidilyInPolyTime_splitAlternatingBlocks' pqs hn (snd _ _)
+    exact .of_tidy <|
+      (hV.tidy.comp ((fst _ _).prod hs.fst')).bool_and'
+        (hW.tidy.comp ((fst _ _).prod hs.snd'))
+  · dsimp only
+    rw [hR₁ a s hs, hR₂ a s hs]
+    have hfst : pqs.map Prod.fst = ps := List.map_fst_zip hlen.le
+    have hsnd : pqs.map Prod.snd = qs := List.map_snd_zip hlen.ge
+    rw [← hfst, ← hsnd]
+    simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Polynomial.eval_add, Bool.and_eq_true]
+    simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using (alternation_splitAlternatingBlocks
+      (pqs.map fun pq => (pq.1.eval (enc a).length, pq.2.eval (enc a).length)) b
+      (fun v => V ((a, s), v) = true) (fun v => W ((a, s), v) = true)).symm
+
+/-- Disjoining two `OnSliceAlt` relations at the same polarity and level. -/
+private theorem or (h₁ : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₁) (h₂ : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₂) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k q (fun a s => R₁ a s ∨ R₂ a s) := by
+  have h : OnSliceAlt enc (!!b) k q (fun a s => ¬(¬R₁ a s ∧ ¬R₂ a s)) := (h₁.not.and h₂.not).not
+  rw [Bool.not_not] at h
+  exact h.congr fun a s _ => by tauto
+
+/-- Implication from a negated `OnSliceAlt` relation to a positive one at the same polarity. -/
+private theorem imp (h₁ : OnSliceAlt enc (!b) k q R₁) (h₂ : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R₂) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k q (fun a s => R₁ a s → R₂ a s) := by
+  have h₁' : OnSliceAlt enc b k q (fun a s => ¬R₁ a s) := by
+    simpa using h₁.not
+  refine (h₁'.or h₂).congr fun a s _ => ?_
+  tauto
+
+/-- Embed a `SigmaP k (encPair enc encBits)` language at any slice polynomial `q`. -/
+private theorem of_mem_SigmaP {C : Set (α × List Bool)} (hC : C ∈ SigmaP k (encPair enc encBits))
+    (q : Polynomial ℕ) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc true k q (fun a s => (a, s) ∈ C) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hA⟩ := hC
+  refine ⟨ps.map fun p => p.comp (pairPoly q), V, by simp [hk], hV, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  dsimp only
+  rw [hA (a, s), length_encPair_eq_eval_pairPoly hs]
+  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Polynomial.eval_comp]
+
+/-- Embed a `PiP k (encPair enc encBits)` language at any slice polynomial `q`. -/
+private theorem of_mem_PiP {C : Set (α × List Bool)} (hC : C ∈ PiP k (encPair enc encBits))
+    (q : Polynomial ℕ) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc false k q (fun a s => (a, s) ∈ C) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hA⟩ := hC
+  refine ⟨ps.map fun p => p.comp (pairPoly q), V, by simp [hk], hV, fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  dsimp only
+  rw [hA (a, s), length_encPair_eq_eval_pairPoly hs]
+  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Polynomial.eval_comp]
+
+/-- Drop the first `p |enc a|` bits of the slice prefix before evaluating `R`. -/
+private theorem drop (p : Polynomial ℕ) (h : OnSliceAlt enc b k q R) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc b k (p + q) (fun a s => R a (s.drop (p.eval (enc a).length))) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨ps, fun x => V ((x.1.1, x.1.2.drop (p.eval (enc x.1.1).length)), x.2), hk, ?_,
+    fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  · have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+        (fun x : (α × List Bool) × List Bool => p.eval (enc x.1.1).length)
+        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encUnary :=
+      (unary_eval p).comp ((encoding_length enc).comp (fst _ _).fst')
+    exact .of_tidy <| hV.tidy.comp (((fst _ _).fst'.prod
+      (bitsDropWithInput (fst _ _).snd' hn)).prod (snd _ _))
+  · refine hR a (s.drop (p.eval (enc a).length)) ?_
+    simp [hs]
+
+/-- Prepend an existential quantifier over words of length `p |enc a|` to a universal relation. -/
+private theorem exists_append_flip (p : Polynomial ℕ) (h : OnSliceAlt enc false k (q + p) R) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc true (k + 1) q
+      (fun a s => ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval (enc a).length ∧ R a (s ++ u)) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨p :: ps, shiftVerifier enc p V, by simp [hk],
+    .of_tidy (computableTidilyInPolyTime_shiftVerifier p hV.tidy), fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_true_cons]
+  refine exists_congr fun u => and_congr_right fun hu => ?_
+  have hsu : (s ++ u).length = (q + p).eval (enc a).length := by
+    simp [hs, hu]
+  rw [hR a (s ++ u) hsu]
+  exact alternation_congr fun v => by rw [shiftVerifier_append hu]
+
+/-- Prepend a universal quantifier over words of length `p |enc a|` to an existential relation. -/
+private theorem forall_append_flip (p : Polynomial ℕ) (h : OnSliceAlt enc true k (q + p) R) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc false (k + 1) q
+      (fun a s => ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval (enc a).length → R a (s ++ u)) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨p :: ps, shiftVerifier enc p V, by simp [hk],
+    .of_tidy (computableTidilyInPolyTime_shiftVerifier p hV.tidy), fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_false_cons]
+  refine forall_congr' fun u => imp_congr_right fun hu => ?_
+  have hsu : (s ++ u).length = (q + p).eval (enc a).length := by
+    simp [hs, hu]
+  rw [hR a (s ++ u) hsu]
+  exact alternation_congr fun v => by rw [shiftVerifier_append hu]
+
+/-- Merge an existential quantifier over words of length `p |enc a|` into the leading existential
+block. -/
+private theorem exists_append_same (p : Polynomial ℕ) (h : OnSliceAlt enc true (k + 1) (q + p) R) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc true (k + 1) q
+      (fun a s => ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval (enc a).length ∧ R a (s ++ u)) := by
+  obtain ⟨ps, V, hk, hV, hR⟩ := h
+  rcases ps with _ | ⟨p₁, ps⟩
+  · cases hk
+  refine ⟨(p + p₁) :: ps, shiftVerifier enc p V, by simpa using hk,
+    .of_tidy (computableTidilyInPolyTime_shiftVerifier p hV.tidy), fun a s hs => ?_⟩
+  simp only [List.map_cons, Polynomial.eval_add, alternation_true_cons]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hRu⟩
+    have hsu : (s ++ u).length = (q + p).eval (enc a).length := by simp [hs, hu]
+    obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, hA⟩ := (hR a (s ++ u) hsu).1 hRu
+    refine ⟨u ++ w₁, by simp [hu, hw₁], ?_⟩
+    refine hA.mono fun v hv => ?_
+    simpa only [List.append_assoc, shiftVerifier_append hu] using hv
+  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hA⟩
+    let n := p.eval (enc a).length
+    have hu : (w.take n).length = n := by simp [n, hw]
+    have hw₁ : (w.drop n).length = p₁.eval (enc a).length := by simp [n, hw]
+    have hsu : (s ++ w.take n).length = (q + p).eval (enc a).length := by simp [hs, hu, n]
+    refine ⟨w.take n, hu, (hR a (s ++ w.take n) hsu).2 ⟨w.drop n, hw₁, ?_⟩⟩
+    refine hA.mono fun v hv => ?_
+    have htake : (w.take n ++ (w.drop n ++ v)) = w ++ v := by
+      rw [← List.append_assoc, List.take_append_drop]
+    rw [← htake, shiftVerifier_append hu] at hv
+    exact hv
+
+/-- Merge a universal quantifier over words of length `p |enc a|` into the leading universal
+block. -/
+private theorem forall_append_same (p : Polynomial ℕ) (h : OnSliceAlt enc false (k + 1) (q + p) R) :
+    OnSliceAlt enc false (k + 1) q
+      (fun a s => ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval (enc a).length → R a (s ++ u)) := by
+  have hnot : OnSliceAlt enc (!!false) (k + 1) q
+      (fun a s => ¬∃ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval (enc a).length ∧ ¬R a (s ++ u)) :=
+    (h.not.exists_append_same p).not
+  exact hnot.congr fun a s _ => by simp
+
+end OnSliceAlt
+
+/-! ### Kadin's alternating tuple chain and word-tuple predicates -/
+
+/-- The canonical `BH r` language on concatenated `r`-tuples of words of length `m |enc a|`:
+`(a, s ++ y)` belongs to `kadinChain enc m E (r + 1)` when `(a, y) ∈ E` and
+`(a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r`. -/
+def kadinChain (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool)) :
+    ℕ → Set (α × List Bool)
+  | 0 => ∅
+  | r + 1 =>
+    {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.drop ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ E} \
+      {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.take ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ kadinChain enc m E r}
+
+@[simp]
+theorem kadinChain_zero (m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool)) :
+    kadinChain enc m E 0 = ∅ := rfl
+
+theorem mem_kadinChain_succ_append {m : Polynomial ℕ} {E : Set (α × List Bool)} {r : ℕ}
+    {a : α} {s y : List Bool} (hs : s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length) :
+    (a, s ++ y) ∈ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) ↔
+      (a, y) ∈ E ∧ (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r := by
+  have hs' : s.length = r * m.eval (enc a).length := by simpa using hs
+  simp [kadinChain, ← hs']
+
+theorem kadinChain_mem_BH {m : Polynomial ℕ} {E : Set (α × List Bool)}
+    (hE : E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)) (r : ℕ) :
+    kadinChain enc m E r ∈ BH (encPair enc encBits) r := by
+  induction r with
+  | zero => simp [kadinChain]
+  | succ r ih =>
+    have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+        (fun x : α × List Bool => (r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)
+        (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
+      (unary_eval (r • m)).comp ((encoding_length enc).comp (fst _ _))
+    have hdrop : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
+        {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.drop ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ E} E :=
+      ⟨fun x => (x.1, x.2.drop ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)),
+        .of_tidy ((fst _ _).prod (bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) hn)), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
+    have htake : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
+        {x : α × List Bool |
+          (x.1, x.2.take ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ kadinChain enc m E r}
+        (kadinChain enc m E r) :=
+      ⟨fun x => (x.1, x.2.take ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)),
+        .of_tidy ((fst _ _).prod (bitsTakeWithInput (snd _ _) hn)), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨_, hdrop.mem_NP hE, _, htake.mem_BH ih, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The `NP` language checking that each of the first `d` consecutive blocks of length `m |enc a|`
+in `z` belongs to `E`. -/
+def allWordsIn (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool)) :
+    ℕ → Set (α × List Bool)
+  | 0 => Set.univ
+  | d + 1 =>
+    {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.take (m.eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ E} ∩
+      {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.drop (m.eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d}
+
+@[simp]
+theorem allWordsIn_zero (m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool)) :
+    allWordsIn enc m E 0 = Set.univ := rfl
+
+theorem mem_allWordsIn_succ_append {m : Polynomial ℕ} {E : Set (α × List Bool)} {d : ℕ}
+    {a : α} {y z : List Bool} (hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length) :
+    (a, y ++ z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E (d + 1) ↔
+      (a, y) ∈ E ∧ (a, z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d := by
+  simp [allWordsIn, ← hy]
+
+theorem allWordsIn_mem_NP {m : Polynomial ℕ} {E : Set (α × List Bool)}
+    (hE : E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)) (d : ℕ) :
+    allWordsIn enc m E d ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits) := by
+  induction d with
+  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ => true, .const _, by simp [IsVerifier]⟩
+  | succ d ih =>
+    have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+        (fun x : α × List Bool => m.eval (enc x.1).length)
+        (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
+      (unary_eval m).comp ((encoding_length enc).comp (fst _ _))
+    have htake : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
+        {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.take (m.eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ E} E :=
+      ⟨fun x => (x.1, x.2.take (m.eval (enc x.1).length)),
+        .of_tidy ((fst _ _).prod (bitsTakeWithInput (snd _ _) hn)), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
+    have hdrop : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
+        {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.drop (m.eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d}
+        (allWordsIn enc m E d) :=
+      ⟨fun x => (x.1, x.2.drop (m.eval (enc x.1).length)),
+        .of_tidy ((fst _ _).prod (bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) hn)), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
+    exact inter_mem_NP (htake.mem_NP hE) (hdrop.mem_NP ih)
+
+/-- Unpack a `BH (r + 1)` language `D ⊆ U` (where `U ∈ NP`) into `D = B \ D₁` with
+`D₁ ⊆ B ⊆ U`, so that `D₁ = B \ D ⊆ U \ D`. -/
+private theorem mem_BH_succ_subset {γ : Type} {encγ : γ ↪ List Bool} {r : ℕ}
+    {U D : Set γ} (hU : U ∈ NP encγ) (hD : D ∈ BH encγ (r + 1)) (hDU : D ⊆ U) :
+    ∃ B ∈ NP encγ, ∃ D₁ ∈ BH encγ r,
+      B ⊆ U ∧ D₁ ⊆ B ∧ D = B \ D₁ ∧ D₁ ⊆ U \ D := by
+  obtain ⟨B', hB', D', hD', rfl⟩ := hD
+  refine ⟨B' ∩ U, inter_mem_NP hB' hU, D' ∩ (B' ∩ U),
+    inter_mem_BH_of_mem_NP hD' (inter_mem_NP hB' hU),
+    Set.inter_subset_right, Set.inter_subset_right, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · ext x
+    have hxU : x ∈ B' \ D' → x ∈ U := fun h => hDU h
+    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_inter_iff] at hxU ⊢
+    tauto
+  · intro x hx
+    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_sdiff] at hx ⊢
+    tauto
+
+/-! ### Hard-prefix branch at level `r` -/
+
+/-- A prefix `s` of `r` words of length `m |enc a|` is `r`-hard for `D₁` on instance `a` if
+`(a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r` and no extension by `y` (of length `m |enc a|`) and `z` (of `d`
+words in `E` of length `m |enc a|`) places `(a, s ++ y ++ z)` in `D₁`. -/
+private def kadinIsHard (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool))
+    (r d : ℕ) (D₁ : Set (α × List Bool)) (a : α) (s : List Bool) : Prop :=
+  (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r ∧
+    ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = ((1 + d) • m).eval (enc a).length →
+      (a, w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+      (a, s ++ w) ∉ D₁
+
+/-- Given a hard prefix `s`, the main `Π₂` check for `a ∈ A`: for every `u₁` of length `p₁ |enc a|`,
+there exist `u₂` of length `p₂ |enc a|` and `z` of `d` words in `E` (packed as `w = u₂ ++ z` of
+length `(p₂ + d • m) |enc a|`) such that `(a, s ++ u₁ ++ w) ∈ B`. -/
+private def kadinMain (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (p₁ p₂ m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool))
+    (d : ℕ) (B : Set (α × List Bool)) (a : α) (s : List Bool) : Prop :=
+  ∀ u₁ : List Bool, u₁.length = p₁.eval (enc a).length →
+    ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = (p₂ + d • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+      (a, w.drop (p₂.eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d ∧
+      (a, s ++ u₁ ++ w) ∈ B
+
+/-- The level-`r` hard-prefix branch of Kadin's `Σ₃ᴾ` simulation. -/
+private def kadinHardBranch (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (p₁ p₂ m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool))
+    (r d : ℕ) (D₁ B : Set (α × List Bool)) : Set α :=
+  {a | ∃ s : List Bool, s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+    kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁ a s ∧
+    kadinMain enc p₁ p₂ m E d B a s}
+
+private theorem kadinHardBranch_mem_SigmaP_three {p₁ p₂ m : Polynomial ℕ}
+    {E : Set (α × List Bool)} (hE : E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)) (r d : ℕ)
+    {D₁ B : Set (α × List Bool)} (hD₁ : D₁ ∈ BH (encPair enc encBits) r)
+    (hB : B ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)) :
+    kadinHardBranch enc p₁ p₂ m E r d D₁ B ∈ SigmaP 3 enc := by
+  have hLr_compl : (kadinChain enc m E r)ᶜ ∈ PiP 2 (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    (BooleanHierarchy_subset_SigmaP_two_inter_PiP_two
+      (compl_mem_BooleanHierarchy
+        (BH_subset_BooleanHierarchy r (kadinChain_mem_BH hE r)))).2
+  have hD₁_compl : D₁ᶜ ∈ PiP 2 (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    (BooleanHierarchy_subset_SigmaP_two_inter_PiP_two
+      (compl_mem_BooleanHierarchy (BH_subset_BooleanHierarchy r hD₁))).2
+  have hAll : allWordsIn enc m E d ∈ SigmaP 1 (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    SigmaP_one (enc := encPair enc encBits) ▸ allWordsIn_mem_NP hE d
+  have hB' : B ∈ SigmaP 1 (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    SigmaP_one (enc := encPair enc encBits) ▸ hB
+  -- `kadinIsHard` is `OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m)`
+  have hHard1 : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m) (fun a s => (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r) :=
+    OnSliceAlt.of_mem_PiP hLr_compl (r • m)
+  have hAll_drop1 : OnSliceAlt enc true 2 ((r • m + m) + d • m)
+      (fun a sw => (a, sw.drop ((r • m + m).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d) :=
+    ((OnSliceAlt.of_mem_SigmaP hAll (d • m)).append_zero).drop (r • m + m)
+  have hAll_drop1' : OnSliceAlt enc (!false) 2 (r • m + (1 + d) • m)
+      (fun a sw => (a, sw.drop ((r • m + m).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d) :=
+    hAll_drop1.congr_poly fun n => by simp [add_smul, one_smul, add_assoc]
+  have hD₁_slice : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m + (1 + d) • m) (fun a sw => (a, sw) ∉ D₁) :=
+    OnSliceAlt.of_mem_PiP hD₁_compl (r • m + (1 + d) • m)
+  have hHard2_body : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m + (1 + d) • m)
+      (fun a sw =>
+        (a, sw.drop ((r • m + m).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+          (a, sw) ∉ D₁) :=
+    hAll_drop1'.imp hD₁_slice
+  have hHard2 : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m)
+      (fun a s => ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = ((1 + d) • m).eval (enc a).length →
+        (a, w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+        (a, s ++ w) ∉ D₁) := by
+    refine (hHard2_body.forall_append_same ((1 + d) • m)).congr fun a s hs => ?_
+    refine forall_congr' fun w => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
+    have hlen : (r • m + m).eval (enc a).length = s.length + m.eval (enc a).length := by
+      rw [Polynomial.eval_add, hs]
+    have hdrop : (s ++ w).drop ((r • m + m).eval (enc a).length) =
+        w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length) := by
+      rw [hlen, ← List.drop_drop, List.drop_left]
+    rw [hdrop]
+  have hIsHard : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m) (kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁) :=
+    hHard1.and hHard2
+  -- `kadinMain` is `OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m)`
+  have hAll_drop2 : OnSliceAlt enc true 1 ((r • m + p₁ + p₂) + d • m)
+      (fun a suw =>
+        (a, suw.drop ((r • m + p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d) :=
+    (OnSliceAlt.of_mem_SigmaP hAll (d • m)).drop (r • m + p₁ + p₂)
+  have hAll_drop2' : OnSliceAlt enc true 1 ((r • m + p₁) + (p₂ + d • m))
+      (fun a suw =>
+        (a, suw.drop ((r • m + p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d) :=
+    hAll_drop2.congr_poly fun n => by simp [add_assoc]
+  have hB_slice : OnSliceAlt enc true 1 ((r • m + p₁) + (p₂ + d • m))
+      (fun a suw => (a, suw) ∈ B) :=
+    OnSliceAlt.of_mem_SigmaP hB' ((r • m + p₁) + (p₂ + d • m))
+  have hMain_exists : OnSliceAlt enc true 1 (r • m + p₁)
+      (fun a su₁ => ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = (p₂ + d • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+        (a, (su₁ ++ w).drop ((r • m + p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d ∧
+        (a, su₁ ++ w) ∈ B) :=
+    (hAll_drop2'.and hB_slice).exists_append_same (p₂ + d • m)
+  have hMain : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (r • m) (kadinMain enc p₁ p₂ m E d B) := by
+    refine (hMain_exists.forall_append_flip p₁).congr fun a s hs => ?_
+    refine forall_congr' fun u₁ => imp_congr_right fun hu₁ => ?_
+    refine exists_congr fun w => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
+    have hsu₁ : (r • m + p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length =
+        (s ++ u₁).length + p₂.eval (enc a).length := by
+      simp [hs, hu₁]
+    have hdrop : (s ++ u₁ ++ w).drop ((r • m + p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length) =
+        w.drop (p₂.eval (enc a).length) := by
+      rw [hsu₁, ← List.drop_drop, List.drop_left]
+    rw [hdrop]
+  -- Combine `kadinIsHard` and `kadinMain`, then existentially quantify over `s`
+  have hBoth : OnSliceAlt enc false 2 (0 + r • m)
+      (fun a s => kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁ a s ∧ kadinMain enc p₁ p₂ m E d B a s) :=
+    (hIsHard.and hMain).congr_poly fun n => by simp
+  have hBranch : OnSliceAlt enc true 3 0
+      (fun a s => ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+        kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁ a (s ++ u) ∧ kadinMain enc p₁ p₂ m E d B a (s ++ u)) :=
+    hBoth.exists_append_flip (r • m)
+  exact hBranch.mem_SigmaP
+
+/-! ### Downward induction along the Boolean hierarchy -/
+
+section KadinInduction
+
+variable (enc) (p₁ p₂ m : Polynomial ℕ) (E : Set (α × List Bool))
+
+private def kadinTarget : Set α :=
+  {a | ∀ u₁ : List Bool, u₁.length = p₁.eval (enc a).length →
+    ∃ u₂ : List Bool, u₂.length = p₂.eval (enc a).length ∧ (a, u₁ ++ u₂) ∉ E}
+
+private def kadinSoundD (r d : ℕ) (D : Set (α × List Bool)) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a : α, ∀ s z : List Bool,
+    s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length →
+    z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length →
+    (a, z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+    (a, s ++ z) ∈ D →
+    (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r
+
+private def kadinSoundDiff (r d : ℕ) (U D : Set (α × List Bool)) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a : α, ∀ s z : List Bool,
+    s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length →
+    z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length →
+    (a, z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+    (a, s ++ z) ∈ U \ D →
+    (a, s) ∈ kadinChain enc m E r
+
+private def kadinComp (r d : ℕ) (D : Set (α × List Bool)) (a : α) : Prop :=
+  ∀ s : List Bool,
+    s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length →
+    (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r →
+    ∃ z : List Bool,
+      z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+      (a, z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d ∧
+      (a, s ++ z) ∈ D
+
+private theorem exists_kadin_sigmaP_three (hm : m = p₁ + p₂)
+    (hE : E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits)) :
+    ∀ (r d : ℕ) {U D : Set (α × List Bool)},
+      U ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits) →
+      D ∈ BH (encPair enc encBits) r →
+      D ⊆ U →
+      kadinSoundD enc m E r d D →
+      kadinSoundDiff enc m E r d U D →
+      ∃ H ∈ SigmaP 3 enc,
+        H ⊆ kadinTarget enc p₁ p₂ E ∧
+        ∀ a ∈ kadinTarget enc p₁ p₂ E, kadinComp enc m E r d D a → a ∈ H
+  | 0, d, U, D, _, hD, _, _, _ => by
+    have hD0 : D = ∅ := hD
+    subst hD0
+    have hempty : (∅ : Set α) ∈ SigmaP 3 enc :=
+      SigmaP_subset_SigmaP_succ 2 (SigmaP_subset_SigmaP_succ 1
+        (SigmaP_one (enc := enc) ▸ ⟨0, fun _ => false, .const _, by simp [IsVerifier]⟩))
+    refine ⟨∅, hempty, Set.empty_subset _, fun a _ hComp => ?_⟩
+    obtain ⟨z, _, _, hz⟩ := hComp [] (by simp) (by simp [kadinChain])
+    exact hz
+  | r + 1, d, U, D, hU, hD, hDU, hSoundD, hSoundDiff => by
+    obtain ⟨B, hB, D₁, hD₁, hBU, hD₁B, hDB, hD₁UD⟩ := mem_BH_succ_subset hU hD hDU
+    -- Strong soundness of `D₁`: `(a, s ++ y ++ z) ∈ D₁` implies `(a, y) ∈ E ∧ (a, s) ∉ L r`
+    have hStrongD₁ : ∀ (a : α) (s y z : List Bool),
+        s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length →
+        y.length = m.eval (enc a).length →
+        z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length →
+        (a, z) ∈ allWordsIn enc m E d →
+        (a, s ++ (y ++ z)) ∈ D₁ →
+        (a, y) ∈ E ∧ (a, s) ∉ kadinChain enc m E r := by
+      intro a s y z hs hy hz hzE hmem
+      have hsy_len : (s ++ y).length = ((r + 1) • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+        simp [hs, hy, add_smul, one_smul]
+      have hmem' : (a, (s ++ y) ++ z) ∈ U \ D := by
+        rw [List.append_assoc]
+        exact hD₁UD hmem
+      have hL : (a, s ++ y) ∈ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) :=
+        hSoundDiff a (s ++ y) z hsy_len hz hzE hmem'
+      exact (mem_kadinChain_succ_append hs).1 hL
+    have hSoundD₁ : kadinSoundD enc m E r (d + 1) D₁ := by
+      intro a s w hs hw hwE hmem
+      have hw' : w.length = m.eval (enc a).length + (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+        simpa [add_smul, one_smul, Nat.add_comm] using hw
+      let y := w.take (m.eval (enc a).length)
+      let z := w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length)
+      have hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length := by simp [y, hw']
+      have hz : z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by simp [z, hw']
+      have hsplit : y ++ z = w := List.take_append_drop _ _
+      rw [← hsplit] at hwE hmem
+      obtain ⟨_, hzE⟩ := (mem_allWordsIn_succ_append hy).1 hwE
+      exact (hStrongD₁ a s y z hs hy hz hzE hmem).2
+    have hSoundDiff₁ : kadinSoundDiff enc m E r (d + 1) B D₁ := by
+      intro a s w hs hw hwE hmem
+      have hw' : w.length = m.eval (enc a).length + (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+        simpa [add_smul, one_smul, Nat.add_comm] using hw
+      let y := w.take (m.eval (enc a).length)
+      let z := w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length)
+      have hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length := by simp [y, hw']
+      have hz : z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by simp [z, hw']
+      have hsplit : y ++ z = w := List.take_append_drop _ _
+      rw [← hsplit] at hwE hmem
+      obtain ⟨hyE, hzE⟩ := (mem_allWordsIn_succ_append hy).1 hwE
+      have hsy_len : (s ++ y).length = ((r + 1) • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+        simp [hs, hy, add_smul, one_smul]
+      have hmemD : (a, (s ++ y) ++ z) ∈ D := by
+        rw [List.append_assoc, hDB]
+        exact hmem
+      have hnotL : (a, s ++ y) ∉ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) :=
+        hSoundD a (s ++ y) z hsy_len hz hzE hmemD
+      rw [mem_kadinChain_succ_append hs, not_and, not_not] at hnotL
+      exact hnotL hyE
+    obtain ⟨H_r, hH_r_mem, hH_r_sub, hH_r_comp⟩ :=
+      exists_kadin_sigmaP_three hm hE r (d + 1) hB hD₁ hD₁B hSoundD₁ hSoundDiff₁
+    let Hard := kadinHardBranch enc p₁ p₂ m E r d D₁ B
+    have hHard_mem : Hard ∈ SigmaP 3 enc :=
+      kadinHardBranch_mem_SigmaP_three hE r d hD₁ hB
+    refine ⟨Hard ∪ H_r, union_mem_SigmaP hHard_mem hH_r_mem, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · rintro a (ha | ha)
+      · obtain ⟨s, hs, ⟨hs_notL, hs_hard⟩, hmain⟩ := ha
+        intro u₁ hu₁
+        obtain ⟨w, hw, hwE, hBw⟩ := hmain u₁ hu₁
+        let u₂ := w.take (p₂.eval (enc a).length)
+        let z := w.drop (p₂.eval (enc a).length)
+        have hu₂ : u₂.length = p₂.eval (enc a).length := by simp [u₂, hw]
+        have hz : z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by simp [z, hw]
+        have hw_eq : u₂ ++ z = w := List.take_append_drop _ _
+        let y := u₁ ++ u₂
+        have hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length := by simp [y, hm, hu₁, hu₂]
+        have hyz_len : (y ++ z).length = ((1 + d) • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+          simp [hy, hz, add_smul, one_smul]
+        have hyz_drop : (y ++ z).drop (m.eval (enc a).length) = z := by
+          simp [← hy]
+        have hnotD₁ : (a, s ++ (y ++ z)) ∉ D₁ := by
+          refine hs_hard (y ++ z) hyz_len ?_
+          rwa [hyz_drop]
+        have hsuw_eq : s ++ u₁ ++ w = (s ++ y) ++ z := by
+          simp [y, ← hw_eq, List.append_assoc]
+        have hmemD : (a, (s ++ y) ++ z) ∈ D := by
+          rw [hDB]
+          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
+          · rwa [← hsuw_eq]
+          · simpa [List.append_assoc] using hnotD₁
+        have hsy_len : (s ++ y).length = ((r + 1) • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+          simp [hs, hy, add_smul, one_smul]
+        have hnotL_succ : (a, s ++ y) ∉ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) :=
+          hSoundD a (s ++ y) z hsy_len hz hwE hmemD
+        rw [mem_kadinChain_succ_append hs] at hnotL_succ
+        exact ⟨u₂, hu₂, fun hyE => hnotL_succ ⟨hyE, hs_notL⟩⟩
+      · exact hH_r_sub ha
+    · intro a ha hComp
+      by_cases hEx : ∃ s : List Bool, s.length = (r • m).eval (enc a).length ∧
+          kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁ a s
+      · left
+        obtain ⟨s, hs, hHard_s⟩ := hEx
+        refine ⟨s, hs, hHard_s, fun u₁ hu₁ => ?_⟩
+        obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂, hnotE⟩ := ha u₁ hu₁
+        let y := u₁ ++ u₂
+        have hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length := by simp [y, hm, hu₁, hu₂]
+        have hsy_len : (s ++ y).length = ((r + 1) • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+          simp [hs, hy, add_smul, one_smul]
+        have hnotL_succ : (a, s ++ y) ∉ kadinChain enc m E (r + 1) := by
+          rw [mem_kadinChain_succ_append hs]
+          exact fun ⟨hyE, _⟩ => hnotE hyE
+        obtain ⟨z, hz, hzE, hmemD⟩ := hComp (s ++ y) hsy_len hnotL_succ
+        have hmemB : (a, (s ++ y) ++ z) ∈ B := by
+          rw [hDB] at hmemD
+          exact hmemD.1
+        refine ⟨u₂ ++ z, by simp [hu₂, hz], ?_, ?_⟩
+        · simpa [← hu₂] using hzE
+        · simpa [y, List.append_assoc] using hmemB
+      · right
+        refine hH_r_comp a ha fun s hs hs_notL => ?_
+        have hnotHard : ¬kadinIsHard enc m E r d D₁ a s := fun h => hEx ⟨s, hs, h⟩
+        simp only [kadinIsHard, hs_notL, not_false_eq_true, true_and, not_forall,
+          not_not] at hnotHard
+        obtain ⟨w, hw, hwE, hmemD₁⟩ := hnotHard
+        have hw' : w.length = m.eval (enc a).length + (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by
+          simpa [add_smul, one_smul] using hw
+        let y := w.take (m.eval (enc a).length)
+        let z := w.drop (m.eval (enc a).length)
+        have hy : y.length = m.eval (enc a).length := by simp [y, hw']
+        have hz : z.length = (d • m).eval (enc a).length := by simp [z, hw']
+        have hsplit : y ++ z = w := List.take_append_drop _ _
+        rw [← hsplit] at hmemD₁
+        have hyE : (a, y) ∈ E := (hStrongD₁ a s y z hs hy hz hwE hmemD₁).1
+        refine ⟨w, by simpa [add_smul, one_smul, Nat.add_comm] using hw, ?_, by rwa [← hsplit]⟩
+        rw [← hsplit, mem_allWordsIn_succ_append hy]
+        exact ⟨hyE, hwE⟩
+
+end KadinInduction
+
+/-! ### Kadin's collapse theorems -/
+
+/-- **Kadin's theorem at level `3`** [Kadin][Kadin1988]: if `coBH k ⊆ BH k` holds for the pair
+encoding `encPair enc encBits`, then `PiP 3 enc ⊆ SigmaP 3 enc`. -/
+theorem PiP_three_subset_SigmaP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH {k : ℕ}
+    (h : coBH (encPair enc encBits) k ⊆ BH (encPair enc encBits) k) :
+    PiP 3 enc ⊆ SigmaP 3 enc := by
+  rintro A ⟨ps, V, hps, hV, hAV⟩
+  rcases ps with _ | ⟨p₁, _ | ⟨p₂, _ | ⟨p₃, _ | _⟩⟩⟩ <;> try cases hps
+  let E : Set (α × List Bool) :=
+    {y | ∃ u₃ : List Bool, u₃.length = p₃.eval (enc y.1).length ∧ (!V (y.1, y.2 ++ u₃)) = true}
+  have hE : E ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    mem_NP_setOf_exists_append (V := fun x => !V x)
+      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp hV.tidy) p₃
+  let m := p₁ + p₂
+  have hLk_compl : (kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ ∈ BH (encPair enc encBits) k :=
+    h (compl_mem_coBH_iff.mpr (kadinChain_mem_BH hE k))
+  have hU : (Set.univ : Set (α × List Bool)) ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits) :=
+    ⟨0, fun _ => true, .const _, by simp [IsVerifier]⟩
+  have hSoundD : kadinSoundD enc m E k 0 (kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ := by
+    intro a s z hs hz _ hmem
+    have hz0 : z = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 (by simpa using hz)
+    subst hz0
+    simpa using hmem
+  have hSoundDiff : kadinSoundDiff enc m E k 0 Set.univ (kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ := by
+    intro a s z hs hz _ hmem
+    have hz0 : z = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 (by simpa using hz)
+    subst hz0
+    simpa using hmem
+  obtain ⟨H, hH_mem, hH_sub, hH_comp⟩ :=
+    exists_kadin_sigmaP_three enc p₁ p₂ m E rfl hE k 0 hU hLk_compl (Set.subset_univ _)
+      hSoundD hSoundDiff
+  have hA_eq : A = kadinTarget enc p₁ p₂ E := by
+    ext a
+    rw [hAV a]
+    simp only [kadinTarget, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
+      alternation_false_cons, alternation_true_cons, alternation_nil]
+    refine forall_congr' fun u₁ => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
+    refine exists_congr fun u₂ => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
+    simp [E, List.append_assoc]
+  have hH_eq : A = H := by
+    rw [hA_eq]
+    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun a ha => hH_comp a ha fun s _ hs => ?_) hH_sub
+    exact ⟨[], by simp, trivial, by simpa using hs⟩
+  rwa [hH_eq]
+
+/-- **Kadin's theorem at level `3`** [Kadin][Kadin1988]: if `coBH k ⊆ BH k` holds for the pair
+encoding `encPair enc encBits`, then `SigmaP 3 enc = PiP 3 enc`. -/
+theorem SigmaP_three_eq_PiP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH {k : ℕ}
+    (h : coBH (encPair enc encBits) k ⊆ BH (encPair enc encBits) k) :
+    SigmaP 3 enc = PiP 3 enc := by
+  have hsub := PiP_three_subset_SigmaP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH h
+  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun A hA => ?_) hsub
+  simpa using compl_mem_PiP_of_mem_SigmaP (hsub (compl_mem_PiP_of_mem_SigmaP hA))
+
+/-- **Kadin's theorem** [Kadin][Kadin1988]: if `coBH k ⊆ BH k` for all encodings, the polynomial
+hierarchy collapses to `Σ₃ᴾ`. -/
+theorem PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_coBH_subset_BH {k : ℕ}
+    (h : ∀ {β : Type} (enc' : β ↪ List Bool), coBH enc' k ⊆ BH enc' k) :

body: Optional scope-clarity suggestion: link the existing `Cslib.Crypto.SignatureScheme` here and state why this exact typed ROM interface is separate. That existing API packages word encodings, strict PPT certificates and non-oracle verification; the present interface has arbitrary typed PMF key/sign coins and shared hash access. A computational connection therefore needs encodings, oracle realization and resource certificates from 3b-ii/#643, rather than an unconditional bridge. This short explanation would keep users from treating the two signature notions as competing computational APIs.

+/-

+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Foundations.Control.Monad.Memoize
+public import Complexity.Languages.Probabilistic.Basic
+public import Cslib.Probability.PMF
+import Complexity.Probability.PMF
+
+/-!
+# Signatures in the random-oracle model
+
+A signature scheme in the random-oracle model ([BonehShoup2023], Section 13.2.1) signs and
+verifies with oracle access to a function `H : Query → Digest`, which the security experiment
+draws uniformly at random. Signing draws its coins and then runs an `OracleComp` program against
+`H`; verification is a deterministic `OracleComp` program. The oracle is sampled lazily: each new
+point gets a uniform answer, remembered in an association list (`oracle`), so the query and digest
+types need not be finite beyond the digests.
+
+The existential-unforgeability experiment (`eufCmaGame`, [BonehShoup2023], Attack Game 13.1 in
+its random-oracle version) gives a forger the public key and oracle access to the signer and to
+`H`; the forger wins with a valid signature on a message it never asked to have signed. A
+`Forger` has explicit coins, drawn first, and is otherwise a deterministic `OracleComp` program;
+this is the form in which a forger can be rerun on the same coins, as forking needs.
+
+These are exact probability laws for one scheme and one forger, with no efficiency claim. The
+oracle interface is the library's `OracleComp`; it is meant to be re-expressed in the shared
+interactive-protocol core of #643 once that core exists.

+
+These are exact probability laws for one scheme and one forger, with no efficiency claim. The
+oracle interface is the library's `OracleComp`; it is meant to be re-expressed in the shared
+interactive-protocol core of #643 once that core exists.

body: Fixed in 1312b01a. `Scopes` now tracks `variable` binders per section/namespace, and the resolver counts a written name as captured when its first component is a section variable, a local binder, an `open … renaming`/`export` alias or a notation token. Opens are modelled by kind. For possible captures, every open counts whole (an over-approximation); for reachability, only enclosing namespaces, `_root_` and opens that are neither selective without the name, hiding it nor `scoped`. A form is written only if it is reachable and nothing else can bind it. Names come from the whole import closure (`QualityReport.lean --names`), so unreferenced Mathlib/cslib constants are seen too. The dual case is also checked: a rename whose new name could capture another constant's reference is deferred. Regressions are in `CaptureTests`: your `open N; section; variable (bar : Nat)` case now yields `N.bar`; renaming/export/notation aliases; selective/hiding/scoped opens; unreferenced constants; new-name capture.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Plan and apply S2 of #456: remove tidy computability from public statements.
+
+Usage: python3 scripts/tidy_sweep.py report [--area AREA]... [--json OUT] [--markdown OUT]
+       python3 scripts/tidy_sweep.py rewrite --area AREA [--diff OUT | --verify [--rounds N]]
+Common options: [--registry FILE] [--allowlist FILE] [--build-dir DIR]; report also accepts
+[--no-build-check] and [--no-plan].
+
+Plain computability is the API and tidy computability is how the machine layer proves it: outside
+the raw machine constructions of the allowlist (`scripts/tidy_allowlist.txt`, from #608), no
+public statement should mention a tidy notion. Every public declaration outside the allowlist
+whose statement (its type, or the exposed body of a definition) mentions a tidy predicate falls
+in one case of the S2 design
+(https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/issues/456#issuecomment-6376748411):
+
+1. a theorem with a committed plain twin: proofs that become plain use the twin, and the
+   original is left for S1/S3 to internalize;
+2. any other theorem: it is renamed `computableTidily…` → `computable…` (the target name must be
+   free) and restated with the plain predicates;
+3. a definition, instance or structure field: it is listed for a hand-written plain redefinition.
+
+The twin of a tidy theorem is the public plain theorem named by its plain rename (`exact` when its
+statement is the syntactic plain transport, `by name` otherwise, for instance a broader canonical
+rule). `--registry` adds pairs from a migration script: a JSON array of
+`{"original": name, "plain": name, "module": module}` objects, validated strictly. A declaration
+that fits none of the cases is *unclassifiable*: it mentions a tidy notion without a same-bound
+plain equivalence, is a plain/tidy bridge or a deprecated alias, or its target name is taken (a
+collision). `report` prints the classification with per-area counts (#587's areas) and each
+area's rewrite plan, without writing anything.
+
+`rewrite --area AREA` restates the area's case 2 declarations and rewrites every reference to them
+in the three libraries, at the exact ranges recorded in the `.ilean` files (full names, names
+relative to namespaces and `open`s, dot notation), and in comments and READMEs. No edit is made
+at a span whose text does not spell the referenced constant, and a replacement name is written
+only if it resolves to its target, and nothing else, from its position (namespaces, `open`s,
+private names of the module, local binders); `rewrite` therefore needs current build outputs.
+
+A declaration is *deferred* (left tidy, with its references unchanged) when its statement names
+another tidy declaration, gets a tidy hypothesis from a `variable` command, or is written inside
+a tidy namespace, and when a reference to it cannot be converted completely. A restated proof is
+*translated* when every tidy declaration it names has a plain counterpart (a twin or a restated
+lemma): those names are replaced in place. Otherwise it is *wrapped*: the old proof runs on tidy
+hypotheses (`have h := h.tidy`) and its conclusion is converted (`refine .of_tidy ?_`);
+statements that are not a bare predicate are transported with `simpa only [<plain ↔ tidy>]`. A
+reference from a proof that stays tidy keeps its old type: the application becomes
+`(lemma args).tidy`, with `.of_tidy` around tidy arguments; references to case 1 originals stay
+there, and the plan counts them. `.of_tidy (x.tidy)` round trips are then removed.
+
+With `--verify`, the three libraries are built strictly (`--wfail --iofail`) after the rewrite; a
+translated proof that fails is wrapped instead and the build repeated. Failures that remain, such
+as a tidy `fun_prop` that relied on a lemma the batch made plain, mark plain-calculus gaps: they
+are reported, the status is `failed` and the exit code nonzero. `--diff` writes the plan as a
+patch instead of rewriting files.
+
+Declarations, statements and references come from `scripts/quality_report.py` and
+`scripts/QualityReport.lean`, which read the build outputs of
+`lake build Complexity ComplexityTests ComplexityAbstracts`.

+def discover_twins(constants: dict[str, dict]) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:

+def twin_map(constants: dict[str, dict], registry: dict[str, str]
+             ) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:

+# --- Classification -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

+@dataclass

+    module: str

+def decl_kind(decl: dict) -> str:

+                  unsupported=[t for t in tidy if t not in BY_TIDY],

+    out = []

+    out += ["", "Unclassifiable, by reason: " + "; ".join(
+        f"{r} ({n})" for r, n in s["unclassifiable_reasons"].items()) + "."]

+    if collisions:

+                "| Declaration | Target | Target module | Why |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
+        for e in collisions[:limit]:
+            c = e["collision"]

+        if len(collisions) > limit:

+    if unsupported:
