+# resolve_shared_packages_dir <worktree_path>: print the path to the pin-keyed shared packages
+# directory, keyed by cslib revision and the full manifest/toolchain/git dependency state, or fail
+# if COMPLEXITYLIB_SHARED_PACKAGES_ROOT points into the primary checkout.
+resolve_shared_packages_dir() {
+  local wt_path="$1"
+  python3 - "$ROOT" "$wt_path" <<'PY'
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+wt_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
+worktrees_root = (root / ".worktrees").resolve()
+
+
+def in_primary_checkout(p: Path) -> bool:
+    return p == root or (p.is_relative_to(root) and not p.is_relative_to(worktrees_root))
+
+
+def git_head(repo: Path) -> str | None:
+    if not (repo / ".git").exists():
+        return None
+    try:
+        rev = subprocess.check_output(
+            ["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"],
+            text=True,
+            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        ).strip()
+        return rev or None
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        return None
+
+
+def revs_match(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
+    n = min(len(a), len(b), 8)
+    return n > 0 and a[:n] == b[:n]
+
+
+def package_has_complete_build(pkg_dir: Path) -> bool:
+    build_dir = pkg_dir / ".lake/build"
+    if not build_dir.is_dir():
+        return False
+    return any(p.is_file() for p in build_dir.rglob("*"))
+
+
+def load_manifest_pkgs(path: Path) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return None
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            return None
+        pkgs = data.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(pkgs, list):
+            return None
+        out: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for pkg in pkgs:
+            if not isinstance(pkg, dict):
+                return None
+            name = pkg.get("name")
+            rev = pkg.get("rev")
+            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(rev, str) or not rev:
+                return None
+            out[name] = rev
+        return out
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+wt_tc = wt_path / "lean-toolchain"
+root_tc = root / "lean-toolchain"
+wt_manifest = wt_path / "lake-manifest.json"
+root_manifest = root / "lake-manifest.json"
+wt_has_own_metadata = (wt_path / ".git").exists() or wt_manifest.is_file() or wt_tc.is_file()
+
+spec_ok = True
+if wt_has_own_metadata:
+    if wt_tc.is_file() != root_tc.is_file():
+        spec_ok = False
+    if wt_manifest.is_file() != root_manifest.is_file():
+        spec_ok = False
+    eff_tc_file = wt_tc
+    eff_manifest_file = wt_manifest
+else:
+    eff_tc_file = root_tc
+    eff_manifest_file = root_manifest
+
+toolchain: str | None = None
+if eff_tc_file.is_file():
+    toolchain = eff_tc_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    if not toolchain:
+        spec_ok = False
+
+manifest_present = eff_manifest_file.is_file()
+loaded_pkgs = load_manifest_pkgs(eff_manifest_file) if manifest_present else {}
+if loaded_pkgs is None:
+    spec_ok = False
+    manifest_pkgs: dict[str, str] = {}
+else:
+    manifest_pkgs = loaded_pkgs
+
+git_heads: dict[str, str] = {}
+pkgs_dir = root / ".lake/packages"
+if pkgs_dir.is_dir():
+    for child in sorted(pkgs_dir.iterdir()):
+        if child.is_dir():
+            h = git_head(child)
+            if h:
+                git_heads[child.name] = h
+
+cslib_rev = manifest_pkgs.get("cslib") or (git_heads.get("cslib") if not manifest_present else "") or ""
+cslib_short = cslib_rev[:8] if cslib_rev else None
+
+other_manifest_pkgs = {k: v for k, v in manifest_pkgs.items() if k != "cslib"}
+other_git_heads = (
+    {k: v for k, v in git_heads.items() if k != "cslib"}
+    if not manifest_present
+    else {}
 )
 
+if cslib_short:
+    if not other_manifest_pkgs and not other_git_heads and toolchain is None:
+        base_pin_name = f"packages-cslib-{cslib_short}"
+    else:
+        pkg_items = manifest_pkgs if manifest_present else git_heads
+        state = {"packages": sorted(pkg_items.items()), "toolchain": toolchain}
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
+        base_pin_name = f"packages-cslib-{cslib_short}-{digest}"
+elif manifest_present or toolchain is not None or git_heads:
+    raw = eff_manifest_file.read_bytes() if manifest_present and eff_manifest_file.is_file() else b""
+    pkg_items = manifest_pkgs if manifest_present else git_heads
+    state_bytes = raw + b"\0" + json.dumps({"pkgs": sorted(pkg_items.items()), "tc": toolchain}, sort_keys=True).encode()
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(state_bytes).hexdigest()[:8]
+    base_pin_name = f"packages-manifest-{digest}"
+else:
+    base_pin_name = "packages-cslib-default"
+
+
+def pool_is_valid_and_hardened(cand: Path) -> bool:
+    if not spec_ok or not cand.is_dir():
+        return False
+    try:
+        cand_real = cand.resolve()
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    if in_primary_checkout(cand_real):
+        return False
+    prov_file = cand / ".pool-provenance.json"
+    if not prov_file.is_file() or prov_file.is_symlink():
+        return False
+    try:
+        prov = json.loads(prov_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return False
+    if not isinstance(prov, dict) or prov.get("schema") != 2 or prov.get("clean") is not True:
+        return False
+    if prov.get("manifest_present") != manifest_present:
+        return False
+    if prov.get("toolchain") != toolchain:
+        return False
+    cand_pkg_dirs = {d.name: d for d in cand.iterdir() if d.is_dir()}
+    if not cand_pkg_dirs:
+        return False
+    if manifest_present:
+        prov_pkgs = prov.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(prov_pkgs, dict):
+            return False
+        if set(prov_pkgs.keys()) != set(manifest_pkgs.keys()) or set(cand_pkg_dirs.keys()) != set(manifest_pkgs.keys()):
+            return False
+        for name, want_rev in manifest_pkgs.items():
+            rec_rev = prov_pkgs.get(name, "")
+            if not isinstance(rec_rev, str) or not revs_match(rec_rev, want_rev):
+                return False
+            actual_rev = git_head(cand_pkg_dirs[name])
+            if not actual_rev or not revs_match(actual_rev, want_rev):
+                return False
+    for pkg_dir in cand_pkg_dirs.values():
+        if not package_has_complete_build(pkg_dir):
+            return False
+    try:
+        if stat.S_IMODE(cand.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+            return False
+        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(cand_real, followlinks=False):
+            dp = Path(dirpath)
+            if stat.S_IMODE(dp.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+                return False
+            for name in list(dirnames) + list(filenames):
+                p = dp / name
+                if p.is_symlink():
+                    raw = Path(os.readlink(p))
+                    if raw.is_absolute():
+                        return False
+                    rel_parts = p.relative_to(cand_real).parts
+                    if len(rel_parts) < 2:
+                        return False
+                    pkg_root = (cand_real / rel_parts[0]).resolve()
+                    resolved = (p.parent / raw).resolve()
+                    if not resolved.exists() or not resolved.is_relative_to(pkg_root):
+                        return False
+                else:
+                    if stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+                        return False
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def select_candidate_in_root(sroot: Path) -> Path:
+    c1 = sroot / base_pin_name
+    if not c1.exists() or pool_is_valid_and_hardened(c1):
+        return c1
+    return sroot / f"{base_pin_name}-v2"

The fixture accepted a different requested full hash with the same first eight characters and seeded the actual checkout under that requested identity. Full manifest hashes must match exactly; if abbreviated revisions are deliberately supported, validate the complete supplied abbreviation rather than truncating it again. Apply the same rule to provenance reuse and root validation.

With a real partial dependency cache (Dep.olean removed, traces/ilean/Extra artifacts retained), this declares the package complete and publishes it read-only; actual scripts/build.sh +Dep fails removing Dep.ilean with permission error13. +# resolve_shared_packages_dir <worktree_path>: print the path to the pin-keyed shared packages
+# directory, keyed by cslib revision and the full manifest/toolchain/git dependency state, or fail
+# if COMPLEXITYLIB_SHARED_PACKAGES_ROOT points into the primary checkout.
+resolve_shared_packages_dir() {
+  local wt_path="$1"
+  python3 - "$ROOT" "$wt_path" <<'PY'
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+wt_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
+worktrees_root = (root / ".worktrees").resolve()
+
+
+def in_primary_checkout(p: Path) -> bool:
+    return p == root or (p.is_relative_to(root) and not p.is_relative_to(worktrees_root))
+
+
+def git_head(repo: Path) -> str | None:
+    if not (repo / ".git").exists():
+        return None
+    try:
+        rev = subprocess.check_output(
+            ["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"],
+            text=True,
+            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        ).strip()
+        return rev or None
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        return None
+
+
+def revs_match(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
+    n = min(len(a), len(b), 8)
+    return n > 0 and a[:n] == b[:n]
+
+
+def package_has_complete_build(pkg_dir: Path) -> bool:
+    build_dir = pkg_dir / ".lake/build"
+    if not build_dir.is_dir():
+        return False
+    return any(p.is_file() for p in build_dir.rglob("*"))
+
+
+def load_manifest_pkgs(path: Path) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return None
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            return None
+        pkgs = data.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(pkgs, list):
+            return None
+        out: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for pkg in pkgs:
+            if not isinstance(pkg, dict):
+                return None
+            name = pkg.get("name")
+            rev = pkg.get("rev")
+            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(rev, str) or not rev:
+                return None
+            out[name] = rev
+        return out
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+wt_tc = wt_path / "lean-toolchain"
+root_tc = root / "lean-toolchain"
+wt_manifest = wt_path / "lake-manifest.json"
+root_manifest = root / "lake-manifest.json"
+wt_has_own_metadata = (wt_path / ".git").exists() or wt_manifest.is_file() or wt_tc.is_file()
+
+spec_ok = True
+if wt_has_own_metadata:
+    if wt_tc.is_file() != root_tc.is_file():
+        spec_ok = False
+    if wt_manifest.is_file() != root_manifest.is_file():
+        spec_ok = False
+    eff_tc_file = wt_tc
+    eff_manifest_file = wt_manifest
+else:
+    eff_tc_file = root_tc
+    eff_manifest_file = root_manifest
+
+toolchain: str | None = None
+if eff_tc_file.is_file():
+    toolchain = eff_tc_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    if not toolchain:
+        spec_ok = False
+
+manifest_present = eff_manifest_file.is_file()
+loaded_pkgs = load_manifest_pkgs(eff_manifest_file) if manifest_present else {}
+if loaded_pkgs is None:
+    spec_ok = False
+    manifest_pkgs: dict[str, str] = {}
+else:
+    manifest_pkgs = loaded_pkgs
+
+git_heads: dict[str, str] = {}
+pkgs_dir = root / ".lake/packages"
+if pkgs_dir.is_dir():
+    for child in sorted(pkgs_dir.iterdir()):
+        if child.is_dir():
+            h = git_head(child)
+            if h:
+                git_heads[child.name] = h
+
+cslib_rev = manifest_pkgs.get("cslib") or (git_heads.get("cslib") if not manifest_present else "") or ""
+cslib_short = cslib_rev[:8] if cslib_rev else None
+
+other_manifest_pkgs = {k: v for k, v in manifest_pkgs.items() if k != "cslib"}
+other_git_heads = (
+    {k: v for k, v in git_heads.items() if k != "cslib"}
+    if not manifest_present
+    else {}
 )
 
+if cslib_short:
+    if not other_manifest_pkgs and not other_git_heads and toolchain is None:
+        base_pin_name = f"packages-cslib-{cslib_short}"
+    else:
+        pkg_items = manifest_pkgs if manifest_present else git_heads
+        state = {"packages": sorted(pkg_items.items()), "toolchain": toolchain}
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
+        base_pin_name = f"packages-cslib-{cslib_short}-{digest}"
+elif manifest_present or toolchain is not None or git_heads:
+    raw = eff_manifest_file.read_bytes() if manifest_present and eff_manifest_file.is_file() else b""
+    pkg_items = manifest_pkgs if manifest_present else git_heads
+    state_bytes = raw + b"\0" + json.dumps({"pkgs": sorted(pkg_items.items()), "tc": toolchain}, sort_keys=True).encode()
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(state_bytes).hexdigest()[:8]
+    base_pin_name = f"packages-manifest-{digest}"
+else:
+    base_pin_name = "packages-cslib-default"
+
+
+def pool_is_valid_and_hardened(cand: Path) -> bool:
+    if not spec_ok or not cand.is_dir():
+        return False
+    try:
+        cand_real = cand.resolve()
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    if in_primary_checkout(cand_real):
+        return False
+    prov_file = cand / ".pool-provenance.json"
+    if not prov_file.is_file() or prov_file.is_symlink():
+        return False
+    try:
+        prov = json.loads(prov_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return False
+    if not isinstance(prov, dict) or prov.get("schema") != 2 or prov.get("clean") is not True:
+        return False
+    if prov.get("manifest_present") != manifest_present:
+        return False
+    if prov.get("toolchain") != toolchain:
+        return False
+    cand_pkg_dirs = {d.name: d for d in cand.iterdir() if d.is_dir()}
+    if not cand_pkg_dirs:
+        return False
+    if manifest_present:
+        prov_pkgs = prov.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(prov_pkgs, dict):
+            return False
+        if set(prov_pkgs.keys()) != set(manifest_pkgs.keys()) or set(cand_pkg_dirs.keys()) != set(manifest_pkgs.keys()):
+            return False
+        for name, want_rev in manifest_pkgs.items():
+            rec_rev = prov_pkgs.get(name, "")
+            if not isinstance(rec_rev, str) or not revs_match(rec_rev, want_rev):
+                return False
+            actual_rev = git_head(cand_pkg_dirs[name])
+            if not actual_rev or not revs_match(actual_rev, want_rev):
+                return False
+    for pkg_dir in cand_pkg_dirs.values():
+        if not package_has_complete_build(pkg_dir):
+            return False
+    try:
+        if stat.S_IMODE(cand.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+            return False
+        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(cand_real, followlinks=False):
+            dp = Path(dirpath)
+            if stat.S_IMODE(dp.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+                return False
+            for name in list(dirnames) + list(filenames):
+                p = dp / name
+                if p.is_symlink():
+                    raw = Path(os.readlink(p))
+                    if raw.is_absolute():
+                        return False
+                    rel_parts = p.relative_to(cand_real).parts
+                    if len(rel_parts) < 2:
+                        return False
+                    pkg_root = (cand_real / rel_parts[0]).resolve()
+                    resolved = (p.parent / raw).resolve()
+                    if not resolved.exists() or not resolved.is_relative_to(pkg_root):
+                        return False
+                else:
+                    if stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode) & 0o222 != 0:
+                        return False
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def select_candidate_in_root(sroot: Path) -> Path:
+    c1 = sroot / base_pin_name
+    if not c1.exists() or pool_is_valid_and_hardened(c1):
+        return c1
+    return sroot / f"{base_pin_name}-v2"
+
+
+env_shared = os.environ.get("COMPLEXITYLIB_SHARED_PACKAGES_ROOT", "")
+if env_shared:
+    shared_root = Path(env_shared).resolve()
+    if in_primary_checkout(shared_root) or shared_root == worktrees_root:
+        print(
+            f"Refusing shared packages directory inside primary checkout: {env_shared}",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    print(select_candidate_in_root(shared_root))
+    raise SystemExit(0)
+
+shared_roots = []
+try:
+    wt_parent = wt_path.resolve().parent
+    if not in_primary_checkout(wt_parent) and wt_parent != worktrees_root:
+        shared_roots.append(wt_parent / ".shared")
+except OSError:
+    pass
+shared_roots.append(worktrees_root / ".shared")
+shared_roots.append(Path(f"{root}-wt") / ".shared")
+
+for sroot in shared_roots:
+    for cname in (base_pin_name, f"{base_pin_name}-v2"):
+        cand = sroot / cname
+        if cand.is_dir() and pool_is_valid_and_hardened(cand):
+            print(cand)
+            raise SystemExit(0)
+
+print(select_candidate_in_root(worktrees_root / ".shared"))
+PY
+}
+
+# check_worktree_safety <worktree_path> <expected_shared_pkg_dir>: refuse if the target worktree
+# is the primary checkout or contains symlinks pointing into the primary checkout or unexpected
+# external cache directories.
+check_worktree_safety() {
+  local wt_path="$1"
+  local expected_shared="$2"
+  python3 - "$ROOT" "$wt_path" "$expected_shared" <<'PY'
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+wt_raw = Path(sys.argv[2])
+expected_shared = Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve() if sys.argv[3] else None
+worktrees_root = (root / ".worktrees").resolve()
+
+
+def in_primary_checkout(p: Path) -> bool:
+    return p == root or (p.is_relative_to(root) and not p.is_relative_to(worktrees_root))
+
+
+if wt_raw.is_symlink():
+    target = wt_raw.resolve()
+    if in_primary_checkout(target):
+        print(
+            f"Refusing worktree symlink pointing into primary checkout: {wt_raw} -> {target}",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+wt_real = wt_raw.resolve()
+if in_primary_checkout(wt_real):
+    print(f"Refusing to seed or point at primary checkout: {wt_raw}", file=sys.stderr)
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+
+if expected_shared is not None and in_primary_checkout(expected_shared):
+    print(
+        f"Refusing shared packages directory inside primary checkout: {expected_shared}",
+        file=sys.stderr,
+    )
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+
+for rel in (".lake", ".lake/build", ".lake/config"):
+    cand = wt_raw / rel
+    if cand.is_symlink():
+        target = cand.resolve()
+        if in_primary_checkout(target):
+            print(
+                f"Refusing destination cache symlink pointing into primary checkout: {cand} -> {target}",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+        else:
+            print(f"Refusing to seed through destination cache symlink: {cand}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+pkg_link = wt_raw / ".lake/packages"
+if pkg_link.is_symlink():
+    target = pkg_link.resolve()
+    if in_primary_checkout(target):
+        print(
+            f"Refusing destination cache symlink pointing into primary checkout: {pkg_link} -> {target}",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    if expected_shared is None or target != expected_shared:
+        print(f"Refusing to seed through destination cache symlink: {pkg_link}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+elif pkg_link.is_dir():
+    for child in pkg_link.iterdir():
+        if child.is_symlink():
+            target = child.resolve()
+            if in_primary_checkout(target):
+                print(
+                    f"Refusing package symlink pointing into primary checkout: {child} -> {target}",
+                    file=sys.stderr,
+                )
+                raise SystemExit(1)
+            if expected_shared is None or target != (expected_shared / child.name).resolve():
+                print(
+                    f"Refusing to seed through destination cache symlink: {child}",
+                    file=sys.stderr,
+                )
+                raise SystemExit(1)
+PY
+}

+# root_packages_match_manifest <worktree_path> [provenance_out]: return 0 iff the target
+# manifest/toolchain and every package git checkout under $ROOT/.lake/packages are verifiable,
+# clean, and match; optionally write .pool-provenance.json to [provenance_out].
+root_packages_match_manifest() {
+  local wt_path="$1"
+  local prov_out="${2:-}"
+  python3 - "$ROOT" "$wt_path" "$prov_out" <<'PY'
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+wt_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
+prov_out = Path(sys.argv[3]) if sys.argv[3] else None
+
+
+def revs_match(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
+    n = min(len(a), len(b), 8)
+    return n > 0 and a[:n] == b[:n]
+
+
+def git_head(repo: Path) -> str | None:
+    if not (repo / ".git").exists():
+        return None
+    try:
+        rev = subprocess.check_output(
+            ["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"],
+            text=True,
+            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        ).strip()
+        return rev or None
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        return None
+
+
+def git_is_clean(repo: Path) -> bool:
+    try:
+        status = subprocess.check_output(
+            ["git", "-C", str(repo), "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"],
+            text=True,
+            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        ).strip()
+        return status == ""
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        return False
+
+
+def load_pkgs(path: Path) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return None
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            return None
+        pkgs = data.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(pkgs, list):
+            return None
+        out: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for pkg in pkgs:
+            if not isinstance(pkg, dict):
+                return None
+            name = pkg.get("name")
+            rev = pkg.get("rev")
+            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(rev, str) or not rev:
+                return None
+            out[name] = rev
+        return out
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+wt_tc = wt_path / "lean-toolchain"
+root_tc = root / "lean-toolchain"
+wt_manifest = wt_path / "lake-manifest.json"
+root_manifest = root / "lake-manifest.json"
+wt_has_own_metadata = (wt_path / ".git").exists() or wt_manifest.is_file() or wt_tc.is_file()
+
+if wt_has_own_metadata:
+    if wt_tc.is_file() != root_tc.is_file():
+        print(
+            "Root and worktree lean-toolchain presence do not match; skipping unverifiable package seed.",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    if wt_manifest.is_file() != root_manifest.is_file():
+        print(
+            "Root and worktree lake-manifest.json presence do not match; skipping unverifiable package seed.",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+if wt_tc.is_file() and root_tc.is_file():
+    wt_tc_val = wt_tc.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    root_tc_val = root_tc.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    if not wt_tc_val or wt_tc_val != root_tc_val:
+        print(
+            "Root lean-toolchain does not match worktree lean-toolchain; skipping mismatched package seed.",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    toolchain: str | None = wt_tc_val
+elif root_tc.is_file():
+    toolchain = root_tc.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() or None
+    if toolchain is None:
+        print("Root lean-toolchain is empty; skipping unverifiable package seed.", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+else:
+    toolchain = None
+
+eff_manifest = wt_manifest if wt_has_own_metadata else root_manifest
+manifest_present = eff_manifest.is_file()
+target_pkgs = load_pkgs(eff_manifest) if manifest_present else {}
+if target_pkgs is None or (root_manifest.is_file() and load_pkgs(root_manifest) is None):
+    print("Invalid lake-manifest.json; skipping unverifiable package seed.", file=sys.stderr)
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+
+pkgs_dir = root / ".lake/packages"
+verified_pkgs: dict[str, str] = {}
+
+if manifest_present:
+    if not pkgs_dir.is_dir() and target_pkgs:
+        print("Root .lake/packages is missing; skipping package seed.", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    for name, want_rev in target_pkgs.items():
+        pkg_dir = pkgs_dir / name
+        if not pkg_dir.is_dir():
+            print(
+                f"Root .lake/packages/{name} is missing; skipping incomplete package seed.",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        if not (pkg_dir / ".git").exists():
+            print(
+                f"Root .lake/packages/{name} has no .git metadata; skipping unverifiable package seed.",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        actual_rev = git_head(pkg_dir)
+        if not actual_rev:
+            print(
+                f"Root .lake/packages/{name} has invalid .git metadata; skipping unverifiable package seed.",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        if not revs_match(actual_rev, want_rev):
+            print(
+                f"Root .lake/packages/{name} ({actual_rev[:8]}) does not match manifest pin ({want_rev[:8]}); skipping mismatched package seed.",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        if not git_is_clean(pkg_dir):
+            print(
+                f"Root .lake/packages/{name} has uncommitted tracked changes; skipping dirty package seed.",
+                file=sys.stderr,
+            )
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        verified_pkgs[name] = actual_rev
+    if pkgs_dir.is_dir():
+        for child in pkgs_dir.iterdir():
+            if child.is_dir() and child.name not in target_pkgs:
+                print(
+                    f"Root .lake/packages/{child.name} is not listed in lake-manifest.json; skipping package seed.",
+                    file=sys.stderr,
+                )
+                raise SystemExit(1)
+else:
+    if pkgs_dir.is_dir():
+        for child in sorted(pkgs_dir.iterdir()):
+            if child.is_dir() and (child / ".git").exists():
+                actual_rev = git_head(child)
+                if not actual_rev or not git_is_clean(child):
+                    print(
+                        f"Root .lake/packages/{child.name} has invalid or dirty .git state; skipping package seed.",
+                        file=sys.stderr,
+                    )
+                    raise SystemExit(1)
+                verified_pkgs[child.name] = actual_rev
+
+if prov_out is not None:
+    prov_data = {
+        "schema": 2,
+        "clean": True,
+        "manifest_present": manifest_present,
+        "packages": verified_pkgs,
+        "toolchain": toolchain,
+    }
+    prov_out.write_text(json.dumps(prov_data, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+PY
+}

+# root_packages_have_complete_builds: return 0 iff every package under $ROOT/.lake/packages has a

+/-!
+# ETH Hardness of Partial-Function MCSP (`PartialMCSP`)
+
+This module formalizes Rahul Ilango's ETH lower bound for partial-function Minimum Circuit Size
+Problem (`MCSP*` / `PartialMCSP`) [Ilango2020FOCS, Theorem I.3, pp. 424, 427–428; ECCC TR20-183,
+Section 1.2.2, Theorem 3, p. 6, and Section 3, Theorem 11 (p. 20) & Lemma 12 (p. 22),
+construction and proof pp. 21–26]: under the Exponential Time Hypothesis (`ETH`), `PartialMCSP` on
+partial Boolean functions of arity $m$ (truth-table size $N = 2^m$) is not decidable in
+subexponential time $2^{o(m \log m)} = N^{o(\log \log N)}$ (`¬DecidableInSubexpTime`).
+
+## Overview of the reduction and faithfulness
+
+1. **Source problem** (`BipartitePermutationIndependentSet`):
+   Given an instance $G = (n, E)$ of `$2n \times 2n$ Bipartite Permutation Independent Set` with
+   parameter $n$ and directed pair-edges $E \subseteq ([n] \times [n])^2$, decide whether there
+   exist permutations $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 \in S_n$ (equivalently, a block-preserving permutation
+   $\pi \in S_{2n}$ on $[0, n) \cup [n, 2n)$) avoiding all conflict edges in $E$. By the
+   Lokshtanov–Marx–Saurabh theorem
+   (`ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_BipartitePermutationIndependentSet`,
+   [LokshtanovMarxSaurabh2018, Theorem 2.11]; [Ilango2020FOCS, Section III.B, p. 427; ECCC
+   TR20-183, Section 3, Theorem 10, p. 20]), this problem cannot be decided in time
+   $2^{o(n \log n)}$ under `ETH`.
+
+2. **Ilango's partial Boolean function $\gamma_G$** (`PartialMCSP.ilangoGamma`,
+   [Ilango2020FOCS, Section III.B, p. 428; ECCC TR20-183, Section 3, p. 21]):
+   For $n = G.1$, $\gamma_G : \{0, 1\}^{6n} \to \mathrm{Option\ Bool}$ views a $6n$-bit input as a
+   triple $(x, y, z) \in \{0, 1\}^{2n} \times \{0, 1\}^{2n} \times \{0, 1\}^{2n}$ and is defined by
+   seven clauses:
+   * (1) If $x = 0^{2n}$: $\bigvee_{i \in [2n]} (y_i \wedge z_i)$.
+   * (2) If $x = 1^{2n}$: $\bigvee_{i \in [2n]} z_i$.
+   * (3) If $z = 1^{2n}$: $\bigvee_{i \in [2n]} (x_i \vee y_i)$.
+   * (4) If $z = 0^{2n}$: $0$ (`false`).
+   * (5) If $z = 1^n 0^n$ and $y = 0^{2n}$: $\bigvee_{i < n} x_i$.
+   * (6) If $z = 0^n 1^n$ and $y = 0^{2n}$: $\bigvee_{n \le i < 2n} x_i$.
+   * (7) If $\exists ((j, k), (j', k')) \in E$ with $(x, y, z) = (\overline{e_k}\,\overline{e_{k'}},
+     0^{2n}, e_j\,e_{j'})$: $1$ (`true`).
+   * Otherwise: $?$ (`none`).
+
+3. **Rigidity of read-once formulas for Clauses 1–4**
+   (`PosFormula.exists_perm_of_agreesWith_ilango`,
+   [ECCC TR20-183, Section 3, Lemma 12, pp. 22, 24–26]):
+   Any read-once positive formula $F$ on $6n$ variables ($n \ge 1$) of leaf size $6n$ (i.e., binary
+   gate size $6n - 1$) that agrees with Clauses (1)–(4) computes
+   $(x, y, z) \mapsto \bigvee_{i \in [2n]} ((x_{\pi(i)} \vee y_i) \wedge z_i)$ for some permutation
+   $\pi \in S_{2n}$.
+
+4. **Equivalence across circuit and formula models** (Issue #798 Decision D5,
+   [ECCC TR20-183, Section 3, Theorem 11, p. 20, construction and proof pp. 21–24]):
+   For $n \ge 2$, the instance `ilangoInstance G` of arity $6n$ and threshold $s = 6n - 1$ has all
+   $6n$ variables positively essential (`ilangoInstance_posEssential`). By
+   `Circuit.exists_posFormula_of_cost_binaryCost_le`, any circuit $c$ with at most $6n - 1$ binary
+   (`AND`/`OR`) gates agreeing with $\gamma_G$ unfolds into a read-once positive formula of size
+   $6n - 1$. Conversely, any satisfying permutation $\pi \in S_{2n}$ yields an explicit read-once
+   positive formula $\bigvee_{i \in [2n]} ((x_{\pi(i)} \vee y_i) \wedge z_i)$ of gate size $6n - 1$
+   whose compiled circuit has all-gates size $6n - 1$. Thus for $n \ge 2$:
+   $$G \in \mathrm{BipartitePermutationIndependentSet}
+     \iff \mathrm{ilangoInstance}\, G \in \mathrm{PartialMCSP}
+     \iff \mathrm{ilangoInstance}\, G \in \mathrm{PartialMCSP.BinaryGate}
+     \iff \mathrm{ilangoInstance}\, G \in \mathrm{PartialMCSP.MonotoneReadOnce}.$$
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.PartialMCSP.MonotoneReadOnce`, `Cslib.PartialMonotoneReadOnceMCSP`: partial-function MCSP
+  restricted to read-once positive formulas.
+* `Cslib.PartialMCSP.ilangoGamma`, `Cslib.PartialMCSP.ilangoInstance`: Ilango's partial Boolean
+  function $\gamma_G$ on $6n$ bits and the `PartialMCSP` instance $(\gamma_G, 6n - 1)$.
+* `Cslib.PartialMCSP.ilangoReduction`: total reduction from `BipartitePermutationGraph` to
+  `PartialMCSP` running in time $2^{O(n)} \cdot \mathrm{poly}(|G|)$.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.PosFormula.exists_perm_of_agreesWith_ilango`: Ilango's Lemma 12
+  [ECCC TR20-183, Section 3, Lemma 12, pp. 22, 24–26].
+* `Cslib.PartialMCSP.mem_BipartitePermutationIndependentSet_iff_ilangoInstance_mem`: correctness of
+  `ilangoInstance` for $2 \le G.1$ across `PartialMCSP`, `PartialMCSP.BinaryGate`, and
+  `PartialMCSP.MonotoneReadOnce` [ECCC TR20-183, Section 3, Theorem 11, p. 20, proof pp. 21–24].

+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMCSP_encBinary`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMCSP_binaryGate`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMCSP_binaryGate_encBinary`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMonotoneReadOnceMCSP`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMonotoneReadOnceMCSP_encBinary`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMCSP_tableSize`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.ETH.not_decidableInSubexpTime_PartialMCSP_tableSize_encBinary`: Ilango's FOCS
+  2020 Theorem I.3 / ECCC TR20-183 Section 1.2.2 Theorem 3 (under `ETH`, `PartialMCSP` and its
+  binary-gate and monotone-read-once variants reject the subexponential decider family
+  `DecidableInSubexpTime` at $m \log_2 m = \log_2 N \cdot \log_2 \log_2 N$, i.e., are not decidable
+  in time $2^{o(m \log m)} = N^{o(\log \log N)}$).
+
+## References
+
+* [R. Ilango, *Constant Depth Formula and Partial Function Versions of MCSP are
+  Hard*][Ilango2020FOCS]
+* [D. Lokshtanov, D. Marx, S. Saurabh, *Slightly Superexponential Parameterized
+  Problems*][LokshtanovMarxSaurabh2018]
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib
+
+open Circuits Circuits.Boolean Complexity Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+namespace PartialMCSP
+
+/-! ### Read-once monotone formula variant of `PartialMCSP` -/
+
+/-- **Read-once positive formula variant of `PartialMCSP`** [Ilango2020FOCS, Section III.B; ECCC
+TR20-183, Section 3, Theorem 11, p. 20]: instances `x : PartialMCSP.Instance` that agree with some
+read-once positive Boolean formula `F : PosFormula x.arity` with at most `x.threshold` binary
+gates. -/
+def MonotoneReadOnce : Set Instance :=
+  {x | ∃ F : PosFormula x.arity, F.IsReadOnce ∧ F.size ≤ x.threshold ∧ x.AgreesWith F.eval}
+
+/-- Top-level alias for `PartialMCSP.MonotoneReadOnce`. -/
+abbrev _root_.Cslib.PartialMonotoneReadOnceMCSP : Set Instance :=

+
+src_root = pathlib.Path(os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]))
+dst_root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
+
+def is_within(child: pathlib.Path, parent: pathlib.Path) -> bool:
+    try:
+        child.relative_to(parent)
+        return True
+    except ValueError:

body: [P2] This makes every `scripts/check.sh --quick` invocation fall back to all six gates. `quick_check.source_modules` allows only `name`, `srcDir`, `leanOptions` and `allowNonModules`, so this standard `roots`/`globs` configuration always raises `FullCheck("custom Lake library roots/globs/options need full checks")`; it would then also require the deleted aggregator. I reproduced this against the exact tree. Please teach the planner this specific known layout and add a regression using a normal changed library/test module, while retaining full-check fallback for unsupported configurations. Otherwise the existing quick-check feature becomes unavailable for every future edit.

body: [P1] The pinned [Definition 2.5, p.8](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2009.11514v1#page=9) uses the symmetric event `|H(x) - f(x)| ≤ g(n)`. This definition uses `f(x)-g(n) ≤ v ∧ v ≤ f(x)`, so it rejects every overestimate. For example, f=0, H=1, g=1 is successful under the source event and unsuccessful here. Please make the canonical PPT approximation notion symmetric (e.g. `Nat.dist v (f x) ≤ g n`) and derive the advertised theorem for it. The one-sided form can remain a clearly named helper: shifting a symmetric estimator down by g converts a g-error into a one-sided 2g-error when the shift is efficiently computable. Account for the rounded-log convention too. A docstring note alone does not supply this missing bridge.

+        linarith [htwo_pow]
+      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (U x).toReal < (p x).toReal),
+            2 * ((p x).toReal - (U x).toReal) := by
+        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hS₂_sub fun x hx _ => ?_
+        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
+        linarith
+  have hpart : (∑ x ∈ S₁, (p x).toReal) + ∑ x ∈ S₂, (p x).toReal = 1 := by
+    have hcompl : S₂ = S₁ᶜ := by
+      ext x
+      simp [S₁, S₂, not_le]
+    rw [hcompl, Finset.sum_add_sum_compl, sum_toReal]
+  have hS₁_mass : 1 - 2 * dist p U ≤ ∑ x ∈ S₁, (p x).toReal := by linarith
+  have hsurp (x : BitString n) (hx : x ∈ S₁) :
+      (p x).toReal * ((n : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (p x).toReal * surprisal p x := by
+    by_cases hp0 : (p x).toReal = 0
+    · simp [hp0]
+    · have hpos : 0 < (p x).toReal :=
+        lt_of_le_of_ne ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (Ne.symm hp0)
+      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hpos.le
+      simp only [S₁, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
+      rw [surprisal, le_neg]
+      exact (Real.logb_le_iff_le_rpow (by norm_num) hpos).mpr hx
+  have hn_real : 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
+  rw [entropy_eq_sum_surprisal]
+  calc
+    ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (1 - 2 * dist p U)
+      ≤ ((n : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ x ∈ S₁, (p x).toReal :=
+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS₁_mass (by linarith)
+    _ = ∑ x ∈ S₁, (p x).toReal * ((n : ℝ) - 1) := by
+        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => mul_comm _ _
+    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ S₁, (p x).toReal * surprisal p x :=
+        Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => hsurp x hx
+    _ ≤ ∑ x, (p x).toReal * surprisal p x :=
+        Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg fun x =>
+          mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (surprisal_nonneg p x)
+
+/-- **[Liu and Pass, Lemma 2.2, §2.5, p. 9 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]: Statistical
+distance to uniform bounds Shannon entropy from below.**
+If $n \ge 4$ (and in fact for any $n$) and $\mathsf{SD}(p, U_n) \le 1 / n^2$, then
+$H(p) \ge n - 2$. -/
+theorem entropy_ge_of_dist_uniform_le {n : ℕ} (p : PMF (BitString n))
+    (hdist : dist p (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n)) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :
+    (n : ℝ) - 2 ≤ entropy p := by
+  rcases le_or_gt n 1 with hn1 | hn1
+  · have hent : 0 ≤ entropy p := entropy_nonneg p
+    have hn_le : (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn1
+    linarith
+  have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < n)
+  have h1 := entropy_ge_of_dist_uniform hn1.le p
+  have hn_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
+    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
+    linarith
+  have h2 : ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (1 - 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) ≤
+      ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (1 - 2 * dist p (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n))) := by
+    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by linarith)
+    linarith
+  have h3 : (n : ℝ) - 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (1 - 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
+    have hsq : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hn_pos
+    have hquad : 2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
+      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((n : ℝ) - 1)]
+    have hdiv : 2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
+      rw [mul_one_div]
+      exact (div_le_one hsq).mpr hquad
+    linarith
+  linarith
+
+/-- **[Liu and Pass, Proof of Theorem 5.2, Claim 2, §5.2, p. 12 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]:
+High Shannon entropy implies non-negligible mass on low-probability outcomes.**
+For any distribution $p$ on `BitString m` with $m \ge 1$ and $B \ge 3$ such that $H(p) \ge B$,
+the set of outcomes $y$ with point mass $p(y) \le 2^{-(B - 3)}$ has total probability at least
+$1 / m$. -/
+theorem sum_filter_mass_le_ge_of_entropy_ge {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (p : PMF (BitString m))
+    {B : ℝ} (hB : 3 ≤ B) (hent : B ≤ entropy p) :
+    1 / (m : ℝ) ≤
+      ∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y => (p y).toReal ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(B - 3))), (p y).toReal := by
+  classical
+  let S : Finset (BitString m) :=
+    Finset.univ.filter fun y => (p y).toReal ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(B - 3))
+  let q : ℝ := ∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal
+  change 1 / (m : ℝ) ≤ q
+  have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
+  -- Bound the contribution outside S: every y ∉ S has surprisal p y ≤ B - 3
+  have hout : ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y ≤ B - 3 := by
+    have hterm (y : BitString m) (hy : y ∈ Sᶜ) :
+        (p y).toReal * surprisal p y ≤ (p y).toReal * (B - 3) := by
+      simp only [S, Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_le] at hy
+      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (surprisal_le_of_mass_ge p y hy.le) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
+    calc
+      ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y
+        ≤ ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal * (B - 3) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
+      _ = (∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal) * (B - 3) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
+      _ ≤ 1 * (B - 3) := by
+        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by linarith)
+        calc
+          ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal ≤ ∑ y : BitString m, (p y).toReal :=
+            Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
+          _ = 1 := sum_toReal p
+      _ = B - 3 := one_mul _
+  -- Bound the contribution inside S by q * m + 2
+  have hin : ∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y ≤ q * (m : ℝ) + 2 := by
+    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
+    · have hall0 : ∀ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal = 0 :=
+        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun _ _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mp hq0
+      have hsum0 : ∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y = 0 :=
+        Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy => by simp [hall0 y hy]
+      rw [hsum0, hq0]
+      linarith
+    · have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
+      have hq_pos : 0 < q := lt_of_le_of_ne hq_nonneg (Ne.symm hq0)
+      have hex : ∃ y ∈ (S : Set (BitString m)), y ∈ p.support := by
+        by_contra! hno
+        have hzero : q = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy => by
+          have := hno y hy
+          rw [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] at this
+          simp [this]
+        exact hq0 hzero
+      let pS := p.filter (S : Set (BitString m)) hex
+      have hmeas : (p.toOuterMeasure (S : Set (BitString m))).toReal = q := by
+        rw [toOuterMeasure_apply_toReal]
+        simp [q]
+      have hent_pS : entropy pS ≤ m := by
+        have hcard := entropy_le_log_card pS
+        rwa [show Fintype.card (BitString m) = 2 ^ m by simp, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat,
+          Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num), mul_one] at hcard
+      have hident : ∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y =
+          q * entropy pS + q * (-Real.logb 2 q) := by
+        rw [entropy_eq_sum_surprisal pS, Finset.mul_sum]
+        have hcompl0 : ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, q * ((pS y).toReal * surprisal pS y) = 0 := by
+          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy => ?_
+          simp only [Finset.mem_compl] at hy
+          have hpSy : (pS y).toReal = 0 := by
+            simp [pS, hy]
+          simp [hpSy]
+        have hq_sum : q * (-Real.logb 2 q) = ∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal * (-Real.logb 2 q) :=
+          Finset.sum_mul S (fun y => (p y).toReal) (-Real.logb 2 q)
+        rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S, hcompl0, add_zero, hq_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y hy => ?_
+        by_cases hpy0 : (p y).toReal = 0
+        · have hpSy : (pS y).toReal = 0 := by
+            simp [pS, hy, hpy0]
+          simp [hpy0, hpSy]
+        · have hpy_pos : 0 < (p y).toReal :=
+            lt_of_le_of_ne ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (Ne.symm hpy0)
+          have hpSy : (pS y).toReal = (p y).toReal / q := by
+            dsimp [pS]
+            rw [filter_apply_toReal, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hy), hmeas]
+          have hq_mul : q * (pS y).toReal = (p y).toReal := by
+            rw [hpSy, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq_pos.ne']
+          rw [← mul_assoc, hq_mul]
+          simp only [surprisal, hpSy, Real.logb_div hpy_pos.ne' hq_pos.ne']
+          ring
+      have hq_log := mul_neg_logb_two_le_two hq_pos
+      have hq_ent : q * entropy pS ≤ q * (m : ℝ) :=
+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hent_pS hq_pos.le
+      linarith
+  have htotal : entropy p =
+      (∑ y ∈ S, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y) + ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, (p y).toReal * surprisal p y := by
+    rw [entropy_eq_sum_surprisal, ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S]
+  have h1 : 1 ≤ q * (m : ℝ) := by linarith
+  exact (div_le_iff₀ hm_pos).mpr (by linarith)
+
+/-- Truncating an `m`-bit distribution to its first `k ≤ m` bits decreases Shannon entropy by at
+most `m - k` bits. -/
+theorem entropy_ofList_take_ge {m k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) (p : PMF (BitString m)) :
+    entropy p - ((m - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
+      entropy (p.map fun x => BitString.ofList k ((List.ofFn x).take k)) := by
+  let split (x : BitString m) : BitString k × BitString (m - k) :=
+    (BitString.ofList k ((List.ofFn x).take k),
+      BitString.ofList (m - k) ((List.ofFn x).drop k))
+  have hinj : Function.Injective split := by
+    intro x y hxy
+    have h1 := congrArg (List.ofFn ∘ Prod.fst) hxy
+    have h2 := congrArg (List.ofFn ∘ Prod.snd) hxy
+    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, split] at h1 h2
+    rw [BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp [hk]), BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp [hk])] at h1
+    rw [BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp), BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp)] at h2
+    apply List.ofFn_inj.mp
+    rw [← List.take_append_drop k (List.ofFn x), ← List.take_append_drop k (List.ofFn y), h1, h2]
+  have hjoint : entropy (p.map split) = entropy p := entropy_map_of_injective p hinj
+  have hfst : (p.map split).map Prod.fst =
+      p.map fun x => BitString.ofList k ((List.ofFn x).take k) := by
+    rw [PMF.map_comp]
+    rfl
+  have hcond := conditionalEntropy_le_log_card (p.map split)
+  rw [conditionalEntropy, hjoint, hfst,
+    show Fintype.card (BitString (m - k)) = 2 ^ (m - k) by simp,
+    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num),
+    mul_one] at hcond
+  linarith
+
+/-- Appending `k` independent uniform bits to an `m`-bit distribution increases Shannon entropy
+by exactly `k` bits. -/
+theorem entropy_append_uniform {m k : ℕ} (p : PMF (BitString m)) :
+    entropy (p.bind fun x => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString k)).map fun z =>
+      BitString.ofList (m + k) (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn z)) =
+      entropy p + (k : ℝ) := by
+  let join (xz : BitString m × BitString k) : BitString (m + k) :=
+    BitString.ofList (m + k) (List.ofFn xz.1 ++ List.ofFn xz.2)
+  have hinj : Function.Injective join := by
+    rintro ⟨x₁, z₁⟩ ⟨x₂, z₂⟩ hxy
+    have h := congrArg List.ofFn hxy
+    dsimp only [join] at h
+    rw [BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp), BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp)] at h
+    obtain ⟨hx, hz⟩ := List.append_inj h (by simp)
+    exact Prod.ext (List.ofFn_inj.mp hx) (List.ofFn_inj.mp hz)
+  have hmap : (p.bind fun x => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString k)).map (x, ·)).map join =
+      p.bind fun x => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString k)).map fun z =>
+        BitString.ofList (m + k) (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn z) := by
+    simp only [PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, join]
+  rw [← hmap, entropy_map_of_injective _ hinj, entropy_prod, entropy_uniform,
+    show Fintype.card (BitString k) = 2 ^ k by simp,
+    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num), mul_one]
+
+end Cslib.Probability.PMF
+
+namespace Cslib.Kolmogorov
+
+open Filter Cslib.Probability Cslib.Probability.PMF Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! ### Average-case hardness definitions
+([Liu and Pass, Definitions 2.4 and 2.5, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]) -/
+
+/-- **[Liu and Pass, Definition 2.4, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]:
+Mildly hard on average (`MildlyHardOnAverage`).**
+A function $f : \{0, 1\}^* \to \mathbb{N}$ is mildly hard on average if there exists a positive
+polynomial $p$ such that for every uniform strict PPT heuristic
+$\mathcal{H} : \{0, 1\}^* \to \mathrm{ProbComp}\ \mathbb{N}$, for all sufficiently large
+$n \in \mathbb{N}$,
+$$\Pr_{x \leftarrow \{0, 1\}^n, v \leftarrow \mathcal{H}(x)}[v = f(x)] \le 1 - \frac{1}{p(n)}.$$ -/
+def MildlyHardOnAverage (f : List Bool → ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, (∀ n, 0 < p.eval n) ∧
+    ∀ H : List Bool → ProbComp ℕ, IsPPTOn encBits encNat H →
+      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
+        (((BitString.uniformList n).bind fun x =>
+          (ProbComp.eval (H x)).map fun v => decide (v = f x)) true).toReal ≤
+          1 - 1 / ((p.eval n : ℕ) : ℝ)
+
+/-- **[Liu and Pass, Definition 2.5, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]:
+Mildly hard on average to $g$-approximate (`MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox`).**
+A function $f : \{0, 1\}^* \to \mathbb{N}$ is mildly hard on average to $g$-approximate if there
+exists a positive polynomial $p$ such that for every uniform strict PPT heuristic
+$\mathcal{H} : \{0, 1\}^* \to \mathrm{ProbComp}\ \mathbb{N}$, for all sufficiently large
+$n \in \mathbb{N}$,
+$$\Pr_{x \leftarrow \{0, 1\}^n, v \leftarrow \mathcal{H}(x)}[f(x) - g(n) \le v \le f(x)]
+  \le 1 - \frac{1}{p(n)}.$$
+When instantiating Theorems 3.1 and 5.2 for natural-number-valued $K^t$, we take the integer
+window $g(n) = d \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor$ (`d * Nat.log 2 n`), which is slightly smaller than
+the real-valued $d \log_2 n$ in the paper. -/
+def MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox (g : ℕ → ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℕ) : Prop :=

+# Average-case hardness of time-bounded Kolmogorov complexity (`K^t`)
+
+This module formalizes the average-case hardness notions and information-theoretic building blocks
+from [Y. Liu and R. Pass, *On One-Way Functions and Kolmogorov Complexity*][LiuPass2020]. All
+section, definition, theorem, lemma, and page locators follow the full version
+`arXiv:2009.11514v1` (and ECCC TR20-052), in which `Theorem`/`Definition` share one section
+counter while `Lemma`/`Fact` share a separate section counter.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverage`: mild average-case hardness of exact computation for
+  `List Bool → ℕ` against uniform strict PPT heuristics
+  ([Liu and Pass, Definition 2.4, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox`: mild average-case hardness of $g(n)$-approximation
+  for `List Bool → ℕ` against uniform strict PPT heuristics
+  ([Liu and Pass, Definition 2.5, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageDet`, `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageToApproxDet`:
+  library specializations of `MildlyHardOnAverage` and `MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox` to
+  deterministic polynomial-time heuristics.
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageIO`, `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageToApproxIO`:
+  library infinitely-often (`∃ᶠ n in atTop`) companions.
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageENat`, `Cslib.Kolmogorov.MildlyHardOnAverageIOENat`:
+  library `ℕ∞`-valued companions for `List Bool → ℕ∞` (such as `timeBounded t`).
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Probability.PMF.entropy_ge_of_dist_uniform_le`: if $X$ is a distribution on
+  $\{0, 1\}^n$ with $\mathsf{SD}(X, U_n) \le 1 / n^2$, then $H(X) \ge n - 2$
+  ([Liu and Pass, Lemma 2.2, §2.5, p. 9 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Probability.PMF.sum_filter_mass_le_ge_of_entropy_ge`: if $Y$ is a distribution on
+  $\{0, 1\}^m$ ($m \ge 1$) with $H(Y) \ge B \ge 3$, then the set of outcomes with point mass at
+  most $2^{-(B - 3)}$ has total probability at least $1 / m$
+  ([Liu and Pass, Proof of Theorem 5.2, Claim 2, §5.2, p. 12 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.exists_timeBounded_generator_le`: for any length-nondecreasing
+  polynomial-time generator $G : \{0, 1\}^* \to \{0, 1\}^*$, there exist a polynomial $p_G$ and a
+  constant $c$ such that for all $t \ge p_G$ and all $z$, $K^t(G(z)) \le |z| + c$
+  ([Liu and Pass, Proof of Theorem 5.2, Equation (3), §5.2, pp. 11–12 of
+  arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Kolmogorov.sum_uniform_timeBoundedNat_lt_le`: counting bound on the fraction of $n$-bit
+  strings with $K^t(x) < n - k$
+  ([Liu and Pass, Proof of Theorem 5.2, Equation (2), §5.2, p. 11 of
+  arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+
+## References
+
+* [Y. Liu, R. Pass, *On One-way Functions and Kolmogorov Complexity*][LiuPass2020],
+  full version `arXiv:2009.11514v1` (Sections 2.3, 2.5, and 5.2).
+-/

+/-- Auxiliary bound: for any $q \in (0, 1]$, $-q \log_2 q \le 2$. -/
+private theorem mul_neg_logb_two_le_two {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) :
+    q * (-Real.logb 2 q) ≤ 2 := by
+  have hlog_half := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
+  rw [one_div, Real.log_inv] at hlog_half
+  have hlog2 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith
+  have hlog_inv : Real.log (1 / q) ≤ 1 / q - 1 :=
+    Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hq0)
+  have hq_log : q * (-Real.log q) ≤ 1 - q := by
+    have h1 : -Real.log q = Real.log (1 / q) := by
+      rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
+    rw [h1]
+    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_inv hq0.le
+    rwa [mul_sub, mul_one_div_cancel hq0.ne', mul_one] at hmul
+  rw [Real.logb, ← neg_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
+  have hnum : q * -Real.log q ≤ 1 := by linarith
+  calc
+    (q * -Real.log q) / Real.log 2 ≤ 1 / Real.log 2 :=
+      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (by linarith)

+/-!
+# Yao's Weak-to-Strong One-Way Function Hardness Amplification
+
+This module formalizes Yao's hardness amplification theorem ([Yao1982];
+[Goldreich, Vol. 1, §2.3, Theorem 2.3.2][Goldreich2001];
+[Liu and Pass, Theorem 2.3, §2.1, p. 7 of `arXiv:2009.11514v1`][LiuPass2020]):
+if there exists a weak one-way function (`WeakOneWay`), then there exists a strong one-way
+function (`OneWay`).
+
+## Construction Overview
+
+1. **Output-length normalization:** Given `hf : WeakOneWay f`, apply
+   `WeakOneWay.exists_fixedOutputLength` and `WeakOneWay.exists_monotone_poly` to obtain a weak
+   one-way function $g$ with a polynomial-time unary output-length schedule `outLen : ℕ → ℕ`
+   (`∀ x, (g x).length = outLen x.length`) and a monotone polynomial $q : \mathbb{N}[X]$
+   ($q(N) \ge N + 1$) such that `WeakOneWayAt g (fun N => 1 / (q.eval N : ℝ))`.
+2. **Parallel direct product on schedule $m(n)$:** At parameter $n \in \mathbb{N}$, set block width
+   $w(n) := n + 1$, block count $k(n) := 2 \cdot q(w(n)) \cdot w(n)$, and input length
+   $m(n) := k(n) \cdot w(n)$. On an input $X \in \{0, 1\}^{m(n)}$, `parallelCore k w g n X` splits
+   $X$ into $k(n)$ blocks $x_0, \dots, x_{k(n)-1} \in \{0, 1\}^{w(n)}$ via `BitString.listRow` and
+   concatenates $g(x_0) \mathbin{\Vert} \dots \mathbin{\Vert} g(x_{k(n)-1})$.
+3. **Direct reduction and probability bound:** For any uniform strict PPT inverter $\mathcal{A}$
+   against `familyInversionGame m (parallelCore k w g)` and any target polynomial degree
+   $d \in \mathbb{N}$, running $t_d(n) := 4 \cdot q(w(n)) \cdot k(n) \cdot p_d(n)$ independent
+   planted-slot trials (where $p_d(n) = (n + 1)^{d + 1}$) defines a uniform strict PPT inverter
+   $B_d$ against $g$. Using `BitString.uniformList_all_listRow_true` twice—once across the $k(n)$
+   input blocks of $X$ and once across the $t_d(n)$ independent seed blocks of $B_d$—together with
+   the exact single-slot planting law `uniformList_replaceRow`, the weak one-wayness bound on $g$
+   forces $\mathcal{A}$'s inversion probability at parameter $n$ to be at most
+   $(1/2)^{n+1} + \frac{1}{2 p_d(n)} \le \frac{1}{p_d(n)}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
+4. **Length-universal extension:** Applying `OneWayReindex.oneWay` to the strictly increasing
+   schedule $m(n)$ extends `parallelCore k w g` to a single strong one-way function on all binary
+   strings.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.parallelCore`: evaluate $f$ in parallel on $k(n)$ blocks of
+  width $w(n)$ and concatenate the outputs.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.replaceRow`: replace block $j$ of a flat bit string with $x$.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.plantedImage`: form the $k(n)$-block parallel output with a
+  challenge $y$ planted in slot $j$.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.familyInversionGame_parallelCore_negligible`: any uniform strict
+  PPT adversary has negligible inversion probability against `parallelCore` on schedule
+  $m(n) = 2 q(n+1) (n+1)^2$.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.WeakOneWay.exists_oneWay`: every weak one-way function yields a strong one-way
+  function ([Liu and Pass, Theorem 2.3, §2.1, p. 7 of `arXiv:2009.11514v1`][LiuPass2020];
+  [Yao1982]).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.exists_oneWay_of_exists_weakOneWay`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.exists_oneWay_iff_exists_weakOneWay`: existential and equivalence forms of
+  Theorem 2.3.
+
+## References
+
+* [Y. Liu and R. Pass, *On One-Way Functions and Kolmogorov Complexity*][LiuPass2020],
+  full version `arXiv:2009.11514v1` (Section 2.1, Theorem 2.3, p. 7).
+* [A. C. Yao, *Theory and Application of Trapdoor Functions*][Yao1982].
+* [O. Goldreich, *Foundations of Cryptography, Volume 1*][Goldreich2001],
+  Section 2.3, Theorem 2.3.2.
+-/

+
+namespace OneWayAmplification

+/-! ### Elementary real-algebra bounds for geometric amplification -/

+private theorem pow_one_sub_mul_one_add_le_one {α : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ α) (h1 : α ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
+    (1 - α) ^ m * (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) ≤ 1 := by
+  induction m with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ m ih =>
+    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - α) ^ m := pow_nonneg (by linarith) m
+    have hstep : (1 - α) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α) ≤ 1 + (m : ℝ) * α := by
+      push_cast
+      have hsq : 0 ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (α * α) := by positivity
+      nlinarith
+    calc (1 - α) ^ (m + 1) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α)
+      _ = (1 - α) ^ m * ((1 - α) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α)) := by ring
+      _ ≤ (1 - α) ^ m * (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hnonneg
+      _ ≤ 1 := ih
+

+    (1 - α) ^ m ≤ 1 / (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) := by
+  have hpos : 0 < 1 + (m : ℝ) * α := by positivity
+  exact (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr (pow_one_sub_mul_one_add_le_one h0 h1 m)

+    (1 - 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ (2 * q * r) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ r := by
+  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
+  have hα0 : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by positivity
+  have hα1 : 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
+    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
+    linarith
+  have hbase : (1 - 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ (2 * q) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
+    have h := pow_one_sub_le_inv_one_add hα0 hα1 (2 * q)
+    have hmul : ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) = 1 := by
+      push_cast
+      field_simp
+    rw [hmul] at h
+    linarith
+  rw [pow_mul]
+  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hbase r

+    (1 - 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ^ (4 * q * m) ≤ 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
+  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
+  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
+  have hα0 : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) := by positivity
+  have hα1 : 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
+    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
+    linarith
+  have h := pow_one_sub_le_inv_one_add hα0 hα1 (4 * q * m)
+  have hmul : ((4 * q * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
+    push_cast
+    field_simp
+    ring
+  rw [hmul] at h
+  refine h.trans ?_
+  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)

+    · simp [← hE, hB]

+private theorem pmf_bind_true_le_of_le {α : Type*} (μ : PMF α) (r : α → PMF Bool)
+    {c : ENNReal} (h : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, (r x) true ≤ c) :
+    (μ.bind r) true ≤ c := by
+  rw [PMF.bind_apply]
+  calc ∑' x, μ x * (r x) true

+    _ = c := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]
+

+      f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X) := by

+/-!
+# Yao's Weak-to-Strong One-Way Function Hardness Amplification
+
+This module formalizes Yao's hardness amplification theorem ([Yao1982];
+[Goldreich, Vol. 1, §2.3, Theorem 2.3.2][Goldreich2001];
+[Liu and Pass, Theorem 2.3, §2.1, p. 7 of `arXiv:2009.11514v1`][LiuPass2020]):
+if there exists a weak one-way function (`WeakOneWay`), then there exists a strong one-way
+function (`OneWay`).
+
+## Construction Overview
+
+1. **Output-length normalization:** Given `hf : WeakOneWay f`, apply
+   `WeakOneWay.exists_fixedOutputLength` and `WeakOneWay.exists_monotone_poly` to obtain a weak
+   one-way function $g$ with a polynomial-time unary output-length schedule `outLen : ℕ → ℕ`
+   (`∀ x, (g x).length = outLen x.length`) and a monotone polynomial $q : \mathbb{N}[X]$
+   ($q(N) \ge N + 1$) such that `WeakOneWayAt g (fun N => 1 / (q.eval N : ℝ))`.
+2. **Parallel direct product on schedule $m(n)$:** At parameter $n \in \mathbb{N}$, set block width
+   $w(n) := n + 1$, block count $k(n) := 2 \cdot q(w(n)) \cdot w(n)$, and input length
+   $m(n) := k(n) \cdot w(n)$. On an input $X \in \{0, 1\}^{m(n)}$, `parallelCore k w g n X` splits
+   $X$ into $k(n)$ blocks $x_0, \dots, x_{k(n)-1} \in \{0, 1\}^{w(n)}$ via `BitString.listRow` and
+   concatenates $g(x_0) \mathbin{\Vert} \dots \mathbin{\Vert} g(x_{k(n)-1})$.
+3. **Direct reduction and probability bound:** For any uniform strict PPT inverter $\mathcal{A}$
+   against `familyInversionGame m (parallelCore k w g)` and any target polynomial degree
+   $d \in \mathbb{N}$, running $t_d(n) := 4 \cdot q(w(n)) \cdot k(n) \cdot p_d(n)$ independent
+   planted-slot trials (where $p_d(n) = (n + 1)^{d + 1}$) defines a uniform strict PPT inverter
+   $B_d$ against $g$. Using `BitString.uniformList_all_listRow_true` twice—once across the $k(n)$
+   input blocks of $X$ and once across the $t_d(n)$ independent seed blocks of $B_d$—together with
+   the exact single-slot planting law `uniformList_replaceRow`, the weak one-wayness bound on $g$
+   forces $\mathcal{A}$'s inversion probability at parameter $n$ to be at most
+   $(1/2)^{n+1} + \frac{1}{2 p_d(n)} \le \frac{1}{p_d(n)}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
+4. **Length-universal extension:** Applying `OneWayReindex.oneWay` to the strictly increasing
+   schedule $m(n)$ extends `parallelCore k w g` to a single strong one-way function on all binary
+   strings.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.parallelCore`: evaluate $f$ in parallel on $k(n)$ blocks of
+  width $w(n)$ and concatenate the outputs.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.replaceRow`: replace block $j$ of a flat bit string with $x$.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.plantedImage`: form the $k(n)$-block parallel output with a
+  challenge $y$ planted in slot $j$.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.OneWayAmplification.familyInversionGame_parallelCore_negligible`: any uniform strict
+  PPT adversary has negligible inversion probability against `parallelCore` on schedule
+  $m(n) = 2 q(n+1) (n+1)^2$.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.WeakOneWay.exists_oneWay`: every weak one-way function yields a strong one-way
+  function ([Liu and Pass, Theorem 2.3, §2.1, p. 7 of `arXiv:2009.11514v1`][LiuPass2020];
+  [Yao1982]).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.exists_oneWay_of_exists_weakOneWay`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.exists_oneWay_iff_exists_weakOneWay`: existential and equivalence forms of
+  Theorem 2.3.
+
+## References
+
+* [Y. Liu and R. Pass, *On One-Way Functions and Kolmogorov Complexity*][LiuPass2020],
+  full version `arXiv:2009.11514v1` (Section 2.1, Theorem 2.3, p. 7).
+* [A. C. Yao, *Theory and Application of Trapdoor Functions*][Yao1982].
+* [O. Goldreich, *Foundations of Cryptography, Volume 1*][Goldreich2001],
+  Section 2.3, Theorem 2.3.2.
+-/

+/-! ### Elementary real-algebra bounds for geometric amplification -/
+
+private theorem pow_one_sub_mul_one_add_le_one {α : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ α) (h1 : α ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
+    (1 - α) ^ m * (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) ≤ 1 := by
+  induction m with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ m ih =>
+    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - α) ^ m := pow_nonneg (by linarith) m
+    have hstep : (1 - α) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α) ≤ 1 + (m : ℝ) * α := by
+      push_cast
+      have hsq : 0 ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (α * α) := by positivity
+      nlinarith
+    calc (1 - α) ^ (m + 1) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α)
+      _ = (1 - α) ^ m * ((1 - α) * (1 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α)) := by ring
+      _ ≤ (1 - α) ^ m * (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hnonneg
+      _ ≤ 1 := ih
+
+private theorem pow_one_sub_le_inv_one_add {α : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ α) (h1 : α ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
+    (1 - α) ^ m ≤ 1 / (1 + (m : ℝ) * α) := by
+  have hpos : 0 < 1 + (m : ℝ) * α := by positivity
+  exact (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr (pow_one_sub_mul_one_add_le_one h0 h1 m)
+
+private theorem pow_one_sub_inv_two_mul_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (r : ℕ) :
+    (1 - 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ (2 * q * r) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ r := by
+  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
+  have hα0 : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by positivity
+  have hα1 : 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
+    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
+    linarith
+  have hbase : (1 - 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ (2 * q) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
+    have h := pow_one_sub_le_inv_one_add hα0 hα1 (2 * q)
+    have hmul : ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) = 1 := by
+      push_cast
+      field_simp
+    rw [hmul] at h
+    linarith
+  rw [pow_mul]
+  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hbase r
+
+private theorem pow_one_sub_le_inv_two_mul {q m : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hm : 0 < m) :
+    (1 - 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ^ (4 * q * m) ≤ 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
+  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
+  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
+  have hα0 : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) := by positivity
+  have hα1 : 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
+    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
+    linarith
+  have h := pow_one_sub_le_inv_one_add hα0 hα1 (4 * q * m)
+  have hmul : ((4 * q * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
+    push_cast
+    field_simp
+    ring
+  rw [hmul] at h
+  refine h.trans ?_
+  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
+
+/-! ### PMF union and expectation bounds -/
+
+private theorem pmf_map_true_le_add {α : Type*} (p : PMF α) (E A B : α → Bool)
+    (h : ∀ a, E a = true → A a = true ∨ B a = true) :
+    (p.map E) true ≤ (p.map A) true + (p.map B) true := by
+  rw [PMF.map_apply, PMF.map_apply, PMF.map_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
+  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => ?_
+  by_cases hE : true = E a
+  · rcases h a hE.symm with hA | hB
+    · simp [← hE, hA]
+    · simp [← hE, hB]
+  · simp [hE]
+
+private theorem pmf_map_any_range_true_le_sum {α : Type*} (p : PMF α) (K : ℕ)
+    (F : ℕ → α → Bool) :
+    (p.map (fun a => (List.range K).any (fun j => F j a))) true ≤
+      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, (p.map (F j)) true := by
+  induction K with
+  | zero =>
+    simp [PMF.map_apply]
+  | succ K ih =>
+    have hsplit : ∀ a, ((List.range (K + 1)).any (fun j => F j a)) = true →
+        ((List.range K).any (fun j => F j a)) = true ∨ F K a = true := by
+      intro a ha
+      rw [List.range_succ, List.any_append, Bool.or_eq_true] at ha
+      simpa using ha
+    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
+    exact (pmf_map_true_le_add p _ _ _ hsplit).trans (add_le_add_left ih _)
+
+private theorem pmf_bind_true_le_of_le {α : Type*} (μ : PMF α) (r : α → PMF Bool)
+    {c : ENNReal} (h : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, (r x) true ≤ c) :
+    (μ.bind r) true ≤ c := by
+  rw [PMF.bind_apply]
+  calc ∑' x, μ x * (r x) true
+    _ ≤ ∑' x, μ x * c := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => by
+        by_cases hx : μ x = 0
+        · simp [hx]
+        · exact mul_le_mul_right (h x ((PMF.mem_support_iff _ _).mpr hx)) (μ x)
+    _ = c := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]
+
+/-! ### Parallel evaluation, row replacement, and planted challenges -/

+/-- Evaluate `f` in parallel on `k n` blocks of width `w n` extracted from `X` via
+`BitString.listRow`, concatenating the resulting bit strings. -/
+def parallelCore (k w : ℕ → ℕ) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (n : ℕ) (X : List Bool) :
+    List Bool :=
+  (List.range (k n)).flatMap (fun j => f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X))
+
+/-- When `f` has fixed output length `outLen |x|` on inputs of length `|x|`, `parallelCore`
+produces outputs of exact length `k n * outLen (w n)`. -/
+theorem length_parallelCore {k w outLen : ℕ → ℕ} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
+    (hlen : ∀ x, (f x).length = outLen x.length) (n : ℕ) (X : List Bool) :
+    (parallelCore k w f n X).length = k n * outLen (w n) := by
+  simp [parallelCore, List.length_flatMap, hlen, BitString.length_listRow]
+
+/-- Extracting the `j`-th output block of width `outLen (w n)` from `parallelCore` recovers
+`f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X)`. -/
+theorem listRow_parallelCore {k w outLen : ℕ → ℕ} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
+    (hlen : ∀ x, (f x).length = outLen x.length) (n : ℕ) (X : List Bool)
+    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < k n) :
+    BitString.listRow (outLen (w n)) j (parallelCore k w f n X) =
+      f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X) := by
+  have h := BitString.listRow_flatMap_append
+    (width := outLen (w n))
+    (fun i => f (BitString.listRow (w n) i X))
+    (List.range (k n))
+    (fun i _ => by simp [hlen])
+    [] j (by simpa using hj)
+  simpa [parallelCore] using h
+
+/-- Any preimage under `parallelCore k w f n` must invert every individual block `j < k n`. -/
+theorem parallelCore_eq_imp_row_eq {k w outLen : ℕ → ℕ} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
+    (hlen : ∀ x, (f x).length = outLen x.length) {n : ℕ} {X X' : List Bool}
+    (heq : parallelCore k w f n X' = parallelCore k w f n X) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < k n) :
+    f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X') = f (BitString.listRow (w n) j X) := by
+  rw [← listRow_parallelCore hlen n X' hj, ← listRow_parallelCore hlen n X hj, heq]
+
+/-- Truncating the input of `parallelCore k w f n` to `k n * w n` bits leaves the output
+unchanged. -/
+theorem parallelCore_take (k w : ℕ → ℕ) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (n : ℕ) (X : List Bool) :
+    parallelCore k w f n (X.take (k n * w n)) = parallelCore k w f n X := by
+  unfold parallelCore
+  refine List.flatMap_congr fun j hj => congrArg f ?_
+  have hj_lt : j < k n := List.mem_range.mp hj
+  apply List.ext_getElem (by simp)
+  intro i hi hi'
+  simp only [BitString.length_listRow] at hi
+  rw [BitString.getElem_listRow hi, BitString.getElem_listRow hi]
+  have hlt : j * w n + i < k n * w n := by
+    have hstep : j * w n + i < (j + 1) * w n := by ring_nf; omega
+    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hstep (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (w n) hj_lt)
+  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_of_lt hlt]
+
+/-- Replace row `j` of a `count × width` bit string `Z` with `x`. -/
+def replaceRow (width count j : ℕ) (x Z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  (List.range count).flatMap (fun i => if i = j then x else BitString.listRow width i Z)
+
+/-- Reading row `i < count` from `replaceRow width count j x Z` returns `x` when `i = j` and
+`BitString.listRow width i Z` otherwise. -/
+theorem listRow_replaceRow {width count j : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (hx : x.length = width)
+    (Z : List Bool) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < count) :
+    BitString.listRow width i (replaceRow width count j x Z) =
+      if i = j then x else BitString.listRow width i Z := by
+  have h := BitString.listRow_flatMap_append
+    (width := width)
+    (fun r => if r = j then x else BitString.listRow width r Z)
+    (List.range count)
+    (fun r _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [hx])
+    [] i (by simpa using hi)
+  simpa [replaceRow] using h
+
+/-- Construct the `k n`-block output of `parallelCore` with a challenge `y` planted in slot `j`
+and the remaining slots filled by `f (BitString.listRow (w n) i Z)`. -/
+def plantedImage (k w : ℕ → ℕ) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (n j : ℕ)
+    (y Z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  (List.range (k n)).flatMap (fun i =>
+    if i = j then y else f (BitString.listRow (w n) i Z))
+
+/-- When `y` has length `outLen (w n)`, `plantedImage` has length `k n * outLen (w n)`. -/
+theorem length_plantedImage {k w outLen : ℕ → ℕ} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
+    (hlen : ∀ x, (f x).length = outLen x.length) (n j : ℕ) {y : List Bool}
+    (hy : y.length = outLen (w n)) (Z : List Bool) :
+    (plantedImage k w f n j y Z).length = k n * outLen (w n) := by
+  have hmap : List.map (fun i =>
+      (if i = j then y else f (BitString.listRow (w n) i Z)).length) (List.range (k n)) =
+        List.replicate (k n) (outLen (w n)) := by
+    rw [List.eq_replicate_iff]
+    refine ⟨by simp, fun len hlen_mem => ?_⟩
+    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hlen_mem
+    split_ifs <;> simp [hy, hlen]
+  rw [plantedImage, List.length_flatMap, hmap, List.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul]
+
+/-- Evaluating `parallelCore` on `replaceRow (w n) (k n) j x Z` produces `plantedImage` with
+`y = f x` planted in slot `j`. -/
+theorem parallelCore_replaceRow {k w : ℕ → ℕ} (f : List Bool → List Bool)
+    (n j : ℕ) {x : List Bool} (hx : x.length = w n) (Z : List Bool) :
+    parallelCore k w f n (replaceRow (w n) (k n) j x Z) =
+      plantedImage k w f n j (f x) Z := by
+  unfold parallelCore plantedImage
+  refine List.flatMap_congr fun i hi => ?_
+  rw [listRow_replaceRow hx Z (List.mem_range.mp hi)]
+  split_ifs <;> rfl
+
+/-- Replacing row `j < count` of a uniform `count * width`-bit string with an independent uniform
+`width`-bit string preserves the uniform distribution `BitString.uniformList (count * width)`. -/
+theorem uniformList_replaceRow (width count : ℕ) (j : Fin count) :
+    (BitString.uniformList width).bind (fun x =>
+      (BitString.uniformList (count * width)).map (replaceRow width count j.val x)) =
+      BitString.uniformList (count * width) := by
+  classical
+  have hrep (x : BitString width) (Z : List Bool) :
+      replaceRow width count j.val (List.ofFn x) Z =
+        List.ofFn (blocksEquiv.symm
+          (Function.update (block (ofList (count * width) Z)) j x)) := by
+    rw [ofFn_blocksEquiv_symm, replaceRow, List.flatMap_def]
+    congr 1

+    intro i hi hi'

+# KEM–DEM hybrid public-key encryption
+
+A Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) samples a public/secret key pair `(pk, sk) ← keyGen n` and
+encapsulates a symmetric key `(k, ctKem) ← encaps n pk` ([BonehShoup2023], Section 11.3.1,
+Definition 11.3). Its IND-CPA security (`KEMINDCPA`, Attack Game 11.4 and Definition 11.4) asks
+that replacing the encapsulated key `k` with an independent uniform `n`-bit key
+`BitString.sampleList n` is computationally indistinguishable to every uniform strict PPT
+distinguisher receiving `(pk, (k, ctKem))`.
+
+A Data Encapsulation Mechanism (DEM) for bit messages encrypts a single challenge bit under a
+fresh uniform `n`-bit key (`demGame`, Attack Game 2.1 / 11.3; `DEMOneTimeINDCPA`).
+
+Combining `encaps` with `encryptSym` produces the hybrid public-key encryption scheme
+`hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym` (`hybridDecrypt decaps decryptSym`, Definition 11.5). By
+Boneh and Shoup's Theorem 11.2, if the KEM is IND-CPA secure and the DEM is one-time IND-CPA
+secure, then `hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym` is IND-CPA secure (`KEMINDCPA.hybrid_indcpa`).
+We formalize both the two-distinguisher triangle bound (`advantage_hybridGame_le`) and the
+single hidden-bit KEM distinguisher bound (`advantage_hybridGame_le_two_mul`), together with a
+non-vacuous one-time pad DEM instantiation (`otpEncrypt`, `otpDecrypt`,
+`demOneTimeINDCPA_otpEncrypt`, `KEMINDCPA.hybrid_otpEncrypt_indcpa`).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.kemRealGame`, `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.kemIdealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.KEMINDCPA`: real and ideal KEM IND-CPA experiments and security.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.demGame`, `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.DEMOneTimeINDCPA`: one-time
+  symmetric bit-encryption experiment and security.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridEncrypt`, `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridDecrypt`: KEM–DEM
+  hybrid encryption and deterministic decryption.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridIdealGame`: intermediate game replacing the encapsulated key
+  with an independent uniform `n`-bit key.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridToKEMDistinguisher`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridToKEMHiddenBitDistinguisher`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridToDEMAdversary`: the certified uniform reductions.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.otpEncrypt`, `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.otpDecrypt`: one-time pad
+  single-bit DEM.
+

+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.isPPTOn_kemRealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.isPPTOn_kemIdealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.isPPTOn_demGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.isPPTOn_hybridEncrypt`,

+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.hybridDecrypt_encPair`,

+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.KEMINDCPA.hybrid_indcpa`: asymptotic Boneh–Shoup Theorem 11.2.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.Encryption.demOneTimeINDCPA_otpEncrypt`,

Finitely many bad-length outputs/parameters, or a negligible bad-length probability, can still satisfy it (the OTP proof itself ignores n=0 asymptotically). Say that non-negligible length deviations are detectable, rather than claiming that every key-length violation directly falsifies the predicate. No definition change is needed.
