+    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
+    intro h
+    rcases h with h | h | h | h <;> apply Prod.ext <;> norm_num <;> linarith
+
+private theorem access_eq_translate (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    access sites p q = translate (cellOrigin 120 p)
+      (if p ∈ sites then Crossover.accessRoute (side p q)
+        else [Crossover.boundaryPort (side p q), (120, 120)]) := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp [access, hp]
+  · simpa only [hp, ↓reduceIte] using access_eq_spoke hp q
+
+/-- The actual access has no boundary contact except its designated midpoint port. -/
+theorem access_support_cell (sites : List Point) (c q : Point) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hp : p ∈ support (access sites c q)) :
+    p ∈ closedCell 120 c ∧
+      (p ∈ openCell 120 c ∨ p = realPoint (cellPort 120 c (side c q))) := by
+  rw [access_eq_translate, support_translate] at hp
+  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hp
+  have hb : 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ 240 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 240 ∧
+      (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 240 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 240 →
+        p = realPoint (Crossover.boundaryPort (side c q))) := by
+    by_cases hc : c ∈ sites
+    · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hp
+      exact Crossover.access_boundary_isolation hp
+    · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hp
+      exact spoke_boundary_isolation _ hp
+  constructor
+  · rw [mem_closedCell_add_origin_iff]
+    norm_num
+    exact ⟨hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2.1⟩
+  · by_cases h : p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 240 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 240
+    · right
+      rw [hb.2.2.2.2 h, cellPort_eq_boundaryPort, realPoint_add, add_comm]
+    · left
+      rw [mem_openCell_add_origin_iff]
+      norm_num
+      push Not at h
+      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hb.1 (Ne.symm h.1), lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.1 h.2.1,
+        lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.2.1 (Ne.symm h.2.2.1), lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2⟩
+
+/-- Access routes from distinct cells can meet only at their two equal designated ports. -/
+theorem access_contact_of_distinct_cells (sites otherSites : List Point)
+    {c d : Point} (hcd : c ≠ d)
+    (a b : Point) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hc : p ∈ support (access sites c a)) (hd : p ∈ support (access otherSites d b)) :
+    p = realPoint (cellPort 120 c (side c a)) ∧
+      p = realPoint (cellPort 120 d (side d b)) := by
+  obtain ⟨hcclosed, hcopen | hcport⟩ := access_support_cell sites c a hc
+  · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp
+      (disjoint_openCell_closedCell (by decide) hcd) hcopen
+      (access_support_cell otherSites d b hd).1)
+  · refine ⟨hcport, ?_⟩
+    obtain ⟨_, hdopen | hdport⟩ := access_support_cell otherSites d b hd
+    · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp
+        (disjoint_openCell_closedCell (by decide) hcd.symm) hdopen hcclosed)
+    · exact hdport
+
+private theorem spoke_contact_check : ∀ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j →
+    routeContactCheck [(120, 120)] [Crossover.boundaryPort i, (120, 120)]
+      [Crossover.boundaryPort j, (120, 120)] = true := by decide
+
+/-- Distinct sides of an ordinary cell contact only at its signal center. -/
+theorem ordinary_access_contact {sites : List Point} {c : Point} (hc : c ∉ sites)
+    (a b : Point) (hs : side c a ≠ side c b) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (ha : p ∈ support (access sites c a)) (hb : p ∈ support (access sites c b)) :
+    p = realPoint (center c) := by
+  rw [access_eq_spoke hc, support_translate] at ha
+  obtain ⟨p, ha, rfl⟩ := ha
+  rw [access_eq_spoke hc] at hb
+  have hb' := (mem_support_translate_iff _ _ _).mp hb
+  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := routeContactCheck_sound
+    (spoke_contact_check _ _ hs) ha hb'
+  have : q = (120, 120) := List.mem_singleton.mp hq
+  subst q
+  rw [hpq, center, realPoint_add, add_comm]
+
+/-- Distinct access sides of a crossing cell have disjoint real supports. -/
+theorem crossing_access_disjoint {sites : List Point} {c : Point} (hc : c ∈ sites)
+    (a b : Point) (hs : side c a ≠ side c b) :
+    Disjoint (support (access sites c a)) (support (access sites c b)) := by
+  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
+  intro p ha hb
+  simp only [access, hc, ↓reduceIte] at ha hb
+  have ha' := (mem_support_translate_iff (cellOrigin 120 c) (Crossover.accessRoute (side c a))
+    (p - realPoint (cellOrigin 120 c))).mp
+    (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using ha)
+  have hb' := (mem_support_translate_iff (cellOrigin 120 c) (Crossover.accessRoute (side c b))
+    (p - realPoint (cellOrigin 120 c))).mp
+    (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hb)
+  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (Crossover.access_disjoint hs) ha' hb'
+
+/-- Compact labels retain the compiler's structured variable order and displayed positions. -/
+theorem positions_getD_variable (φ : CNF ℕ) {v : Variable}
+    (hv : v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars) :
+    (positions φ).getD ((formula φ).distinctVars.idxOf ((rawFormula φ).vars.idxOf v)) (0, 0) =
+      variablePosition v := by
+  rw [formula, CNF.idxOf_distinctVars_compact _ hv]
+  have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (CNF.mem_distinctVars.mpr hv)
+  rw [positions, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hi)]
+  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hi), List.getElem_map]
+  congr 1
+  exact List.getElem_idxOf hi
+
+private theorem three_simple {a b c : Point} (hn : [a, b, c].Nodup)
+    (hc : segmentContactCheck [b] a b b c = true) : IsSimple [a, b, c] := by
+  have hcontact : EndpointContacts a b b c := by
+    intro p hp hq
+    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := segmentContactCheck_sound hc hp hq
+    have hqb : q = b := List.mem_singleton.mp hq
+    exact ⟨Or.inr (hqb ▸ hpq), Or.inl (hqb ▸ hpq)⟩
+  refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
+  intro e he f hf hne
+  simp only [List.consecutivePairs, List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.zip_nil_right,
+    List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at he hf
+  rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hf with rfl | rfl
+  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
+  · exact hcontact
+  · exact hcontact.symm
+  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
+
+private def finalLocalRoute (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) : Route :=
+  [2 • Crossover.boundaryPort s - (120, 120), Crossover.boundaryPort s,
+    if crossing then Crossover.variablePosition (Crossover.splitTerminal s) else (120, 120)]
+
+private theorem finalLocalRoute_simple (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) :
+    IsSimple (finalLocalRoute s crossing) := by
+  unfold finalLocalRoute
+  apply three_simple
+  · fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+  · fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+
+private theorem finalLocalRoute_orthogonal (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) :
+    IsOrthogonal (finalLocalRoute s crossing) := by
+  fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;>
+    norm_num [finalLocalRoute, Crossover.boundaryPort, Crossover.variablePosition,
+      Crossover.splitTerminal, IsOrthogonal, List.consecutivePairs, AxisAligned]
+
+private theorem neighbor_center {p q : Point} (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    center q = 2 • Crossover.boundaryPort (side p q) - (120, 120) + cellOrigin 120 p := by
+  rcases p with ⟨px, py⟩
+  rcases unit_neighbor_cases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
+    norm_num [center, side, Crossover.boundaryPort, cellOrigin, two_nsmul,
+      Prod.ext_iff] <;> omega
+
+/-- The final-literal route is a translated straight three-point route for every unit step. -/
+private theorem finalRoute_eq_translate (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    center q :: access sites p q = translate (cellOrigin 120 p)
+      (finalLocalRoute (side p q) (decide (p ∈ sites))) := by
+  rw [neighbor_center h]
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites <;>
+    simp [access, hp, translate, finalLocalRoute, Crossover.accessRoute,
+      cellPort_eq_boundaryPort, center, add_comm]
+
+/-- The actual final incidence across a unit step is continuously simple. -/
+theorem finalRoute_simple (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) : IsSimple (center q :: access sites p q) := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, isSimple_translate_iff]
+  exact finalLocalRoute_simple _ _
+
+/-- The actual final incidence across a unit step is proper and orthogonal. -/
+theorem finalRoute_orthogonal (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) : IsOrthogonal (center q :: access sites p q) := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, isOrthogonal_translate_iff]
+  exact finalLocalRoute_orthogonal _ _
+
+/-- Access length is exactly 20 inside a crossing cell and 120 inside an ordinary cell. -/
+theorem access_wireLength (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    wireLength (access sites p q) = if p ∈ sites then 20 else 120 := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp only [access, hp, ↓reduceIte, wireLength_translate]
+    exact (Crossover.access_route_sizes _).2
+  · rw [access_eq_spoke hp, wireLength_translate]
+    simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]
+    generalize side p q = s
+    fin_cases s <;> decide
+
+/-- A final literal route across one unit step uses at most 240 units of wire. -/
+theorem finalRoute_wireLength_le (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    wireLength (center q :: access sites p q) ≤ 240 := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, wireLength_translate]
+  generalize side p q = s
+  generalize decide (p ∈ sites) = crossing
+  fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+
+/-- A final literal route is the ordinary clause-cell spoke followed by its neighbor's access.
+This equality concerns the full real supports and includes the shared boundary midpoint. -/
+theorem support_finalRoute (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    support (center q :: access sites p q) =
+      support (access [] q p) ∪ support (access sites p q) := by
+  rw [access_eq_pair sites p q, access_eq_pair [] q p, support_cons_cons]
+  have hs (a b : Point) : support [a, b] = segment a b :=
+    Set.ext fun _ => mem_support_pair
+  rw [hs (cellPort 120 q (side q p))]
+  simp only [signal, List.not_mem_nil, ↓reduceIte, variablePosition, Option.elim_none]
+  rw [← shared_cellPort h]
+  congr 1
+  exact _root_.segment_symm ℝ _ _
+
+/-- The final route starts at its original clause center and ends at the presented signal. -/
+theorem finalRoute_endpoints (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    (center q :: access sites p q).head? = some (center q) ∧
+      (center q :: access sites p q).getLast? =
+        some (variablePosition (signal sites p q)) := by
+  rw [access_eq_pair]
+  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The two binary-link incidences are simple actual access routes. -/
+theorem link_routes_simple (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) (p q : Point) :
+    ∀ r ∈ (link sites positive p q).2.2, IsSimple r := by
+  cases positive <;> simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+    List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] <;>
+    exact ⟨access_simple _ _ _, access_simple _ _ _⟩
+
+/-- The two binary-link incidences are proper actual orthogonal access routes. -/
+theorem link_routes_orthogonal (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) (p q : Point) :
+    ∀ r ∈ (link sites positive p q).2.2, IsOrthogonal r := by
+  cases positive <;> simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+    List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] <;>
+    exact ⟨access_orthogonal _ _ _, access_orthogonal _ _ _⟩
+
+/-- Literal and route ordering in an actual binary link gives the declared geometric endpoints. -/
+theorem link_endpoints (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) {l : Literal Variable} {r : Route}
+    (hlr : (l, r) ∈ (link sites positive p q).1.zip (link sites positive p q).2.2) :
+    r.head? = some (link sites positive p q).2.1 ∧
+      r.getLast? = some (variablePosition l.1) := by
+  cases positive <;>
+    simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.zip_cons_cons, List.zip_nil_right,
+      List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hlr ⊢ <;>
+    rcases hlr with e | e <;> cases e <;>
+    simp [access_eq_pair, ← shared_cellPort h]
+
+/-- An ordinary signal name occurs exactly in an ordinary cell. -/
+theorem signal_none_iff (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    (signal sites p q).2 = none ↔ p ∉ sites := by
+  simp [signal]
+
+/-- Every variable actually emitted by the compiler has the appropriate cell kind.
+In particular, the ordinary center name is never emitted inside a crossover cell. -/
+theorem raw_variable_cell_kind (φ : CNF ℕ) {v : Variable}
+    (hv : v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars) :
+    v.2 = none ↔ v.1 ∉ crossingSites φ := by
+  obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hv⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp hv
+  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
+  simp only [placedClauses, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap] at hpc
+  rcases hpc with (hpc | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨o, _, hpc⟩
+  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    obtain ⟨lr, hlr, hlreq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
+    obtain ⟨lj, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hlr
+    have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hlreq
+    simp only [lastLiteral] at heq
+    subst v
+    exact signal_none_iff _ _ _
+  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    obtain ⟨l, _, hl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
+    have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hl
+    dsimp only at heq
+    subst v
+    simp [hp]
+  · obtain ⟨e, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    cases hpos : o.2.2.2 <;>
+      simp only [link, hpos, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+        List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv <;>
+      rcases hv with hv | hv <;>
+      have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hv <;> dsimp only at heq <;> subst v <;>
+      exact signal_none_iff _ _ _
+
+/-- Actual structured variable names have distinct positions, including across different cells. -/
+theorem variablePosition_injOn_rawVars (φ : CNF ℕ) :
+    Set.InjOn variablePosition {v | v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars} := by
+  intro v hv w hw heq
+  have hreal := congrArg realPoint heq
+  have hvcell := variablePosition_mem_openCell v
+  have hwcell := variablePosition_mem_openCell w
+  rw [← hreal] at hwcell
+  have hcell : v.1 = w.1 := cell_eq_of_mem_open_closed (by decide) hvcell
+    ⟨hwcell.1.le, hwcell.2.1.le, hwcell.2.2.1.le, hwcell.2.2.2.le⟩
+  rcases v with ⟨p, v⟩
+  rcases w with ⟨q, w⟩
+  change p = q at hcell
+  subst q
+  have hvkind := raw_variable_cell_kind φ hv
+  have hwkind := raw_variable_cell_kind φ hw
+  cases v <;> cases w
+  · rfl
+  · cases hwkind.mpr (hvkind.mp rfl)
+  · cases hvkind.mpr (hwkind.mp rfl)
+  · simp only [variablePosition, Option.elim_some, add_right_inj] at heq
+    exact congrArg (fun x => (p, some x)) (Crossover.variablePosition_injective heq)
+
+/-- The executable compiler uses exactly the canonical unit paths certified by the layout API. -/
+theorem paths_eq_unitPaths (φ : CNF ℕ) : paths φ = (SAT.incidenceGraph φ).unitPaths := rfl

+/-!
+# Geometry of the actual finite planar SAT compiler
+
+The lemmas refer to the executable routes and positions in `PlanarCompile` and to their
+complete real supports. Cell-local statements cover both the fixed crossover access and
+ordinary center spokes. Their translated supports are confined to the corresponding square.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.access_eq_pair`: the actual access route endpoints.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.access_orthogonal`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.access_simple`: local route certificates.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.routes_regular`: all actual emitted routes are simple
+  and orthogonal.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.routes_length`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.positions_length`: counts match the final incidence graph.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.variablePosition_injOn_rawVars`: distinct actual variable
+  names have distinct displayed positions.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.pathPorts_nodup`: all directed unit-cell ports of the
+  actual paths are distinct under the source width and occurrence bounds.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile.positions_nodup`: every actual output vertex has a
+  distinct displayed position under those same source bounds.
+
+These results do not yet certify the complete planar drawing: incidence-order endpoint transport,
+nonincident-vertex avoidance and global route contacts remain to be proved.
+
+## References
+
+The global assembly and coordinate arguments are original. The fixed crossover and its
+continuous certificates are credited in `CrossoverLayout`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Complexity.SAT.PlanarCompile
+
+open Cslib.Logic.PL Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF Orthogonal
+
+/-- The fixed gadget and cell API use the same four geometric boundary points. -/
+theorem cellPort_eq_boundaryPort (p : Point) (s : Fin 4) :
+    cellPort 120 p s = cellOrigin 120 p + Crossover.boundaryPort s := by
+  fin_cases s <;> rfl
+
+/-- Every actual access route is a single segment from its cell port to its signal variable. -/
+theorem access_eq_pair (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    access sites p q = [cellPort 120 p (side p q), variablePosition (signal sites p q)] := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp only [access, hp, ↓reduceIte, Crossover.accessRoute, translate, List.map_cons,
+      List.map_nil, signal, variablePosition, Option.elim_some, cellPort_eq_boundaryPort]
+    simp only [add_comm]
+  · simp [access, hp, signal, variablePosition, center]
+
+private theorem spoke_orthogonal (s : Fin 4) :
+    IsOrthogonal [Crossover.boundaryPort s, (120, 120)] := by
+  fin_cases s <;> norm_num [IsOrthogonal, List.consecutivePairs, AxisAligned,
+    Crossover.boundaryPort]
+
+private theorem pair_simple (a b : Point) (h : a ≠ b) : IsSimple [a, b] := by
+  simp [IsSimple, List.consecutivePairs, h]
+
+/-- Ordinary access spokes are translates of the same four local straight segments. -/
+theorem access_eq_spoke {sites : List Point} {p : Point} (hp : p ∉ sites) (q : Point) :
+    access sites p q = translate (cellOrigin 120 p)
+      [Crossover.boundaryPort (side p q), (120, 120)] := by
+  simp [access, hp, translate, cellPort_eq_boundaryPort, center, add_comm]
+
+/-- The actual access route is proper and orthogonal in both kinds of occupied cell. -/
+theorem access_orthogonal (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    IsOrthogonal (access sites p q) := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp only [access, hp, ↓reduceIte, isOrthogonal_translate_iff]
+    exact (Crossover.access_endpoints (side p q)).1
+  · rw [access_eq_spoke hp, isOrthogonal_translate_iff]
+    exact spoke_orthogonal _
+
+/-- The actual access route is continuously simple in both kinds of occupied cell. -/
+theorem access_simple (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) : IsSimple (access sites p q) := by
+  rw [access_eq_pair]
+  apply pair_simple
+  have h := access_orthogonal sites p q
+  rw [access_eq_pair] at h
+  exact (h (cellPort 120 p (side p q), variablePosition (signal sites p q))
+    (by simp [List.consecutivePairs])).2
+
+/-- Every structured output variable is strictly inside the cell named by its first coordinate.
+This includes all gadget variables, not only those selected as access terminals. -/
+theorem variablePosition_mem_openCell (v : Variable) :
+    realPoint (variablePosition v) ∈ openCell 120 v.1 := by
+  rcases v with ⟨p, v⟩
+  cases v with
+  | none => exact center_mem_openCell (by decide) p
+  | some v =>
+    rw [variablePosition, Option.elim_some, realPoint_add, add_comm,
+      mem_openCell_add_origin_iff]
+    have h := Crossover.variable_bounds v
+    simp only [realPoint]
+    norm_num
+    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < (Crossover.variablePosition v).1 ∧
+      (Crossover.variablePosition v).1 < 240 ∧ 0 < (Crossover.variablePosition v).2 ∧
+      (Crossover.variablePosition v).2 < 240 by omega)
+
+/-- Every translated fixed-gadget incidence stays in the open cell of that gadget. -/
+theorem crossingRoute_mem_openCell {e : ℕ × Crossover.SplitVariable × Route}
+    (he : e ∈ Crossover.incidenceRoutes) (c : Point) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hp : p ∈ support (translate (cellOrigin 120 c) e.2.2)) : p ∈ openCell 120 c := by
+  rw [support_translate] at hp
+  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hp
+  rw [mem_openCell_add_origin_iff]
+  simpa only [Int.reduceMul, Int.cast_ofNat] using Crossover.core_support_interior he hp
+
+/-- Unit-adjacent integer cells differ by exactly one of the four cardinal displacements. -/
+theorem unit_neighbor_cases {p q : Point} (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    q = p + (-1, 0) ∨ q = p + (1, 0) ∨ q = p + (0, -1) ∨ q = p + (0, 1) := by
+  rcases p with ⟨px, py⟩
+  rcases q with ⟨qx, qy⟩
+  simp only [Orthogonal.length] at h
+  simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
+  omega
+
+/-- Neighboring unit cells use exactly the same geometric midpoint for their shared port. -/
+theorem shared_cellPort {p q : Point} (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    cellPort 120 p (side p q) = cellPort 120 q (side q p) := by
+  rcases p with ⟨px, py⟩
+  rcases unit_neighbor_cases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
+    norm_num [side, cellPort, cellOrigin, Prod.ext_iff] <;> omega
+
+private theorem mem_support_pair {a b : Point} {p : ℝ × ℝ} :
+    p ∈ support [a, b] ↔ p ∈ segment a b := by
+  rw [support_cons_cons]
+  have hs : p ∈ support [b] ↔ p = realPoint b := by
+    simp [support, List.consecutivePairs]
+  rw [Set.mem_union, hs]
+  exact ⟨fun h => h.elim id (fun h => h ▸ _root_.right_mem_segment ℝ _ _), Or.inl⟩
+
+private theorem spoke_boundary_isolation (s : Fin 4) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hp : p ∈ support [Crossover.boundaryPort s, (120, 120)]) :
+    0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ 240 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 240 ∧
+      (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 240 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 240 →
+        p = realPoint (Crossover.boundaryPort s)) := by
+  rw [mem_support_pair] at hp
+  fin_cases s <;>
+    norm_num [Crossover.boundaryPort, Orthogonal.segment, realPoint, mem_horizontal,
+      mem_vertical, Set.mem_uIcc] at hp ⊢
+  all_goals
+    rcases hp with ⟨heq, hlo, hhi⟩
+    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
+    intro h
+    rcases h with h | h | h | h <;> apply Prod.ext <;> norm_num <;> linarith
+
+private theorem access_eq_translate (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    access sites p q = translate (cellOrigin 120 p)
+      (if p ∈ sites then Crossover.accessRoute (side p q)
+        else [Crossover.boundaryPort (side p q), (120, 120)]) := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp [access, hp]
+  · simpa only [hp, ↓reduceIte] using access_eq_spoke hp q
+
+/-- The actual access has no boundary contact except its designated midpoint port. -/
+theorem access_support_cell (sites : List Point) (c q : Point) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hp : p ∈ support (access sites c q)) :
+    p ∈ closedCell 120 c ∧
+      (p ∈ openCell 120 c ∨ p = realPoint (cellPort 120 c (side c q))) := by
+  rw [access_eq_translate, support_translate] at hp
+  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hp
+  have hb : 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ 240 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 240 ∧
+      (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 240 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 240 →
+        p = realPoint (Crossover.boundaryPort (side c q))) := by
+    by_cases hc : c ∈ sites
+    · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hp
+      exact Crossover.access_boundary_isolation hp
+    · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hp
+      exact spoke_boundary_isolation _ hp
+  constructor
+  · rw [mem_closedCell_add_origin_iff]
+    norm_num
+    exact ⟨hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2.1⟩
+  · by_cases h : p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 240 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 240
+    · right
+      rw [hb.2.2.2.2 h, cellPort_eq_boundaryPort, realPoint_add, add_comm]
+    · left
+      rw [mem_openCell_add_origin_iff]
+      norm_num
+      push Not at h
+      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hb.1 (Ne.symm h.1), lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.1 h.2.1,
+        lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.2.1 (Ne.symm h.2.2.1), lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2⟩
+
+/-- Access routes from distinct cells can meet only at their two equal designated ports. -/
+theorem access_contact_of_distinct_cells (sites otherSites : List Point)
+    {c d : Point} (hcd : c ≠ d)
+    (a b : Point) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (hc : p ∈ support (access sites c a)) (hd : p ∈ support (access otherSites d b)) :
+    p = realPoint (cellPort 120 c (side c a)) ∧
+      p = realPoint (cellPort 120 d (side d b)) := by
+  obtain ⟨hcclosed, hcopen | hcport⟩ := access_support_cell sites c a hc
+  · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp
+      (disjoint_openCell_closedCell (by decide) hcd) hcopen
+      (access_support_cell otherSites d b hd).1)
+  · refine ⟨hcport, ?_⟩
+    obtain ⟨_, hdopen | hdport⟩ := access_support_cell otherSites d b hd
+    · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp
+        (disjoint_openCell_closedCell (by decide) hcd.symm) hdopen hcclosed)
+    · exact hdport
+
+private theorem spoke_contact_check : ∀ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j →
+    routeContactCheck [(120, 120)] [Crossover.boundaryPort i, (120, 120)]
+      [Crossover.boundaryPort j, (120, 120)] = true := by decide
+
+/-- Distinct sides of an ordinary cell contact only at its signal center. -/
+theorem ordinary_access_contact {sites : List Point} {c : Point} (hc : c ∉ sites)
+    (a b : Point) (hs : side c a ≠ side c b) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
+    (ha : p ∈ support (access sites c a)) (hb : p ∈ support (access sites c b)) :
+    p = realPoint (center c) := by
+  rw [access_eq_spoke hc, support_translate] at ha
+  obtain ⟨p, ha, rfl⟩ := ha
+  rw [access_eq_spoke hc] at hb
+  have hb' := (mem_support_translate_iff _ _ _).mp hb
+  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := routeContactCheck_sound
+    (spoke_contact_check _ _ hs) ha hb'
+  have : q = (120, 120) := List.mem_singleton.mp hq
+  subst q
+  rw [hpq, center, realPoint_add, add_comm]
+
+/-- Distinct access sides of a crossing cell have disjoint real supports. -/
+theorem crossing_access_disjoint {sites : List Point} {c : Point} (hc : c ∈ sites)
+    (a b : Point) (hs : side c a ≠ side c b) :
+    Disjoint (support (access sites c a)) (support (access sites c b)) := by
+  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
+  intro p ha hb
+  simp only [access, hc, ↓reduceIte] at ha hb
+  have ha' := (mem_support_translate_iff (cellOrigin 120 c) (Crossover.accessRoute (side c a))
+    (p - realPoint (cellOrigin 120 c))).mp
+    (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using ha)
+  have hb' := (mem_support_translate_iff (cellOrigin 120 c) (Crossover.accessRoute (side c b))
+    (p - realPoint (cellOrigin 120 c))).mp
+    (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hb)
+  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (Crossover.access_disjoint hs) ha' hb'
+
+/-- Compact labels retain the compiler's structured variable order and displayed positions. -/
+theorem positions_getD_variable (φ : CNF ℕ) {v : Variable}
+    (hv : v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars) :
+    (positions φ).getD ((formula φ).distinctVars.idxOf ((rawFormula φ).vars.idxOf v)) (0, 0) =
+      variablePosition v := by
+  rw [formula, CNF.idxOf_distinctVars_compact _ hv]
+  have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (CNF.mem_distinctVars.mpr hv)
+  rw [positions, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hi)]
+  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hi), List.getElem_map]
+  congr 1
+  exact List.getElem_idxOf hi
+
+private theorem three_simple {a b c : Point} (hn : [a, b, c].Nodup)
+    (hc : segmentContactCheck [b] a b b c = true) : IsSimple [a, b, c] := by
+  have hcontact : EndpointContacts a b b c := by
+    intro p hp hq
+    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := segmentContactCheck_sound hc hp hq
+    have hqb : q = b := List.mem_singleton.mp hq
+    exact ⟨Or.inr (hqb ▸ hpq), Or.inl (hqb ▸ hpq)⟩
+  refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
+  intro e he f hf hne
+  simp only [List.consecutivePairs, List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.zip_nil_right,
+    List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at he hf
+  rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hf with rfl | rfl
+  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
+  · exact hcontact
+  · exact hcontact.symm
+  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
+
+private def finalLocalRoute (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) : Route :=
+  [2 • Crossover.boundaryPort s - (120, 120), Crossover.boundaryPort s,
+    if crossing then Crossover.variablePosition (Crossover.splitTerminal s) else (120, 120)]
+
+private theorem finalLocalRoute_simple (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) :
+    IsSimple (finalLocalRoute s crossing) := by
+  unfold finalLocalRoute
+  apply three_simple
+  · fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+  · fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+
+private theorem finalLocalRoute_orthogonal (s : Fin 4) (crossing : Bool) :
+    IsOrthogonal (finalLocalRoute s crossing) := by
+  fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;>
+    norm_num [finalLocalRoute, Crossover.boundaryPort, Crossover.variablePosition,
+      Crossover.splitTerminal, IsOrthogonal, List.consecutivePairs, AxisAligned]
+
+private theorem neighbor_center {p q : Point} (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    center q = 2 • Crossover.boundaryPort (side p q) - (120, 120) + cellOrigin 120 p := by
+  rcases p with ⟨px, py⟩
+  rcases unit_neighbor_cases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
+    norm_num [center, side, Crossover.boundaryPort, cellOrigin, two_nsmul,
+      Prod.ext_iff] <;> omega
+
+/-- The final-literal route is a translated straight three-point route for every unit step. -/
+private theorem finalRoute_eq_translate (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    center q :: access sites p q = translate (cellOrigin 120 p)
+      (finalLocalRoute (side p q) (decide (p ∈ sites))) := by
+  rw [neighbor_center h]
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites <;>
+    simp [access, hp, translate, finalLocalRoute, Crossover.accessRoute,
+      cellPort_eq_boundaryPort, center, add_comm]
+
+/-- The actual final incidence across a unit step is continuously simple. -/
+theorem finalRoute_simple (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) : IsSimple (center q :: access sites p q) := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, isSimple_translate_iff]
+  exact finalLocalRoute_simple _ _
+
+/-- The actual final incidence across a unit step is proper and orthogonal. -/
+theorem finalRoute_orthogonal (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) : IsOrthogonal (center q :: access sites p q) := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, isOrthogonal_translate_iff]
+  exact finalLocalRoute_orthogonal _ _
+
+/-- Access length is exactly 20 inside a crossing cell and 120 inside an ordinary cell. -/
+theorem access_wireLength (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    wireLength (access sites p q) = if p ∈ sites then 20 else 120 := by
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites
+  · simp only [access, hp, ↓reduceIte, wireLength_translate]
+    exact (Crossover.access_route_sizes _).2
+  · rw [access_eq_spoke hp, wireLength_translate]
+    simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]
+    generalize side p q = s
+    fin_cases s <;> decide
+
+/-- A final literal route across one unit step uses at most 240 units of wire. -/
+theorem finalRoute_wireLength_le (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    wireLength (center q :: access sites p q) ≤ 240 := by
+  rw [finalRoute_eq_translate sites h, wireLength_translate]
+  generalize side p q = s
+  generalize decide (p ∈ sites) = crossing
+  fin_cases s <;> cases crossing <;> decide
+
+/-- A final literal route is the ordinary clause-cell spoke followed by its neighbor's access.
+This equality concerns the full real supports and includes the shared boundary midpoint. -/
+theorem support_finalRoute (sites : List Point) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) :
+    support (center q :: access sites p q) =
+      support (access [] q p) ∪ support (access sites p q) := by
+  rw [access_eq_pair sites p q, access_eq_pair [] q p, support_cons_cons]
+  have hs (a b : Point) : support [a, b] = segment a b :=
+    Set.ext fun _ => mem_support_pair
+  rw [hs (cellPort 120 q (side q p))]
+  simp only [signal, List.not_mem_nil, ↓reduceIte, variablePosition, Option.elim_none]
+  rw [← shared_cellPort h]
+  congr 1
+  exact _root_.segment_symm ℝ _ _
+
+/-- The final route starts at its original clause center and ends at the presented signal. -/
+theorem finalRoute_endpoints (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    (center q :: access sites p q).head? = some (center q) ∧
+      (center q :: access sites p q).getLast? =
+        some (variablePosition (signal sites p q)) := by
+  rw [access_eq_pair]
+  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The two binary-link incidences are simple actual access routes. -/
+theorem link_routes_simple (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) (p q : Point) :
+    ∀ r ∈ (link sites positive p q).2.2, IsSimple r := by
+  cases positive <;> simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+    List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] <;>
+    exact ⟨access_simple _ _ _, access_simple _ _ _⟩
+
+/-- The two binary-link incidences are proper actual orthogonal access routes. -/
+theorem link_routes_orthogonal (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) (p q : Point) :
+    ∀ r ∈ (link sites positive p q).2.2, IsOrthogonal r := by
+  cases positive <;> simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+    List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] <;>
+    exact ⟨access_orthogonal _ _ _, access_orthogonal _ _ _⟩
+
+/-- Literal and route ordering in an actual binary link gives the declared geometric endpoints. -/
+theorem link_endpoints (sites : List Point) (positive : Bool) {p q : Point}
+    (h : Orthogonal.length p q = 1) {l : Literal Variable} {r : Route}
+    (hlr : (l, r) ∈ (link sites positive p q).1.zip (link sites positive p q).2.2) :
+    r.head? = some (link sites positive p q).2.1 ∧
+      r.getLast? = some (variablePosition l.1) := by
+  cases positive <;>
+    simp only [link, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.zip_cons_cons, List.zip_nil_right,
+      List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hlr ⊢ <;>
+    rcases hlr with e | e <;> cases e <;>
+    simp [access_eq_pair, ← shared_cellPort h]
+
+/-- An ordinary signal name occurs exactly in an ordinary cell. -/
+theorem signal_none_iff (sites : List Point) (p q : Point) :
+    (signal sites p q).2 = none ↔ p ∉ sites := by
+  simp [signal]
+
+/-- Every variable actually emitted by the compiler has the appropriate cell kind.
+In particular, the ordinary center name is never emitted inside a crossover cell. -/
+theorem raw_variable_cell_kind (φ : CNF ℕ) {v : Variable}
+    (hv : v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars) :
+    v.2 = none ↔ v.1 ∉ crossingSites φ := by
+  obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hv⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp hv
+  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
+  simp only [placedClauses, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap] at hpc
+  rcases hpc with (hpc | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨o, _, hpc⟩
+  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    obtain ⟨lr, hlr, hlreq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
+    obtain ⟨lj, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hlr
+    have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hlreq
+    simp only [lastLiteral] at heq
+    subst v
+    exact signal_none_iff _ _ _
+  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    obtain ⟨l, _, hl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
+    have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hl
+    dsimp only at heq
+    subst v
+    simp [hp]
+  · obtain ⟨e, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
+    cases hpos : o.2.2.2 <;>
+      simp only [link, hpos, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_cons,
+        List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv <;>
+      rcases hv with hv | hv <;>
+      have heq := congrArg Prod.fst hv <;> dsimp only at heq <;> subst v <;>
+      exact signal_none_iff _ _ _
+
+/-- Actual structured variable names have distinct positions, including across different cells. -/
+theorem variablePosition_injOn_rawVars (φ : CNF ℕ) :
+    Set.InjOn variablePosition {v | v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars} := by
+  intro v hv w hw heq
+  have hreal := congrArg realPoint heq
+  have hvcell := variablePosition_mem_openCell v
+  have hwcell := variablePosition_mem_openCell w
+  rw [← hreal] at hwcell
+  have hcell : v.1 = w.1 := cell_eq_of_mem_open_closed (by decide) hvcell
+    ⟨hwcell.1.le, hwcell.2.1.le, hwcell.2.2.1.le, hwcell.2.2.2.le⟩
+  rcases v with ⟨p, v⟩
+  rcases w with ⟨q, w⟩
+  change p = q at hcell
+  subst q
+  have hvkind := raw_variable_cell_kind φ hv
+  have hwkind := raw_variable_cell_kind φ hw
+  cases v <;> cases w
+  · rfl
+  · cases hwkind.mpr (hvkind.mp rfl)
+  · cases hvkind.mpr (hwkind.mp rfl)
+  · simp only [variablePosition, Option.elim_some, add_right_inj] at heq
+    exact congrArg (fun x => (p, some x)) (Crossover.variablePosition_injective heq)
+
+/-- The executable compiler uses exactly the canonical unit paths certified by the layout API. -/
+theorem paths_eq_unitPaths (φ : CNF ℕ) : paths φ = (SAT.incidenceGraph φ).unitPaths := rfl

body: [P2] Match the proof explanation to the checked construction. The library's `CircuitMinMergeLanguage` is a polynomial-hierarchy language; the assumed NP-to-P/poly inclusion supplies polynomial-size circuits via the PH closure argument. Its merged certificate is lexicographically least among valid size-≤s fixed-threshold certificates, rather than a minimum-size circuit. Please describe those actual steps here. Also identify the binary-subcube construction as the library's adaptation of Lemma 3.1/Section 5 and state the specialization from [Theorem 1.4, third bullet](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rrw/MCSP-MKTP-stoc19.pdf): oracle-free decision MCSP and a size-only lower-bound hypothesis, with no search/depth conclusion. The library module already records these distinctions; the self-contained abstract should preserve them.

@@ -0,0 +1,250 @@
+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 lean-trominoes contributors. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Erik Demaine, Stefan Langerman, GPT 5.6
+-/
+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Logics.Propositional.CNF.Planar.Crossover
+public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Union
+public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
+import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
+
+/-!
+# A fixed degree-three crossover
+
+Each of the eight degree-six internal variables is replaced by six cyclically ordered copies,
+with one directed implication between each consecutive pair. The four boundary variables and
+central variable retain their two occurrences. This is a fixed template, not a generic splitter.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.Crossover.SplitVariable`: the 53 variables of the template.
+* `Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.Crossover.splitFormula`: its 74 clauses.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.Crossover.split_occurrences_le_three`: internal degree bound.
+* `Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.Crossover.split_terminal_occurrences`: degree-two attachment ports.
+
+## References
+
+* The finite Figure 8(b) gadget credited in `Crossover`; local six-copy replacement is original.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.Crossover
+
+/-- The eight original internal variables that need local splitting. -/
+inductive Internal
+  | aInnerLeft
+  | upperLeft
+  | lowerLeft
+  | bInnerTop
+  | bInnerBottom
+  | upperRight
+  | lowerRight
+  | aInnerRight
+  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
+
+instance : Fintype Internal where
+  elems := {.aInnerLeft, .upperLeft, .lowerLeft, .bInnerTop, .bInnerBottom,
+    .upperRight, .lowerRight, .aInnerRight}
+  complete v := by cases v <;> simp
+
+/-- The five unsplit variables and six local copies of each degree-six variable. -/
+inductive SplitVariable
+  | aLeft | aRight | bTop | bBottom | center
+  | copy (v : Internal) (i : Fin 6)
+  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
+
+instance : Fintype SplitVariable where
+  elems := {.aLeft, .aRight, .bTop, .bBottom, .center} ∪
+    Finset.univ.biUnion fun v : Internal => Finset.univ.image (SplitVariable.copy v)
+  complete v := by cases v <;> simp
+
+/-- The original variable represented by a split variable. -/
+def SplitVariable.origin : SplitVariable → Variable
+  | .aLeft => .aLeft
+  | .aRight => .aRight
+  | .bTop => .bTop
+  | .bBottom => .bBottom
+  | .center => .center
+  | .copy .aInnerLeft _ => .aInnerLeft
+  | .copy .upperLeft _ => .upperLeft
+  | .copy .lowerLeft _ => .lowerLeft
+  | .copy .bInnerTop _ => .bInnerTop
+  | .copy .bInnerBottom _ => .bInnerBottom
+  | .copy .upperRight _ => .upperRight
+  | .copy .lowerRight _ => .lowerRight
+  | .copy .aInnerRight _ => .aInnerRight
+
+/-- A distinguished representative of every original variable. -/
+def representative : Variable → SplitVariable
+  | .aLeft => .aLeft
+  | .aRight => .aRight
+  | .bTop => .bTop
+  | .bBottom => .bBottom
+  | .center => .center
+  | .aInnerLeft => .copy .aInnerLeft 0
+  | .upperLeft => .copy .upperLeft 0

+  | .lowerRight => .copy .lowerRight 0
+  | .aInnerRight => .copy .aInnerRight 0
+
+/-- The original 26 clauses, using the cyclic copy determined by each local incidence ray. -/
+def splitClauses : CNF SplitVariable :=
+  [[(.aLeft, true), (.copy .aInnerLeft 5, false)],
+   [(.aLeft, false), (.copy .aInnerLeft 4, true)],
+   [(.copy .aInnerLeft 0, false), (.copy .upperLeft 0, false), (.copy .bInnerTop 5, true)],

+   [(.copy .upperLeft 1, true), (.copy .bInnerTop 4, false)],
+   [(.copy .upperLeft 3, false), (.copy .lowerLeft 1, false), (.center, false)],
+   [(.copy .lowerLeft 3, true), (.copy .bInnerBottom 0, true)],

+   [(.copy .bInnerBottom 4, false), (.bBottom, true)],

+   [(.copy .upperRight 3, true), (.copy .lowerRight 1, true)],

+# The Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function from Decisional Diffie–Hellman
+
+Over a `PrimeOrderGroupFamily` `F`, the Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424; [NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1,
+Construction 4.1 & Theorem 4.1) with key `(α₀, α₁, …, αₙ) ∈ (ZMod q)ⁿ⁺¹` maps an `n`-bit input
+`x ∈ {0, 1}ⁿ` to the group element
+$$F_{\mathrm{NR}}((\alpha_0, \alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_n), (x_1, \dots, x_n))
+  := \left(\alpha_0 \cdot \prod_{i=1}^n \alpha_i^{x_i}\right) \bullet g.$$
+
+Following Boneh–Shoup Exercises 10.4, 10.8, 10.11, and 4.18, we formalize:
+
+1. **Algebraic and augmented-tree characterization (`naorReingoldEval`, `naorReingoldTreeEval`)**:
+   - The closed-form exponent product `naorReingoldExp` and group evaluation `naorReingoldEval`.
+   - The single-step generator `naorReingoldPRG`
+     ($G_{\mathrm{NR}}(\alpha, u) = (u, \alpha \bullet u)$)
+     and augmented-tree fold `naorReingoldTreeEval`, together with
+     `naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424, and
+     Exercise 4.18, p. 172).
+   - The word-level evaluator `naorReingoldWordEval`, its correctness theorem
+     `naorReingoldWordEval_eq_encode`, and its plain polynomial-time certificate
+     `computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordEval`.
+2. **Fixed-$u$ DDH random self-reduction and Multi-DDH (I) (`ddhFixedURerandomize`,
+   `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw`)**:
+   - Fixed-$u$ rerandomization $(u, v, w) \mapsto (u, \sigma \bullet g + \tau \bullet v,
+     \sigma \bullet u + \tau \bullet w)$ ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.8, p. 425), its word-level
+     counterpart `ddhFixedUWordRerandomize`, and the exact distributional laws
+     `ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_real` (Exercise 10.8(a)) and `ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_ideal`
+     (Exercise 10.8(b)).
+   - The $n = 1$ (single shared secret $\alpha$, $|\iota|$ pairs) Multi-DDH (I) reduction
+     `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.11, p. 426), whose wrapper samples
+     $|\iota|$ rerandomized pairs, proving `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_real`,
+     `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_ideal`, and the quantitative bound `advantage_multiDDH_le`
+     ($\le \mathrm{DDHadv}[B] + 1 / q$).
+3. **Naor–Reingold PRF prefix hybrids and distributional security bound (`naorReingoldRealGame`,
+   `naorReingoldIdealGame`, `naorReingoldHybridGame`)**:
+   - The adaptive oracle experiments `naorReingoldRealGame`, `naorReingoldIdealGame`, and the
+     depth-$k$ prefix hybrids `naorReingoldHybridGame` ($0 \le k \le n$), with exact endpoint
+     identities `naorReingoldHybridGame_zero` and `naorReingoldHybridGame_self`.
+   - The distributional single-level DDH distinguisher `naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher`
+     (which samples the $2^k$-entry prefix table `BitString k`) and adjacent-hop bound
+     `advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le`, the $n$-hybrid sum bound
+     `advantage_naorReingold_le_sum`, and the common-bound corollary `advantage_naorReingold_le_mul`

+     `PseudorandomFunction` bridge) remains open in #1093.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldExp`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldEval`:
+  the Naor–Reingold exponent product and PRF evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldPRG`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldStep`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldTreeEval`:
+  the single-step generator $G_{\mathrm{NR}}$ and augmented-tree evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldWordEval`:
+  polynomial-time evaluation on encoded group elements.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomize`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw`:
+  fixed-$u$ DDH rerandomization (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.8).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHRealTupleLaw`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw`:

+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldRealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldIdealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldHybridGame`:
+  real, ideal, and prefix-hybrid adaptive PRF experiments.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval`:
+  augmented-tree characterization of the Naor–Reingold PRF (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(a)).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordEval`:
+  plain polynomial-time certificate for word-level Naor–Reingold evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_real`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_ideal`:
+  fixed-$u$ DDH random self-reduction (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.8).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_multiDDH_le`:
+  $n = 1$ Multi-DDH (I) reduction to DDH, sampling $|\iota|$ rerandomized pairs
+  (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.11).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingold_le_sum`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingold_le_mul`:
+  distributional prefix-hybrid security bounds for the Naor–Reingold PRF against the explicit
+  $2^k$-pair PMF distinguisher `naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher` (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(b);
+  Naor–Reingold Theorem 4.1). The efficient lazy-sampling reduction (`IsOraclePPT` /
+  `PseudorandomFunction` bridge) remains open in #1093.
+
+## References
+
+* [D. Boneh, V. Shoup, *A Graduate Course in Applied Cryptography*,
+  Version 0.6][BonehShoup2023], Section 4.11 (Exercise 4.18, p. 172) and Section 10.11
+  (Exercises 10.4, 10.8, 10.11, pp. 424–426).
+* [M. Naor, O. Reingold, *Number-Theoretic Constructions of Efficient Pseudo-Random
+  Functions*][NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1 (Construction 4.1 & Theorem 4.1).

+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily
+
+open Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM
+open scoped ENNReal NNReal
+
+variable (F : PrimeOrderGroupFamily)
+
+/-! ### Naor–Reingold PRF and augmented-tree characterization (Exercise 10.4(a) & Exercise 4.18) -/
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold exponent product `α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, if x i then α i else 1` in
+`ZMod (F.order d)` ([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424;
+[NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1, Construction 4.1). -/
+def naorReingoldExp (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    ZMod (F.order d) :=
+  α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, if x i then α i else 1
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function
+`F_NR((α₀, α₁, …, αₙ), (x₁, …, xₙ)) = (α₀ * ∏ i, αᵢ^{xᵢ}) • g`
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424;
+[NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1, Construction 4.1). -/
+def naorReingoldEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α x • F.generator d
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_zero (d : F.Desc)
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin 0 → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString 0) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α x = α₀ := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_zero (d : F.Desc)
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin 0 → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString 0) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α x = α₀ • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_false (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α (fun _ => false) = α₀ := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_false (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α (fun _ => false) = α₀ • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_true (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α (fun _ => true) = α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, α i := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_true (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α (fun _ => true) = (α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, α i) • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold single-step generator `G_NR(α, u) := (u, α • u)` ([BonehShoup2023],
+Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424). -/
+def naorReingoldPRG (d : F.Desc) (α : ZMod (F.order d)) (u : F.Carrier d) :
+    F.Carrier d × F.Carrier d :=
+  (u, α • u)
+
+/-- One step of the augmented tree construction ([BonehShoup2023], Section 4.11, Exercise 4.18,
+p. 172, and Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424): select the `false` (`u`) or `true` (`α • u`)
+child of `naorReingoldPRG d α u`. -/
+def naorReingoldStep (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (p : ZMod (F.order d) × Bool) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  if p.2 then p.1 • u else u
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldStep_eq_prg (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (α : ZMod (F.order d)) (b : Bool) :
+    F.naorReingoldStep d u (α, b) =
+      if b then (F.naorReingoldPRG d α u).2 else (F.naorReingoldPRG d α u).1 :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- Augmented-tree evaluation of `naorReingoldStep` along a list of `(key, bit)` pairs starting
+from an initial group element `u`. -/
+def naorReingoldTreeFold (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d)
+    (steps : List (ZMod (F.order d) × Bool)) : F.Carrier d :=
+  steps.foldl (F.naorReingoldStep d) u
+
+/-- Augmented-tree evaluation of the Naor–Reingold PRF from root `α₀ • g` along `(α i, x i)` for
+`i : Fin n` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424, and Exercise 4.18, p. 172). -/
+def naorReingoldTreeEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  F.naorReingoldTreeFold d (α₀ • F.generator d) (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => (α i, x i))
+
+/-- Folding `naorReingoldStep` starting from `β • u` multiplies the scalar `β` by the product of
+selected step exponents. -/
+theorem naorReingoldTreeFold_smul (d : F.Desc) (β : ZMod (F.order d)) (u : F.Carrier d)
+    (steps : List (ZMod (F.order d) × Bool)) :
+    F.naorReingoldTreeFold d (β • u) steps =
+      (β * (steps.map fun p => if p.2 then p.1 else 1).prod) • u := by
+  induction steps generalizing β with
+  | nil => simp [naorReingoldTreeFold]
+  | cons p rest ih =>
+    have hstep : F.naorReingoldStep d (β • u) p = (β * if p.2 then p.1 else 1) • u := by
+      rcases p with ⟨a, _ | _⟩ <;> simp [naorReingoldStep, smul_smul, mul_comm]
+    rw [naorReingoldTreeFold, List.foldl_cons, ← naorReingoldTreeFold, hstep,
+      ih (β * if p.2 then p.1 else 1), List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]
+
+/-- **Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(a)**: the augmented-tree construction `naorReingoldTreeEval` built
+from `naorReingoldPRG` ($G_{\mathrm{NR}}(\alpha, u) = (u, \alpha \bullet u)$) coincides with
+`naorReingoldEval`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.naorReingoldTreeEval d α₀ α x = F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α x := by
+  rw [naorReingoldTreeEval, naorReingoldTreeFold_smul, naorReingoldEval, naorReingoldExp]
+  congr 2
+  rw [List.map_ofFn, Fin.prod_univ_def, List.prod_ofFn]
+  rfl
+
+/-! ### Word-level polynomial-time evaluation -/
+
+/-- Multiply the selected natural-number exponents in `steps` starting from `acc`. -/
+def naorReingoldProdNat (acc : ℕ) (steps : List (ℕ × Bool)) : ℕ :=
+  steps.foldl (fun e p => if p.2 then e * p.1 else e) acc
+
+/-- Casting `naorReingoldProdNat` to `ZMod q` equals `acc` times the product of selected step
+exponents in `ZMod q`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldProdNat_cast (q acc : ℕ) (steps : List (ℕ × Bool)) :
+    (naorReingoldProdNat acc steps : ZMod q) =
+      (acc : ZMod q) * (steps.map fun p => if p.2 then (p.1 : ZMod q) else 1).prod := by
+  induction steps generalizing acc with
+  | nil => simp [naorReingoldProdNat]
+  | cons p rest ih =>
+    rw [naorReingoldProdNat, List.foldl_cons, ← naorReingoldProdNat,
+      ih (if p.2 then acc * p.1 else acc), List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
+    rcases p with ⟨a, _ | _⟩ <;> simp [Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]
+
+/-- Word-level suffix evaluation of the Naor–Reingold tree from an encoded group element `u` along
+`αs` and `xs`. -/
+def naorReingoldWordSuffix (d : F.Desc) (u : List Bool) (αs : List ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :
+    List Bool :=
+  F.smul (d, naorReingoldProdNat 1 (αs.zip xs), u)
+
+/-- Word-level evaluation of the Naor–Reingold PRF on `(d, α₀, αs, xs)`. -/
+def naorReingoldWordEval (d : F.Desc) (α₀ : ℕ) (αs : List ℕ) (xs : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  F.smul (d, naorReingoldProdNat α₀ (αs.zip xs), F.encode d (F.generator d))
+
+/-- On an encoded group element `F.encode d u`, `naorReingoldWordSuffix` computes the encoding of
+`naorReingoldTreeFold`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldWordSuffix_encode (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (αs : List ℕ)
+    (xs : List Bool) :
+    F.naorReingoldWordSuffix d (F.encode d u) αs xs =
+      F.encode d (F.naorReingoldTreeFold d u
+        ((αs.zip xs).map fun p => ((p.1 : ZMod (F.order d)), p.2))) := by
+  obtain ⟨β, rfl⟩ := F.smul_generator_surjective d u
+  rw [naorReingoldWordSuffix, F.smul_encode, naorReingoldProdNat_cast, Nat.cast_one, one_mul,
+    naorReingoldTreeFold_smul, List.map_map, smul_smul, mul_comm]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Correctness of `naorReingoldWordEval` on an `n`-element exponent list `αs` and `n`-bit query
+`xs`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldWordEval_eq_encode (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ} (α₀ : ℕ)
+    (α : Fin n → ℕ) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.naorReingoldWordEval d α₀ (List.ofFn α) (List.ofFn x) =
+      F.encode d (F.naorReingoldEval d (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d))
+        (fun i => (α i : ZMod (F.order d))) x) := by
+  rw [naorReingoldWordEval, F.smul_encode, naorReingoldProdNat_cast, naorReingoldEval,
+    naorReingoldExp]
+  congr 2
+  have hzip : (List.ofFn α).zip (List.ofFn x) = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => (α i, x i)) := by
+    refine List.ext_getElem (by simp) fun i h₁ h₂ => ?_
+    simp
+  rw [hzip, List.map_ofFn, Fin.prod_univ_def, List.prod_ofFn]
+  rfl
+
+/-- `naorReingoldProdNat` is computable in polynomial time. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_naorReingoldProdNat :

+/-!
+# The Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function from Decisional Diffie–Hellman
+
+Over a `PrimeOrderGroupFamily` `F`, the Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424; [NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1,
+Construction 4.1 & Theorem 4.1) with key `(α₀, α₁, …, αₙ) ∈ (ZMod q)ⁿ⁺¹` maps an `n`-bit input
+`x ∈ {0, 1}ⁿ` to the group element
+$$F_{\mathrm{NR}}((\alpha_0, \alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_n), (x_1, \dots, x_n))
+  := \left(\alpha_0 \cdot \prod_{i=1}^n \alpha_i^{x_i}\right) \bullet g.$$
+
+Following Boneh–Shoup Exercises 10.4, 10.8, 10.11, and 4.18, we formalize:
+
+1. **Algebraic and augmented-tree characterization (`naorReingoldEval`, `naorReingoldTreeEval`)**:
+   - The closed-form exponent product `naorReingoldExp` and group evaluation `naorReingoldEval`.
+   - The single-step generator `naorReingoldPRG`
+     ($G_{\mathrm{NR}}(\alpha, u) = (u, \alpha \bullet u)$)
+     and augmented-tree fold `naorReingoldTreeEval`, together with
+     `naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424, and
+     Exercise 4.18, p. 172).
+   - The word-level evaluator `naorReingoldWordEval`, its correctness theorem
+     `naorReingoldWordEval_eq_encode`, and its plain polynomial-time certificate
+     `computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordEval`.
+2. **Fixed-$u$ DDH random self-reduction and Multi-DDH (I) (`ddhFixedURerandomize`,
+   `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw`)**:
+   - Fixed-$u$ rerandomization $(u, v, w) \mapsto (u, \sigma \bullet g + \tau \bullet v,
+     \sigma \bullet u + \tau \bullet w)$ ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.8, p. 425), its word-level
+     counterpart `ddhFixedUWordRerandomize`, and the exact distributional laws
+     `ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_real` (Exercise 10.8(a)) and `ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_ideal`
+     (Exercise 10.8(b)).
+   - The $n = 1$ (single shared secret $\alpha$, $|\iota|$ pairs) Multi-DDH (I) reduction
+     `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.11, p. 426), whose wrapper samples
+     $|\iota|$ rerandomized pairs, proving `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_real`,
+     `multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_ideal`, and the quantitative bound `advantage_multiDDH_le`
+     ($\le \mathrm{DDHadv}[B] + 1 / q$).
+3. **Naor–Reingold PRF prefix hybrids and distributional security bound (`naorReingoldRealGame`,
+   `naorReingoldIdealGame`, `naorReingoldHybridGame`)**:
+   - The adaptive oracle experiments `naorReingoldRealGame`, `naorReingoldIdealGame`, and the
+     depth-$k$ prefix hybrids `naorReingoldHybridGame` ($0 \le k \le n$), with exact endpoint
+     identities `naorReingoldHybridGame_zero` and `naorReingoldHybridGame_self`.
+   - The distributional single-level DDH distinguisher `naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher`
+     (which samples the $2^k$-entry prefix table `BitString k`) and adjacent-hop bound
+     `advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le`, the $n$-hybrid sum bound
+     `advantage_naorReingold_le_sum`, and the common-bound corollary `advantage_naorReingold_le_mul`
+     ($\le n \cdot (\varepsilon + 1 / q)$). The efficient lazy-sampling reduction (`IsOraclePPT` /
+     `PseudorandomFunction` bridge) remains open in #1093.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldExp`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldEval`:
+  the Naor–Reingold exponent product and PRF evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldPRG`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldStep`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldTreeEval`:
+  the single-step generator $G_{\mathrm{NR}}$ and augmented-tree evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldWordEval`:
+  polynomial-time evaluation on encoded group elements.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomize`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw`:
+  fixed-$u$ DDH rerandomization (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.8).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHRealTupleLaw`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw`:
+  $n = 1$ Multi-DDH (I) distributions and rerandomization (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.11).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldRealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldIdealGame`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldHybridGame`:
+  real, ideal, and prefix-hybrid adaptive PRF experiments.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval`:
+  augmented-tree characterization of the Naor–Reingold PRF (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(a)).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordEval`:
+  plain polynomial-time certificate for word-level Naor–Reingold evaluation.
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_real`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_ideal`:
+  fixed-$u$ DDH random self-reduction (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.8).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_multiDDH_le`:
+  $n = 1$ Multi-DDH (I) reduction to DDH, sampling $|\iota|$ rerandomized pairs
+  (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.11).
+* `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingold_le_sum`,
+  `Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily.advantage_naorReingold_le_mul`:
+  distributional prefix-hybrid security bounds for the Naor–Reingold PRF against the explicit
+  $2^k$-pair PMF distinguisher `naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher` (Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(b);
+  Naor–Reingold Theorem 4.1). The efficient lazy-sampling reduction (`IsOraclePPT` /
+  `PseudorandomFunction` bridge) remains open in #1093.
+
+## References
+
+* [D. Boneh, V. Shoup, *A Graduate Course in Applied Cryptography*,
+  Version 0.6][BonehShoup2023], Section 4.11 (Exercise 4.18, p. 172) and Section 10.11
+  (Exercises 10.4, 10.8, 10.11, pp. 424–426).
+* [M. Naor, O. Reingold, *Number-Theoretic Constructions of Efficient Pseudo-Random
+  Functions*][NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1 (Construction 4.1 & Theorem 4.1).
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily
+
+open Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM
+open scoped ENNReal NNReal
+
+variable (F : PrimeOrderGroupFamily)
+
+/-! ### Naor–Reingold PRF and augmented-tree characterization (Exercise 10.4(a) & Exercise 4.18) -/
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold exponent product `α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, if x i then α i else 1` in
+`ZMod (F.order d)` ([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424;
+[NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1, Construction 4.1). -/
+def naorReingoldExp (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    ZMod (F.order d) :=
+  α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, if x i then α i else 1
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold pseudorandom function
+`F_NR((α₀, α₁, …, αₙ), (x₁, …, xₙ)) = (α₀ * ∏ i, αᵢ^{xᵢ}) • g`
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4, p. 424;
+[NaorReingold2004], Section 4.1, Construction 4.1). -/
+def naorReingoldEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α x • F.generator d
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_zero (d : F.Desc)
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin 0 → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString 0) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α x = α₀ := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_zero (d : F.Desc)
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin 0 → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString 0) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α x = α₀ • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_false (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α (fun _ => false) = α₀ := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_false (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α (fun _ => false) = α₀ • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldExp_true (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldExp d α₀ α (fun _ => true) = α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, α i := by
+  simp [naorReingoldExp]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldEval_true (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) :
+    F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α (fun _ => true) = (α₀ * ∏ i : Fin n, α i) • F.generator d := by
+  simp [naorReingoldEval]
+
+/-- The Naor–Reingold single-step generator `G_NR(α, u) := (u, α • u)` ([BonehShoup2023],
+Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424). -/
+def naorReingoldPRG (d : F.Desc) (α : ZMod (F.order d)) (u : F.Carrier d) :
+    F.Carrier d × F.Carrier d :=
+  (u, α • u)
+
+/-- One step of the augmented tree construction ([BonehShoup2023], Section 4.11, Exercise 4.18,
+p. 172, and Section 10.11, Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424): select the `false` (`u`) or `true` (`α • u`)
+child of `naorReingoldPRG d α u`. -/
+def naorReingoldStep (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (p : ZMod (F.order d) × Bool) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  if p.2 then p.1 • u else u
+
+@[simp]
+theorem naorReingoldStep_eq_prg (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (α : ZMod (F.order d)) (b : Bool) :
+    F.naorReingoldStep d u (α, b) =
+      if b then (F.naorReingoldPRG d α u).2 else (F.naorReingoldPRG d α u).1 :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- Augmented-tree evaluation of `naorReingoldStep` along a list of `(key, bit)` pairs starting
+from an initial group element `u`. -/
+def naorReingoldTreeFold (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d)
+    (steps : List (ZMod (F.order d) × Bool)) : F.Carrier d :=
+  steps.foldl (F.naorReingoldStep d) u
+
+/-- Augmented-tree evaluation of the Naor–Reingold PRF from root `α₀ • g` along `(α i, x i)` for
+`i : Fin n` ([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.4(a), p. 424, and Exercise 4.18, p. 172). -/
+def naorReingoldTreeEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.Carrier d :=
+  F.naorReingoldTreeFold d (α₀ • F.generator d) (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => (α i, x i))
+
+/-- Folding `naorReingoldStep` starting from `β • u` multiplies the scalar `β` by the product of
+selected step exponents. -/
+theorem naorReingoldTreeFold_smul (d : F.Desc) (β : ZMod (F.order d)) (u : F.Carrier d)
+    (steps : List (ZMod (F.order d) × Bool)) :
+    F.naorReingoldTreeFold d (β • u) steps =
+      (β * (steps.map fun p => if p.2 then p.1 else 1).prod) • u := by
+  induction steps generalizing β with
+  | nil => simp [naorReingoldTreeFold]
+  | cons p rest ih =>
+    have hstep : F.naorReingoldStep d (β • u) p = (β * if p.2 then p.1 else 1) • u := by
+      rcases p with ⟨a, _ | _⟩ <;> simp [naorReingoldStep, smul_smul, mul_comm]
+    rw [naorReingoldTreeFold, List.foldl_cons, ← naorReingoldTreeFold, hstep,
+      ih (β * if p.2 then p.1 else 1), List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]
+
+/-- **Boneh–Shoup Exercise 10.4(a)**: the augmented-tree construction `naorReingoldTreeEval` built
+from `naorReingoldPRG` ($G_{\mathrm{NR}}(\alpha, u) = (u, \alpha \bullet u)$) coincides with
+`naorReingoldEval`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldTreeEval_eq_naorReingoldEval (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ}
+    (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d)) (α : Fin n → ZMod (F.order d)) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.naorReingoldTreeEval d α₀ α x = F.naorReingoldEval d α₀ α x := by
+  rw [naorReingoldTreeEval, naorReingoldTreeFold_smul, naorReingoldEval, naorReingoldExp]
+  congr 2
+  rw [List.map_ofFn, Fin.prod_univ_def, List.prod_ofFn]
+  rfl
+
+/-! ### Word-level polynomial-time evaluation -/
+
+/-- Multiply the selected natural-number exponents in `steps` starting from `acc`. -/
+def naorReingoldProdNat (acc : ℕ) (steps : List (ℕ × Bool)) : ℕ :=
+  steps.foldl (fun e p => if p.2 then e * p.1 else e) acc
+
+/-- Casting `naorReingoldProdNat` to `ZMod q` equals `acc` times the product of selected step
+exponents in `ZMod q`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldProdNat_cast (q acc : ℕ) (steps : List (ℕ × Bool)) :
+    (naorReingoldProdNat acc steps : ZMod q) =
+      (acc : ZMod q) * (steps.map fun p => if p.2 then (p.1 : ZMod q) else 1).prod := by
+  induction steps generalizing acc with
+  | nil => simp [naorReingoldProdNat]
+  | cons p rest ih =>
+    rw [naorReingoldProdNat, List.foldl_cons, ← naorReingoldProdNat,
+      ih (if p.2 then acc * p.1 else acc), List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
+    rcases p with ⟨a, _ | _⟩ <;> simp [Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]
+
+/-- Word-level suffix evaluation of the Naor–Reingold tree from an encoded group element `u` along
+`αs` and `xs`. -/
+def naorReingoldWordSuffix (d : F.Desc) (u : List Bool) (αs : List ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :
+    List Bool :=
+  F.smul (d, naorReingoldProdNat 1 (αs.zip xs), u)
+
+/-- Word-level evaluation of the Naor–Reingold PRF on `(d, α₀, αs, xs)`. -/
+def naorReingoldWordEval (d : F.Desc) (α₀ : ℕ) (αs : List ℕ) (xs : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  F.smul (d, naorReingoldProdNat α₀ (αs.zip xs), F.encode d (F.generator d))
+
+/-- On an encoded group element `F.encode d u`, `naorReingoldWordSuffix` computes the encoding of
+`naorReingoldTreeFold`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldWordSuffix_encode (d : F.Desc) (u : F.Carrier d) (αs : List ℕ)
+    (xs : List Bool) :
+    F.naorReingoldWordSuffix d (F.encode d u) αs xs =
+      F.encode d (F.naorReingoldTreeFold d u
+        ((αs.zip xs).map fun p => ((p.1 : ZMod (F.order d)), p.2))) := by
+  obtain ⟨β, rfl⟩ := F.smul_generator_surjective d u
+  rw [naorReingoldWordSuffix, F.smul_encode, naorReingoldProdNat_cast, Nat.cast_one, one_mul,
+    naorReingoldTreeFold_smul, List.map_map, smul_smul, mul_comm]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Correctness of `naorReingoldWordEval` on an `n`-element exponent list `αs` and `n`-bit query
+`xs`. -/
+theorem naorReingoldWordEval_eq_encode (d : F.Desc) {n : ℕ} (α₀ : ℕ)
+    (α : Fin n → ℕ) (x : BitString n) :
+    F.naorReingoldWordEval d α₀ (List.ofFn α) (List.ofFn x) =
+      F.encode d (F.naorReingoldEval d (α₀ : ZMod (F.order d))
+        (fun i => (α i : ZMod (F.order d))) x) := by
+  rw [naorReingoldWordEval, F.smul_encode, naorReingoldProdNat_cast, naorReingoldEval,
+    naorReingoldExp]
+  congr 2
+  have hzip : (List.ofFn α).zip (List.ofFn x) = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => (α i, x i)) := by
+    refine List.ext_getElem (by simp) fun i h₁ h₂ => ?_
+    simp
+  rw [hzip, List.map_ofFn, Fin.prod_univ_def, List.prod_ofFn]
+  rfl
+
+/-- `naorReingoldProdNat` is computable in polynomial time. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_naorReingoldProdNat :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : ℕ × List (ℕ × Bool) => naorReingoldProdNat input.1 input.2)
+      (encPair encNat (encList (encPair encNat encBool))) encNat := by
+  unfold naorReingoldProdNat
+  refine ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.foldlWith_of_bounded_growth
+    (encA := encPair encNat encBool) (encL := encList (encPair encNat encBool))
+    (encB := encNat) (encP := encBool)
+    (par := fun _ => false) (list := Prod.snd) (init := Prod.fst)
+    (step := fun _ e p => if p.2 then e * p.1 else e)
+    (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
+    (growth := fun input => (encList (encPair encNat encBool) input.2).length)
+    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _).polyBounded_length ?_
+  intro input state value hmem
+  have hval : value.1.size ≤ (encList (encPair encNat encBool) input.2).length := by
+    rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len, ← encNat_apply]
+    have h1 : (encNat value.1).length ≤ (encPair encNat encBool value).length := by
+      simp only [length_encPair]
+      omega
+    exact h1.trans (length_le_encList_of_mem (encPair encNat encBool) hmem)
+  rcases value with ⟨v, _ | _⟩
+  · simp
+  · simp only [↓reduceIte, encNat_apply, Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
+    exact (Nat.size_mul_le state v).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left hval _)
+
+/-- `naorReingoldWordSuffix` is computable in polynomial time. -/
+theorem computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordSuffix :
+    ComputableInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool =>
+        F.naorReingoldWordSuffix input.1 input.2.1 input.2.2.1 input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encBits := by
+  have hd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool => input.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) F.encDesc := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hu : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encBits := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hαs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits)))
+      (encList encNat) := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hxs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits)))
+      (encList encBool) :=
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsToList.comp (by fun_prop)
+  have hzip : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.1.zip input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits)))
+      (encList (encPair encNat encBool)) :=
+    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.zip encNat encBool).comp (hαs.prod hxs)
+  have hprod : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List ℕ × List Bool =>
+        naorReingoldProdNat 1 (input.2.2.1.zip input.2.2.2))
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encNat :=
+    computableTidilyInPolyTime_naorReingoldProdNat.comp
+      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1).prod hzip)
+  exact ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy
+    (F.computableInPolyTime_smul.tidy.comp (hd.prod (hprod.prod hu)))
+
+/-- `naorReingoldWordEval` is computable in polynomial time. -/
+theorem computableInPolyTime_naorReingoldWordEval :
+    ComputableInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool =>
+        F.naorReingoldWordEval input.1 input.2.1 input.2.2.1 input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encBits := by
+  have hd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => input.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) F.encDesc := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hα₀ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encNat := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hαs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.1)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) (encList encNat) := by
+    fun_prop
+  have hxs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits)))
+      (encList encBool) :=
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsToList.comp (by fun_prop)
+  have hzip : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => input.2.2.1.zip input.2.2.2)
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits)))
+      (encList (encPair encNat encBool)) :=
+    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.zip encNat encBool).comp (hαs.prod hxs)
+  have hprod : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool =>
+        naorReingoldProdNat input.2.1 (input.2.2.1.zip input.2.2.2))
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encNat :=
+    computableTidilyInPolyTime_naorReingoldProdNat.comp (hα₀.prod hzip)
+  have hgen : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun input : F.Desc × ℕ × List ℕ × List Bool => F.encode input.1 (F.generator input.1))
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat (encPair (encList encNat) encBits))) encBits :=
+    F.computableInPolyTime_generator.tidy.comp hd
+  exact ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy
+    (F.computableInPolyTime_smul.tidy.comp (hd.prod (hprod.prod hgen)))
+
+/-! ### Fixed-$u$ DDH random self-reduction and Multi-DDH (I) (Exercises 10.8 & 10.11) -/
+
+/-- Fixed-$u$ DDH rerandomization ([BonehShoup2023], Section 10.11, Exercise 10.8, p. 425):
+given `(u, v, w)` and exponents `σ, τ : ZMod (F.order d)`, output
+`(v*, w*) = (σ • g + τ • v, σ • u + τ • w)`. -/
+def ddhFixedURerandomize (d : F.Desc) (u v w : F.Carrier d)

+module

+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CollisionResistant
+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.ProjectiveHash
+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.DiffieHellman
+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.ElGamal
