+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 Renfei Zhou. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Renfei Zhou
+-/
+
+-- upstream: local-only (formal abstract library)
+
+import ComplexityAbstracts.Check
+import ComplexityAbstracts.RandomizedWordRAMBridge
+import Cslib.Probability.PMF
+import Mathlib.Data.List.Sort
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log
+
+/-! # The randomized word RAM and in-place quicksort: a formal abstract
+
+This file states the randomized word-RAM model, its worst-case and expected running time, and the
+correctness and cost bounds of randomized in-place three-way quicksort.
+
+At word size `w`, a *word* is a natural number below `2 ^ w`. A machine has `r` registers
+`R[0], …, R[r - 1]` and memory `M[a]` for `a : ℕ`. Its ten deterministic instructions, `init`, and
+`InputFits` match `WordRAMAbstract` (restated because an abstract cannot import another abstract,
+and in-place algorithms inspect final memory at `halt`). Alongside them, `rand d i` reads
+`n = R[i]`, faults when `n ≥ 2 ^ w`, and otherwise draws a uniform integer in `{0, …, n}` into
+`R[d]` in one step and one random call (`n = 0` returns `0` and still counts as one call).
+
+Simplifications relative to `Cslib.WordRAM` and `Cslib.Algorithms.WordRAM.Quicksort`:
+
+* `AluOp` fixes `Basis.exact` (as in `WordRAMAbstract`) instead of a general `Basis`. The bridge
+  lifts `Quicksort` from `Basis.standard` because it uses no division or remainder and no reached
+  subtraction underflows.
+* `Instr` lists the eleven flat instructions directly instead of `Op`, `Cond`, and `Code`.
+* `Comp` specializes `ProbComp` to finite-depth uniform trees over `Fin (n + 1)` with direct
+  `CallsAtMost` and `Comp.eval` (`RandBitsBounded` stays in the library).
+* `State` and `Cfg.halted` carry `reg` and `mem` directly without `Data`, keeping final registers
+  and memory at `halt` for in-place postconditions.
+* Array slices and unchanged memory use `slice` and address bounds instead of `Block.Realizes` and
+  `Modifies`, and `logWidth 3 n` is written inline as `3 * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)`.
+
+Lean checks the proofs via `RandomizedWordRAMBridge` under `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and
+`Quot.sound`; `#check_abstract` verifies zero allowlisted project modules.
+
+## References
+
+* [T. H. Cormen, C. E. Leiserson, R. L. Rivest and C. Stein, *Introduction to
+  Algorithms*][CLRS2009]
+* [M. L. Fredman and D. E. Willard, *Surpassing the information theoretic bound with fusion
+  trees*][FredmanWillard1993]
+* [M. Mitzenmacher and E. Upfal, *Probability and Computing*][MitzenmacherUpfal2017]
+-/
+
+namespace ComplexityAbstracts.RandomizedWordRAMAbstract
+
+/-! ## Words, operations, and instructions
+
+Each arithmetic, bitwise, or shift operation in `AluOp` computes its exact value on natural
+numbers, returning `none` where undefined (`x - y` when `y > x`, and `x / 0` and `x % 0`). In
+`AluOp.eval`, a bare natural number stands for `some n`. The instruction `rand d i` draws a
+uniform integer in `{0, …, R[i]}`.
+-/
+
+/-- The ten exact binary operations on natural numbers. -/
+inductive AluOp
+  | add | sub | mul | div | mod | and | or | xor | shl | shr
+
+/-- Exact value of a binary operation before word-range checking, or `none` when undefined. -/
+def AluOp.eval : AluOp → ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ
+  | .add, x, y => x + y
+  | .sub, x, y => if y ≤ x then x - y else none
+  | .mul, x, y => x * y
+  | .div, x, y => if y = 0 then none else x / y
+  | .mod, x, y => if y = 0 then none else x % y
+  | .and, x, y => x &&& y
+  | .or, x, y => x ||| y
+  | .xor, x, y => x ^^^ y
+  | .shl, x, y => some (x * 2 ^ y)
+  | .shr, x, y => some (x / 2 ^ y)
+
+/-- Instructions over `r` registers: ten deterministic instructions and bounded random sampling
+`rand`. -/
+inductive Instr (r : ℕ)
+  | const (d : Fin r) (x : ℕ)         -- R[d] := x
+  | copy (d i : Fin r)                -- R[d] := R[i]
+  | alu (f : AluOp) (d i j : Fin r)   -- R[d] := f(R[i], R[j])
+  | width (d : Fin r)                 -- R[d] := w, the word size
+  | load (d a : Fin r)                -- R[d] := M[R[a]]
+  | store (a i : Fin r)               -- M[R[a]] := R[i]
+  | jump (t : ℕ)                      -- go to instruction t
+  | branchEq (i j : Fin r) (t : ℕ)    -- go to t if R[i] = R[j], else next
+  | branchLt (i j : Fin r) (t : ℕ)    -- go to t if R[i] < R[j], else next
+  | halt (i : Fin r)                  -- stop with output R[i]
+  | rand (d i : Fin r)                -- R[d] ← uniform on {0, …, R[i]}
+
+/-- A program over `r` registers is a list of instructions indexed from `0`. -/
+abbrev Program (r : ℕ) := List (Instr r)
+
+/-! ## Finite-depth uniform sampling trees
+
+A clocked execution builds a finite-depth tree `Comp α` of uniform draws `sample n next` over
+`Fin (n + 1)` (`{0, …, n}`). Keeping the tree separates output distributions from pathwise call
+counts, including `rand` on `0` whose output distribution is a point mass. `Comp.eval` maps a tree
+to a discrete probability distribution (`PMF α`), and `Comp.CallsAtMost m R` states that every
+branch makes at most `R` draws.
+-/
+
+/-- A finite-depth computation tree whose random choices draw uniformly from `Fin (n + 1)`. -/
+inductive Comp (α : Type) : Type
+  | pure (a : α)
+  | sample (n : ℕ) (next : Fin (n + 1) → Comp α)
+
+/-- Sequential composition of sampling trees. -/
+def Comp.bind {α β : Type} : Comp α → (α → Comp β) → Comp β
+  | .pure a, f => f a
+  | .sample n next, f => .sample n fun k => (next k).bind f
+
+/-- Probability distribution induced by answering every `sample n` uniformly on `Fin (n + 1)`. -/
+noncomputable def Comp.eval {α : Type} : Comp α → PMF α
+  | .pure a => PMF.pure a
+  | .sample n next =>
+    (Cslib.Probability.PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (n + 1))).bind fun k =>
+      (next k).eval
+
+/-- Every branch of `m` performs at most `R` random draws. -/
+def Comp.CallsAtMost {α : Type} : Comp α → ℕ → Prop
+  | .pure _, _ => True
+  | .sample _ _, 0 => False
+  | .sample _ next, R + 1 => ∀ k, (next k).CallsAtMost R
+
+/-! ## Configurations, clocked runs, and cost measures
+
+A configuration is `running` at a `State`, `halted` with scalar output `v` alongside final registers
+`reg` and memory `mem`, or `faulted`. Both `halted` and `faulted` are absorbing: further clock ticks
+leave them unchanged and make zero `rand` calls.
+
+At an active state `s`, `rand d i` faults when `s.reg i ≥ 2 ^ w`. When `s.reg i < 2 ^ w`, it draws
+`k` uniformly from `Fin (s.reg i + 1)` (`{0, …, s.reg i}`), writes `k` to `R[d]`, and advances `pc`
+to `pc + 1` in one step and one `sample` node.
+
+Expected running time `expectedTime w p s` takes values in the extended nonnegative reals `ENNReal`
+(`[0, ∞]`). It sums over `t : ℕ` the probability that the configuration after `t` steps is
+`running`. Because `halted` and `faulted` are absorbing, a branch that halts after `n` steps is
+`running` at horizons `0, 1, …, n - 1` and contributes `n`, while non-terminating mass contributes
+`∞`.
+-/
+
+/-- Machine state: instruction index `pc`, registers `reg`, and memory `mem`. -/
+structure State (r : ℕ) where
+  /-- Index of the next instruction. -/
+  pc : ℕ
+  /-- Register file `R[0], …, R[r - 1]`. -/
+  reg : Fin r → ℕ
+  /-- Unbounded natural-addressed memory `M[a]`. -/
+  mem : ℕ → ℕ
+
+/-- Configuration of a clocked randomized run: active, halted with final data, or faulted. -/
+inductive Cfg (r : ℕ)
+  | running (s : State r)
+  | halted (v : ℕ) (reg : Fin r → ℕ) (mem : ℕ → ℕ)
+  | faulted
+
+/-- One step of program `p` at word size `w`. Halted and faulted configurations are absorbing. -/
+def stepRand {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r) : Cfg r → Comp (Cfg r)
+  | .halted v reg mem => .pure (.halted v reg mem)
+  | .faulted => .pure .faulted
+  | .running s =>
+    let next (d : Fin r) (x : ℕ) : Comp (Cfg r) :=
+      .pure (.running
+        { s with pc := s.pc + 1, reg := Function.update s.reg d x })
+    let nextWord (d : Fin r) (x : ℕ) : Comp (Cfg r) :=
+      if x < 2 ^ w then next d x else .pure .faulted
+    match p[s.pc]? with
+    | none => .pure .faulted
+    | some (.const d x) => nextWord d x
+    | some (.copy d i) => next d (s.reg i)
+    | some (.alu f d i j) =>
+      match f.eval (s.reg i) (s.reg j) with
+      | some x => nextWord d x
+      | none => .pure .faulted
+    | some (.width d) => next d w
+    | some (.load d a) => next d (s.mem (s.reg a))
+    | some (.store a i) =>
+      .pure (.running { s with
+        pc := s.pc + 1
+        mem := Function.update s.mem (s.reg a) (s.reg i) })
+    | some (.jump t) => .pure (.running { s with pc := t })
+    | some (.branchEq i j t) =>
+      .pure (.running
+        { s with pc := if s.reg i = s.reg j then t else s.pc + 1 })
+    | some (.branchLt i j t) =>
+      .pure (.running
+        { s with pc := if s.reg i < s.reg j then t else s.pc + 1 })
+    | some (.halt i) => .pure (.halted (s.reg i) s.reg s.mem)
+    | some (.rand d i) =>
+      if s.reg i < 2 ^ w then
+        .sample (s.reg i) fun k => next d k.val
+      else .pure .faulted
+
+/-- Clocked `T`-step sampling tree from configuration `cfg`. -/
+def runRand {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r) : ℕ → Cfg r → Comp (Cfg r)
+  | 0, cfg => .pure cfg
+  | T + 1, cfg => (stepRand w p cfg).bind (runRand w p T)
+
+/-- Distribution over configurations after `T` steps starting from state `s`. -/
+noncomputable def evalRand {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r) (T : ℕ)
+    (s : State r) : PMF (Cfg r) :=
+  (runRand w p T (.running s)).eval
+
+/-- Every positive-probability outcome after `T` steps from `s` has halted cleanly. -/
+def HaltsWithin {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r) (s : State r) (T : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ cfg ∈ (evalRand w p T s).support, ∃ v reg mem, cfg = .halted v reg mem
+
+/-- Every execution branch over `T` steps from `s` makes at most `R` `rand` calls. -/
+def RandCallsBounded {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r) (s : State r)
+    (T R : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  (runRand w p T (.running s)).CallsAtMost R
+
+/-- Expected running time in `ENNReal`, as the sum over `t` of the probability of still running. -/
+noncomputable def expectedTime {r : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (p : Program r)
+    (s : State r) : ENNReal :=
+  ∑' t : ℕ,
+    (evalRand w p t s).toOuterMeasure {cfg | ∃ u, cfg = .running u}
+
+/-! ## Input convention, memory slices, and randomized quicksort
+
+An input `x₁, …, xₖ` starts at `init` with `M[0] = k`, `M[1] = x₁, …, M[k] = xₖ`, and `0`
+elsewhere; `slice a b mem` reads `[M[a], …, M[b - 1]]`. One fixed 16-register program sorts in
+place by iterative three-way randomized quicksort (splitting around a random pivot into `<`, `=`,
+and `>`), using `M[n + 1 .. 3 n + 1)` as a `2 n`-word stack. At word size
+`w ≥ 3 * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)` (`Nat.log 2 0 = 0`, so `w ≥ 3` addresses `3 n + 3` for all `n`) on any
+word-fitting input, every branch halts within `20 n² + 8 n + 32` steps and `n - 1` `rand` calls,
+leaving a sorted (`Pairwise (· ≤ ·)`) permutation of `input` in `M[1 .. n + 1)` and preserving
+memory outside `1, …, 3 n`. Across all inputs, including duplicates, its expected running time is at
+most `120 n (Nat.log 2 n + 1) + 32`.
+-/
+
+/-- Start state on `input = [x₁, …, xₖ]`: `pc = 0`, registers `0`, `M[0] = k`, `M[1..k] = input`. -/
+def init {r : ℕ} (input : List ℕ) : State r :=
+  ⟨0, fun _ => 0, fun a => (input.length :: input).getD a 0⟩
+
+/-- An input fits word size `w` when its length and every element are words below `2 ^ w`. -/
+def InputFits (w : ℕ) (input : List ℕ) : Prop :=
+  input.length < 2 ^ w ∧ ∀ x ∈ input, x < 2 ^ w
+
+/-- The memory slice `[mem a, mem (a + 1), …, mem (b - 1)]` of length `b - a`. -/
+def slice (a b : ℕ) (mem : ℕ → ℕ) : List ℕ :=
+  (List.range (b - a)).map fun i => mem (a + i)
+
+/-- **In-place randomized quicksort.** One fixed 16-register program sorts every word-fitting input
+of length `n` in place at word size `w ≥ 3 * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)`. Every branch halts within
+`20 n² + 8 n + 32` steps and `n - 1` `rand` calls with a sorted permutation of `input` in
+`M[1 .. n + 1)` and memory outside `1, …, 3 n` unchanged. Expected running time is at most
+`120 n (Nat.log 2 n + 1) + 32`. -/
+theorem quicksort :
+    ∃ p : Program 16,
+      ∀ (w : ℕ) (input : List ℕ),
+        3 * (Nat.log 2 input.length + 1) ≤ w →
+        InputFits w input →
+        let n := input.length
+        let T := 20 * n ^ 2 + 8 * n + 32
+        HaltsWithin w p (init input) T ∧
+        RandCallsBounded w p (init input) T (n - 1) ∧
+        (∀ cfg ∈ (evalRand w p T (init input)).support,
+          ∃ reg mem, cfg = .halted 0 reg mem ∧
+            (∀ i, reg i < 2 ^ w) ∧
+            (∀ a, mem a < 2 ^ w) ∧
+            (slice 1 (n + 1) mem).Perm input ∧
+            (slice 1 (n + 1) mem).Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ∧
+            (∀ a, a < 1 ∨ 3 * n + 1 ≤ a →
+              mem a = (init (r := 16) input).mem a)) ∧
+        expectedTime w p (init input) ≤
+          ((120 * n * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) + 32 : ℕ) : ENNReal) :=
+  RandomizedWordRAMBridge.quicksort
+    ⟨AluOp, .add, .sub, .mul, .div, .mod, .and, .or, .xor, .shl, .shr,
+      @AluOp.rec, AluOp.eval,
+      Instr, .const, .copy, .alu, .width, .load, .store, .jump,
+      .branchEq, .branchLt, .halt, .rand, @Instr.rec,
+      Comp, @Comp.pure, @Comp.sample, @Comp.bind, @Comp.eval,
+      @Comp.CallsAtMost,
+      State, .mk, Cfg, .running, .halted, .faulted, @stepRand, @runRand⟩
+    (by refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
+        ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
+        ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
+      simp_all [AluOp.eval, Comp.bind, Comp.eval, Comp.CallsAtMost,
+        stepRand, runRand])
+
+/--
+info: 'ComplexityAbstracts.RandomizedWordRAMAbstract.quicksort' depends on axioms:
+[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
+-/
+#guard_msgs (whitespace := lax) in
+#print axioms quicksort

+noncomputable def cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n

+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))

+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))

+  let pkVal := F.cramerShoupPublicKey d α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKeyValues d pkVal
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1

+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))

+/-- **Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, printed p. 490, adapted to
+$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): draw `(α, β)` and `sk` uniformly from `ZMod q`, and compute the
+challenge ciphertext from `(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` using the secret key via
+`encodeCramerShoupChallenge`. -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupGame1
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d ((α * β) • F.generator d)
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+/-- **Game 0 = Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, equation (12.21), printed p. 490):

+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]

+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]

+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]

+  have htri2 := Game.advantage_triangle g₂ g₃ g₄
+  rw [Game.advantage_comm g₁ g₂] at htri1

+/-- **Game 1 $\to$ Game 2 bound** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, equation (12.22), printed

+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +

+    (F.advantage_ddhRealGame_cramerShoupGame1_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n)

+/-- Exact-exponent collision game matching the collision event between `cramerShoupGame2` and
+`cramerShoupGame3`. -/
+private noncomputable def cramerShoupExactCollisionGame
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n

+  let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let γ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)

+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))

+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct) none
+      (fun cand => isCollisionFor (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) n d

+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun β => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun γ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun σ => ?_

+        (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret

+      (fun req hbad => by simp [cramerShoupPhase2Reply, cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Reply, hbad])
+      (fun req hbad => by

+private theorem succProbability_cramerShoupExactCollisionGame_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    Game.succProbability
+      (F.cramerShoupExactCollisionGame encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      9 / 2 ^ n := by
+  let C := F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit
+  have hadv :
+      Game.advantage
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) C n)
+        (F.cramerShoupExactCollisionGame encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤
+      9 / 2 ^ n := by
+    unfold collisionGameFor cramerShoupExactCollisionGame C cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder
+    simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_bind,
+      F.smul_encode]
+    refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (setup n) _ _ fun d => ?_
+    let kZMod (α β γ σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂ : ZMod (F.order d)) : Game :=
+      let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+      let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+      let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+      let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)
+      let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+      (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+          (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+        (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())).bind fun choiceOut =>
+        let choice := choiceOut.1
+        if isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)) && isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)) then
+          let m := if bit then encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2) else encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+          let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+          runFinderOracle (F.cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Reply H isElem d sk ct)
+            (fun req => F.isCramerShoupCollision H d req ct) extractCramerShoupTriple
+            (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct) none
+            (fun cand => isCollisionFor (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) n d
+              cand (extractCramerShoupTriple ct))
+        else PMF.pure false
+    let kTriple (α β γ : ZMod (F.order d)) : Game :=
+      (ProbComp.eval (F.sampleCramerShoupSK n d)).bind fun sk =>
+        let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+        let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+        let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)
+        let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+        (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+            (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+          (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())).bind fun choiceOut =>
+          let choice := choiceOut.1
+          (ProbComp.eval
+            (if isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)) && isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)) then
+              let m := if bit then encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2) else encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+              let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+              ((OracleComp.interpret
+                (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+                  (F.cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+                (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run none) >>= fun out =>
+                let target := extractCramerShoupTriple ct
+                pure (out.2.getD target, target)
+            else pure ([], []))).bind fun pair =>
+            PMF.pure (isCollisionFor (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) n d pair.1 pair.2)
+    have hstep1 := F.advantage_bind_sampleCramerShoupTripleExponents_le n d kTriple
+    have hstep2 :
+        Game.advantage
+          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α =>
+            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β =>
+              (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ => kTriple α β γ)
+          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α =>
+            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β =>
+              (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
+                (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun σ =>
+                  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun τ =>
+                    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun σ₁ =>
+                      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun τ₁ =>
+                        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun σ₂ =>
+                          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun τ₂ =>
+                            kZMod α β γ σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂) ≤
+          6 / 2 ^ n := by
+      refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun α => ?_
+      refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun β => ?_
+      refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun γ => ?_
+      refine F.advantage_bind_sampleCramerShoupSK_le n d _ (kZMod α β γ)
+        fun s t s₁ t₁ s₂ t₂ => ?_
+      dsimp only [kZMod]
+      rw [F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey_eq_skNatOfZMod d α ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+        F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+      refine congrArg _ (funext fun choiceOut => ?_)
+      by_cases h : (isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)) &&
+          isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true
+      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.bind_bind,
+          PMF.pure_bind]
+        rw [F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge_eq_skNatOfZMod H d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+          F.cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d
+            ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+        unfold runFinderOracle cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Oracle
+        refine congrArg _ (funext fun out => ?_)
+        cases out.2 with
+        | none => simp
+        | some cand => rfl
+      · simp only [h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.pure_bind]
+        rfl
+    exact ((Game.advantage_triangle _ _ _).trans (add_le_add hstep1 hstep2)).trans_eq (by ring)
+  have htri := Game.advantage_triangle
+    (F.cramerShoupExactCollisionGame encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n)
+    (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) C n)
+    (PMF.pure false)
+  rw [Game.advantage_pure_false, Game.advantage_pure_false,
+    Game.advantage_comm (F.cramerShoupExactCollisionGame encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n),
+    add_comm] at htri
+  exact htri.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hadv)
+
+/-- **Game 2 $\to$ Game 3 bound** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, equations (12.24)–(12.25),
+printed p. 492, adapted to $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): the distinguishing advantage between
+`cramerShoupGame2` and `cramerShoupGame3` is bounded by the collision-finding success probability of
+`cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder` plus `9 / 2 ^ n` (from the nine approximate `sampleModNat`
+exponent draws in `cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder`). -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupGame2_game3_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupGame2 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGame3 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      9 / 2 ^ n :=
+  (F.advantage_cramerShoupGame2_game3_le_exactCollision
+    encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n).trans
+    (F.succProbability_cramerShoupExactCollisionGame_le
+      encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n)
+
+/-! ### Concrete and asymptotic 1CCA security bounds ([BonehShoup2023], Theorem 12.9 & Ex. 12.27) -/
+
+/-- **Combined Game 0 $\to$ Game 5 bound for a single challenge bit**: under honest query bounds
+`(Q₁, Q₂)`, the distinguishing advantage between `cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game` and `cramerShoupGame5` is
+at most the DDH advantage of `cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher` plus the collision-finding success
+probability of `cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder` plus `(Q₁ + Q₂ + 1) / m + 21 / 2 ^ n`. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n Q₁ Q₂ m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d)
+    (hQ₁ : F.HonestPhase1QueryBound setup adversary n Q₁)
+    (hQ₂ : F.HonestPhase2QueryBound setup H isElem adversary n Q₂) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      ((Q₁ + Q₂ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      21 / 2 ^ n := by
+  rw [F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_eq_game1]
+  have h12 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame1_game2_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n
+  have h23 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame2_game3_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n
+  have h34 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame3_game4_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit
+    n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have h45 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame4_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit
+    n m hm0 hm
+  refine ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+    (F.cramerShoupGame2 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+    (add_le_add h12 ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+      (F.cramerShoupGame3 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+      (add_le_add h23 ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+        (F.cramerShoupGame4 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+        (add_le_add h34 h45)))))).trans_eq ?_
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+/-- **Concrete 1CCA security bound under honest query bounds**: combining the Game 0 $\to$ Game 5
+bounds for `bit = false` and `bit = true` via `cramerShoupGame5_false_eq_true`. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le_of_honest_bounds
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (n Q₁ Q₂ m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d)
+    (hQ₁ : F.HonestPhase1QueryBound setup adversary n Q₁)
+    (hQ₂ : F.HonestPhase2QueryBound setup H isElem adversary n Q₂) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ + 2 * Q₂ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n := by
+  have hfalse := F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary false n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have htrue := F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary true n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have htri := Game.advantage_triangle
+    (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n)
+  rw [F.cramerShoupGame5_false_eq_true,
+    Game.advantage_comm (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n)] at htri
+  refine (htri.trans (add_le_add hfalse htrue)).trans_eq ?_
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+/-- **Concrete 1CCA security bound for `cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game`**: for any adversary with
+decryption-query bounds `(Q₁ n, Q₂ n)`, the 1CCA advantage at parameter `n` is bounded by the DDH
+advantages of `cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher` (`false` and `true`), the collision-finding
+success probabilities of `cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder` (`false` and `true`), plus
+`(2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2) / m + 42 / 2 ^ n`. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool)
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
+    (hQ : adversary.IsQueryBounded Q₁ Q₂) (n m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n :=
+  F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le_of_honest_bounds encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary
+    n (Q₁ n) (Q₂ n) m hm0 hm
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => hQ.1 n _)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => hQ.2 n _ _)
+
+/-- **Theorem 12.9 & Exercise 12.27 concrete bound (group-element messages)**
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, Theorem 12.9 and Remark 12.3, printed pp. 488–493, and
+Exercise 12.27, printed pp. 521–522): original adaptation of the concrete bound (12.19) to
+Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ in the two-run single-bit reduction style
+(with `42 / 2 ^ n` from the approximate `sampleModNat` exponent draws in the reductions). -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game_le
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
+    (hQ : adversary.IsQueryBounded Q₁ Q₂) (n m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupToCollisionFinder H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupToCollisionFinder H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n :=
+  F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le Prod.snd setup H isElem hmem adversary Q₁ Q₂ hQ n m hm0 hm
+
+/-- **Concrete 1CCA security bound for single-bit messages (`cramerShoupCCA2Game`)**. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupCCA2Game_le
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2Adversary) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
+    (hQ : adversary.IsQueryBounded Q₁ Q₂) (n m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n :=
+  F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2) setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary Q₁ Q₂ hQ n m hm0 hm
+
+/-! ### Polynomial length bounds and asymptotic 1CCA security -/
+
+private theorem length_encNat_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
+    (encNat m).length ≤ (encNat n).length := by
+  simpa only [encNat_apply, ← Nat.size_eq_bits_len] using Nat.size_le_size h
+

+`(F.encDesc d).length`. -/

body: Required scope correction: this docstring, the module introduction and PR headline describe security under DDH and collision resistance, but the theorem additionally assumes a positive order lower bound `m` with negligible `1/m` (lines1239–1241). State that growth premise explicitly in those summaries. Also identify the earlier exact-uniform PMF games as ideal, so their `42/2^n` reduction loss is not mistaken for the native sampler's total loss. No derivation of a stronger theorem is requested.

@@ -0,0 +1,1283 @@

+module

+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.Scheme

+/-!
+# The Cramer–Shoup public-key encryption scheme and 1CCA security under DDH
+
+This module completes the single-challenge adaptive chosen-ciphertext (**1CCA / IND-CCA2**,
+Definition 12.2, printed p. 468) security proof for the **Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup public-key
+encryption scheme** ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$, [Boneh and Shoup, Exercise 12.27, printed
+pp. 521–522][BonehShoup2023], specialized to associated data $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$) defined
+in `Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.Scheme` over a `PrimeOrderGroupFamily`, in the
+standard model under the Decisional Diffie–Hellman (`DDH`) assumption and collision resistance
+(`CollisionResistantFor`) of the $\mathbb{Z}_q$-valued hash family $H'$, following the Games 0–6
+proof template of [Boneh and Shoup, Section 12.5.3, Theorem 12.9 and Remark 12.3, printed
+pp. 488–493][BonehShoup2023].
+
+## Source Statements ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3 & Exercise 12.27)
+
+Verbatim from [BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3 (printed pp. 489–492):
+
+> **Theorem 12.9.** If the DDH assumption holds in $\mathbb{G}$, $\mathcal{E}_s$ is 1CCA secure,
+> $H$ is a secure KDF, and $H'$ is collision resistant, then $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}$ is CCA
+> secure.
+>
+> In particular, for every 1CCA adversary $\mathcal{A}$ that attacks $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}$ as
+> in Definition 12.2, and makes at most $Q_d$ decryption queries, there exist a DDH adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}$ for $\mathbb{G}$ as in Attack Game 10.6, a 1CCA adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_s$ that attacks $\mathcal{E}_s$ as in Definition 9.6, a KDF adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}$ that attacks $H$ as in Attack Game 11.3, and a collision-finding
+> adversary $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$ that attacks $H'$ as in Attack Game 8.1, where
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathcal{B}_s, \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}, \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$
+> are elementary wrappers around $\mathcal{A}$, such that
+> $$\text{1CCAadv}[\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}] \le
+> 2\left(\text{DDHadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathbb{G}] +
+> \text{KDFadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}, H] +
+> \text{CRadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}, H'] + \frac{Q_d + 1}{q}\right) +
+> \text{1CCAadv}[\mathcal{B}_s, \mathcal{E}_s]. \quad (12.19)$$
+> …
+> **Game 2.** We next modify the Challenger in Game 1, replacing line (1) with
+> $$(1) \qquad \alpha, \beta, \gamma \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q,\;
+>   u \leftarrow g^\alpha,\; v \leftarrow g^\beta,\; w \leftarrow g^\gamma$$
+> It is clear that any 1CCA adversary that can distinguish between Games 1 and 2 can be converted
+> into a DDH adversary. More precisely, we can easily construct an elementary wrapper
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}$ around $\mathcal{A}$, such that
+> $$|\Pr[W_1] - \Pr[W_2]| \le \text{DDHadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathbb{G}]. \quad (12.22)$$
+>
+> **Game 3.** We next modify the Challenger in Game 2, replacing line (1) with
+> $$(1) \qquad \alpha, \beta \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q,\;
+>   \gamma \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q \setminus \{\alpha\beta\},\;
+>   u \leftarrow g^\alpha,\; v \leftarrow g^\beta,\; w \leftarrow g^\gamma$$
+> That is, instead of choosing $\gamma \in \mathbb{Z}_q$ at random, we choose
+> $\gamma \in \mathbb{Z}_q$ at random, subject to the constraint that $\gamma \ne \alpha\beta$. It
+> is clear that the distributions ofGames 2 and 3 are identical, unless in Game 2 the challenger
+> happens to choose $\gamma = \alpha\beta$, which happens with probability $1/q$. By the Difference
+> Lemma (Theorem 4.7), we immediately get
+> $$|\Pr[W_2] - \Pr[W_3]| \le 1/q. \quad (12.23)$$
+>
+> **Game 4.** Now we widen the rejection rule in the decryption oracle (line (5)), replacing it
+> with:
+> $$(5) \qquad \text{if } (\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{z}', \hat{c}) = (v, w, z', c) \text{ or }
+>   \mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v}) \text{ or } z' \ne f'(\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{\rho})$$
+> where $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ is the condition:
+> $$(\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{c}) \ne (v, w, c) \quad \text{and} \quad \hat{\rho} = \rho$$
+> Let $Z_4$ be the event that in Game 4, the adversary submits a decryption query that would not
+> have been rejected in Game 3, and yet triggers the condition
+> $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ in Game 4. Actually, we may as well define $Z_4$ to be the
+> event that $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ holds in Game 4 (which could only happen after
+> line (2) is executed), since if this happens at all, then it happens before the two games
+> diverge. Clearly, Games 3 and 4 proceed identically unless $Z_4$ occurs, and so by the Difference
+> Lemma, we have
+> $$|\Pr[W_3] - \Pr[W_4]| \le \Pr[Z_4]. \quad (12.24)$$
+> Moreover, if event $Z_4$ does occur, this immediately gives us a collision for $H'$. Therefore, we
+> can construct an elementary wrapper $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$ around $\mathcal{A}$ that outputs
+> the colliding inputs when $Z_4$ occurs, and so
+> $$\Pr[Z_4] \le \text{CRadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}, H']. \quad (12.25)$$
+
+Verbatim from [BonehShoup2023], Exercise 12.27 (printed pp. 521–522):
+> Show that $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ is CCA secure, provided $H'$ is collision resistant and the
+> DDH assumption holds for $\mathbb{G}$.
+
+## Scope and Quantitative Adaptation
+
+* **Associated data specialized to $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$** and **single-challenge 1CCA
+  (`Definition 12.2`)**.
+* **Quantitative bound (`advantage_cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game_le`)**: an original quantitative
+  adaptation of `(12.19)` to $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ in the uniform strict-PPT model, where the
+  two fixed-bit DDH distinguishers (`cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher`) and two fixed-bit collision
+  finders (`cramerShoupToCollisionFinder`) contribute `42 / 2 ^ n` from their `sampleModNat`
+  exponent draws, and `(2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2) / m` combines the non-DH triple exclusion (`1 / m`)
+  and the adaptive Lemma 12.8 bound (`(Q₁ n + Q₂ n) / m`) across `bit = false` and `bit = true`.
+-/

+namespace Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily

+open Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM ProjectiveHash Encryption Game

+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup parameterized by a
+message-to-group-word encoding `encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool` ([BonehShoup2023],
+Section 12.1, Attack Game 12.1 and Definition 12.2, printed pp. 467–468, and Exercise 12.27,
+printed pp. 521–522, specialized to associated data $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$; Game 0 of
+Section 12.5.3, printed pp. 490–491). -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pkVal := F.cramerShoupPublicKey d α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKeyValues d pkVal
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupEncrypt H d
+      (F.encode d pkVal.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.2.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.2.2)
+      m β.val
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over encoded group-element
+messages (`Msg = List Bool`, `encodeMsg = Prod.snd`), enforcing the group-membership challenge
+admissibility check `isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁)`. -/
+noncomputable abbrev cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary)
+    (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game :=
+  F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game Prod.snd setup H isElem adversary bit n
+
+/-- Single-challenge 1CCA security of Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over encoded group-element
+messages (`WordCCA2Adversary`). -/
+def cramerShoupGroupINDCCA2
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) : Prop :=
+  Game.Indistinguishable
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n)
+    WordCCA2Adversary.IsPPT
+
+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over single-bit messages
+(`Msg = Bool`, embedded into `F.Carrier d` via `F.encodeBit`). -/
+noncomputable abbrev cramerShoupCCA2Game
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) (adversary : CCA2Adversary) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game :=
+  F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2) setup H isElem adversary bit n
+
+/-- Single-challenge 1CCA security of Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over single-bit messages
+(`CCA2Adversary`). -/
+def cramerShoupINDCCA2
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) : Prop :=
+  Game.Indistinguishable
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n)
+    CCA2Adversary.IsPPT
+
+/-- **Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, printed p. 490, adapted to
+$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): draw `(α, β)` and `sk` uniformly from `ZMod q`, and compute the
+challenge ciphertext from `(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` using the secret key via
+`encodeCramerShoupChallenge`. -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupGame1
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d ((α * β) • F.generator d)
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+/-- **Game 0 = Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, equation (12.21), printed p. 490):
+computing the challenge ciphertext from `(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` using the secret key
+produces the exact same distribution as public-key encryption. -/
+theorem cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_eq_game1
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n =
+      F.cramerShoupGame1 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n := by
+  simp only [cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game, cramerShoupGame1, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
+    PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, encodeCramerShoupPublicKey_encode, skNatOfZMod,
+    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, encodeCramerShoupEncrypt_publicKey_eq_challenge]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun d => congrArg _ (funext fun α => ?_))
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ₁ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ₁ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ₂ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ₂ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun choiceOut => ?_)
+  by_cases h : (isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)) &&
+      isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true
+  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
+  · simp only [h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, PMF.bind_const]
+
+/-- **Game 2** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, printed p. 490, adapted to
+$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): replace the Diffie–Hellman challenge pair
+`(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` by an independent random pair `(v, w) = (β • g, γ • g)` with
+uniform `γ : ZMod (F.order d)`. -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupGame2
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let γ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+private theorem advantage_ddhRealGame_cramerShoupGame1_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.ddhRealGame setup
+        (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGame1 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤ 6 / 2 ^ n := by
+  unfold ddhRealGame cramerShoupGame1 cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher
+  simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (setup n) _ _ fun d => ?_
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun α => ?_
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun β => ?_
+  refine F.advantage_bind_sampleCramerShoupSK_le n d _ _ fun s t s₁ t₁ s₂ t₂ => ?_
+  rw [F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey_eq_skNatOfZMod d α ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+    F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun choiceOut => ?_)
+  by_cases h : (isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)) &&
+      isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true
+  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure]
+    rw [F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge_eq_skNatOfZMod H d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+      F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+  · simp only [h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_pure]
+
+private theorem advantage_ddhIdealGame_cramerShoupGame2_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+        (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGame2 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤ 6 / 2 ^ n := by
+  unfold ddhIdealGame cramerShoupGame2 cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher
+  simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (setup n) _ _ fun d => ?_
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun α => ?_
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun β => ?_
+  refine advantage_bind_le_nnreal (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))) _ _ fun γ => ?_
+  refine F.advantage_bind_sampleCramerShoupSK_le n d _ _ fun s t s₁ t₁ s₂ t₂ => ?_
+  rw [F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey_eq_skNatOfZMod d α ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+    F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun choiceOut => ?_)
+  by_cases h : (isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)) &&
+      isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true
+  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure]
+    rw [F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge_eq_skNatOfZMod H d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂))),
+      F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle_eq_skNatOfZMod H isElem hmem d ((s, t), ((s₁, t₁), (s₂, t₂)))]
+  · simp only [h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_pure]
