+/-- **Combined Game 0 $\to$ Game 5 bound for a single challenge bit**: under honest query bounds
+`(Q₁, Q₂)`, the distinguishing advantage between `cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game` and `cramerShoupGame5` is
+at most the DDH advantage of `cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher` plus the collision-finding success
+probability of `cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder` plus `(Q₁ + Q₂ + 1) / m + 21 / 2 ^ n`. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n Q₁ Q₂ m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d)
+    (hQ₁ : F.HonestPhase1QueryBound setup adversary n Q₁)
+    (hQ₂ : F.HonestPhase2QueryBound setup H isElem adversary n Q₂) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +
+      ((Q₁ + Q₂ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      21 / 2 ^ n := by
+  rw [F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_eq_game1]
+  have h12 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame1_game2_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n
+  have h23 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame2_game3_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit n
+  have h34 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame3_game4_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit
+    n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have h45 := F.advantage_cramerShoupGame4_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem adversary bit
+    n m hm0 hm
+  refine ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+    (F.cramerShoupGame2 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+    (add_le_add h12 ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+      (F.cramerShoupGame3 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+      (add_le_add h23 ((Game.advantage_triangle _
+        (F.cramerShoupGame4 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n) _).trans
+        (add_le_add h34 h45)))))).trans_eq ?_
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+/-- **Concrete 1CCA security bound under honest query bounds**: combining the Game 0 $\to$ Game 5
+bounds for `bit = false` and `bit = true` via `cramerShoupGame5_false_eq_true`. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le_of_honest_bounds
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (n Q₁ Q₂ m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d)
+    (hQ₁ : F.HonestPhase1QueryBound setup adversary n Q₁)
+    (hQ₂ : F.HonestPhase2QueryBound setup H isElem adversary n Q₂) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ + 2 * Q₂ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n := by
+  have hfalse := F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary false n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have htrue := F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_game5_le encodeMsg setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary true n Q₁ Q₂ m hm0 hm hQ₁ hQ₂
+  have htri := Game.advantage_triangle
+    (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n)
+  rw [F.cramerShoupGame5_false_eq_true,
+    Game.advantage_comm (F.cramerShoupGame5 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n)] at htri
+  refine (htri.trans (add_le_add hfalse htrue)).trans_eq ?_
+  push_cast
+  ring

+
+/-- **Theorem 12.9 & Exercise 12.27 concrete bound (group-element messages)**
+([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, Theorem 12.9 and Remark 12.3, printed pp. 488–493, and
+Exercise 12.27, printed pp. 521–522): original adaptation of the concrete bound (12.19) to
+Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ in the two-run single-bit reduction style
+(with `42 / 2 ^ n` from the approximate `sampleModNat` exponent draws in the reductions). -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game_le
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
+    (hQ : adversary.IsQueryBounded Q₁ Q₂) (n m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupToCollisionFinder H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupToCollisionFinder H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n :=
+  F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le Prod.snd setup H isElem hmem adversary Q₁ Q₂ hQ n m hm0 hm
+
+/-- **Concrete 1CCA security bound for single-bit messages (`cramerShoupCCA2Game`)**. -/
+theorem advantage_cramerShoupCCA2Game_le
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (adversary : CCA2Adversary) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
+    (hQ : adversary.IsQueryBounded Q₁ Q₂) (n m : ℕ)
+    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
+    Game.advantage
+      (F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n) ≤
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.advantage
+        (F.ddhRealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n)
+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary false) n) +
+      Game.succProbability
+        (collisionGameFor setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true)
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToCollisionFinder (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2)
+            H isElem adversary true) n) +
+      ((2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) / (m : ℝ≥0) +
+      42 / 2 ^ n :=
+  F.advantage_cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_le (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2) setup H isElem hmem
+    adversary Q₁ Q₂ hQ n m hm0 hm
+
+/-! ### Polynomial length bounds and asymptotic 1CCA security -/
+
+private theorem length_encNat_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
+    (encNat m).length ≤ (encNat n).length := by
+  simpa only [encNat_apply, ← Nat.size_eq_bits_len] using Nat.size_le_size h
+

Fixed in `1990add8`: explicitly stated the positive group-order lower-bound and negligible inverse-order growth premise (`m : ℕ → ℕ`, `0 < m n`, `m n ≤ F.order`, `Negligible (fun n => (1 / m n : ℝ≥0))`) in the module introduction, `Scope and Quantitative Adaptation`, theorem docstrings, and PR summary; qualified `cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game`, `cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game`, `cramerShoupGroupINDCCA2`, `cramerShoupCCA2Game`, and `cramerShoupINDCCA2` as ideal exact-uniform PMF games/definitions (with `42 / 2 ^ n` reduction loss) vs. the native strict-PPT `Encryption.INDCCA2On` notion (which adds `8 / 2 ^ n` per challenge bit via `advantage_cca2GameOn_cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game_le`); and updated the Existing Notions Considered table to explain this distinction and reference `Complexity/Crypto/Computational/Encryption/CCA.lean`.

+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.Scheme
+public import Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.Reductions
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Nat.Binary
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Nat.BinaryDiv
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Plain
+import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.UniformNat
+import Complexity.Crypto.Game.Statistical
+import Complexity.Crypto.Negligible.Basic
+import Complexity.Crypto.Negligible.Dyadic

+/-!
+# The Cramer–Shoup public-key encryption scheme and 1CCA security under DDH
+
+This module completes the single-challenge adaptive chosen-ciphertext (**1CCA / IND-CCA2**,
+Definition 12.2, printed p. 468) security proof for the **Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup public-key
+encryption scheme** ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$, [Boneh and Shoup, Exercise 12.27, printed
+pp. 521–522][BonehShoup2023], specialized to associated data $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$) defined
+in `Complexity.Crypto.Computational.CramerShoup.Scheme` over a `PrimeOrderGroupFamily`, in the
+standard model under the Decisional Diffie–Hellman (`DDH`) assumption and collision resistance
+(`CollisionResistantFor`) of the $\mathbb{Z}_q$-valued hash family $H'$, following the Games 0–6
+proof template of [Boneh and Shoup, Section 12.5.3, Theorem 12.9 and Remark 12.3, printed
+pp. 488–493][BonehShoup2023].
+
+## Source Statements ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3 & Exercise 12.27)
+
+Verbatim from [BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3 (printed pp. 489–492):
+
+> **Theorem 12.9.** If the DDH assumption holds in $\mathbb{G}$, $\mathcal{E}_s$ is 1CCA secure,
+> $H$ is a secure KDF, and $H'$ is collision resistant, then $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}$ is CCA
+> secure.
+>
+> In particular, for every 1CCA adversary $\mathcal{A}$ that attacks $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}$ as
+> in Definition 12.2, and makes at most $Q_d$ decryption queries, there exist a DDH adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}$ for $\mathbb{G}$ as in Attack Game 10.6, a 1CCA adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_s$ that attacks $\mathcal{E}_s$ as in Definition 9.6, a KDF adversary
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}$ that attacks $H$ as in Attack Game 11.3, and a collision-finding
+> adversary $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$ that attacks $H'$ as in Attack Game 8.1, where
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathcal{B}_s, \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}, \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$
+> are elementary wrappers around $\mathcal{A}$, such that
+> $$\text{1CCAadv}[\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{CS}}] \le
+> 2\left(\text{DDHadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathbb{G}] +
+> \text{KDFadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{kdf}}, H] +
+> \text{CRadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}, H'] + \frac{Q_d + 1}{q}\right) +
+> \text{1CCAadv}[\mathcal{B}_s, \mathcal{E}_s]. \quad (12.19)$$
+> …
+> **Game 2.** We next modify the Challenger in Game 1, replacing line (1) with
+> $$(1) \qquad \alpha, \beta, \gamma \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q,\;
+>   u \leftarrow g^\alpha,\; v \leftarrow g^\beta,\; w \leftarrow g^\gamma$$
+> It is clear that any 1CCA adversary that can distinguish between Games 1 and 2 can be converted
+> into a DDH adversary. More precisely, we can easily construct an elementary wrapper
+> $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}$ around $\mathcal{A}$, such that
+> $$|\Pr[W_1] - \Pr[W_2]| \le \text{DDHadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{ddh}}, \mathbb{G}]. \quad (12.22)$$
+>
+> **Game 3.** We next modify the Challenger in Game 2, replacing line (1) with
+> $$(1) \qquad \alpha, \beta \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q,\;
+>   \gamma \xleftarrow{R} \mathbb{Z}_q \setminus \{\alpha\beta\},\;
+>   u \leftarrow g^\alpha,\; v \leftarrow g^\beta,\; w \leftarrow g^\gamma$$
+> That is, instead of choosing $\gamma \in \mathbb{Z}_q$ at random, we choose
+> $\gamma \in \mathbb{Z}_q$ at random, subject to the constraint that $\gamma \ne \alpha\beta$. It
+> is clear that the distributions ofGames 2 and 3 are identical, unless in Game 2 the challenger
+> happens to choose $\gamma = \alpha\beta$, which happens with probability $1/q$. By the Difference
+> Lemma (Theorem 4.7), we immediately get
+> $$|\Pr[W_2] - \Pr[W_3]| \le 1/q. \quad (12.23)$$
+>
+> **Game 4.** Now we widen the rejection rule in the decryption oracle (line (5)), replacing it
+> with:
+> $$(5) \qquad \text{if } (\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{z}', \hat{c}) = (v, w, z', c) \text{ or }
+>   \mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v}) \text{ or } z' \ne f'(\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{\rho})$$
+> where $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ is the condition:
+> $$(\hat{v}, \hat{w}, \hat{c}) \ne (v, w, c) \quad \text{and} \quad \hat{\rho} = \rho$$
+> Let $Z_4$ be the event that in Game 4, the adversary submits a decryption query that would not
+> have been rejected in Game 3, and yet triggers the condition
+> $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ in Game 4. Actually, we may as well define $Z_4$ to be the
+> event that $\mathit{Coll}_{u,v}(\hat{u}, \hat{v})$ holds in Game 4 (which could only happen after
+> line (2) is executed), since if this happens at all, then it happens before the two games
+> diverge. Clearly, Games 3 and 4 proceed identically unless $Z_4$ occurs, and so by the Difference
+> Lemma, we have
+> $$|\Pr[W_3] - \Pr[W_4]| \le \Pr[Z_4]. \quad (12.24)$$
+> Moreover, if event $Z_4$ does occur, this immediately gives us a collision for $H'$. Therefore, we
+> can construct an elementary wrapper $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}$ around $\mathcal{A}$ that outputs
+> the colliding inputs when $Z_4$ occurs, and so
+> $$\Pr[Z_4] \le \text{CRadv}[\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{cr}}, H']. \quad (12.25)$$
+
+Verbatim from [BonehShoup2023], Exercise 12.27 (printed pp. 521–522):
+> Show that $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ is CCA secure, provided $H'$ is collision resistant and the
+> DDH assumption holds for $\mathbb{G}$.
+
+## Scope and Quantitative Adaptation
+
+* **Associated data specialized to $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$** and **single-challenge 1CCA
+  (`Definition 12.2`)**.
+* **Quantitative bound (`advantage_cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game_le`)**: an original quantitative
+  adaptation of `(12.19)` to $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$ in the uniform strict-PPT model, where the
+  two fixed-bit DDH distinguishers (`cramerShoupToDDHDistinguisher`) and two fixed-bit collision
+  finders (`cramerShoupToCollisionFinder`) contribute `42 / 2 ^ n` from their `sampleModNat`
+  exponent draws, and `(2 * Q₁ n + 2 * Q₂ n + 2) / m` combines the non-DH triple exclusion (`1 / m`)
+  and the adaptive Lemma 12.8 bound (`(Q₁ n + Q₂ n) / m`) across `bit = false` and `bit = true`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Crypto.PrimeOrderGroupFamily
+
+open Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM ProjectiveHash Encryption Game
+open scoped ENNReal NNReal
+
+variable (F : PrimeOrderGroupFamily)
+
+
+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup parameterized by a
+message-to-group-word encoding `encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool` ([BonehShoup2023],
+Section 12.1, Attack Game 12.1 and Definition 12.2, printed pp. 467–468, and Exercise 12.27,
+printed pp. 521–522, specialized to associated data $\mathcal{D} = \mathrm{Unit}$; Game 0 of
+Section 12.5.3, printed pp. 490–491). -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pkVal := F.cramerShoupPublicKey d α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKeyValues d pkVal
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupEncrypt H d
+      (F.encode d pkVal.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.2.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.2.2)
+      m β.val
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over encoded group-element
+messages (`Msg = List Bool`, `encodeMsg = Prod.snd`), enforcing the group-membership challenge
+admissibility check `isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁)`. -/
+noncomputable abbrev cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary)
+    (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game :=
+  F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game Prod.snd setup H isElem adversary bit n
+
+/-- Single-challenge 1CCA security of Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over encoded group-element
+messages (`WordCCA2Adversary`). -/
+def cramerShoupGroupINDCCA2
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) : Prop :=
+  Game.Indistinguishable
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupGroupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n)
+    WordCCA2Adversary.IsPPT
+
+/-- The single-challenge 1CCA experiment for Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over single-bit messages
+(`Msg = Bool`, embedded into `F.Carrier d` via `F.encodeBit`). -/
+noncomputable abbrev cramerShoupCCA2Game
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) (adversary : CCA2Adversary) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game :=
+  F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game (fun p => F.encodeBit p.1 p.2) setup H isElem adversary bit n
+
+/-- Single-challenge 1CCA security of Multiplicative Cramer–Shoup over single-bit messages
+(`CCA2Adversary`). -/
+def cramerShoupINDCCA2
+    (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool) : Prop :=
+  Game.Indistinguishable
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary false n)
+    (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupCCA2Game setup H isElem adversary true n)
+    CCA2Adversary.IsPPT
+
+/-- **Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, printed p. 490, adapted to
+$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): draw `(α, β)` and `sk` uniformly from `ZMod q`, and compute the
+challenge ciphertext from `(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` using the secret key via
+`encodeCramerShoupChallenge`. -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupGame1
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n
+  let α ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let β ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d ((α * β) • F.generator d)
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())
+  let choice := choiceOut.1
+  let m₀ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.1)
+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)
+  if isElem (d, m₀) && isElem (d, m₁) then
+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    let guessOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+        (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct)).run ())
+    return guessOut.1
+  else
+    return false
+
+/-- **Game 0 = Game 1** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, equation (12.21), printed p. 490):
+computing the challenge ciphertext from `(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` using the secret key
+produces the exact same distribution as public-key encryption. -/
+theorem cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game_eq_game1
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
+    F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n =
+      F.cramerShoupGame1 encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary bit n := by
+  simp only [cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game, cramerShoupGame1, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
+    PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, encodeCramerShoupPublicKey_encode, skNatOfZMod,
+    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, encodeCramerShoupEncrypt_publicKey_eq_challenge]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun d => congrArg _ (funext fun α => ?_))
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ₁ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ₁ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun σ₂ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun τ₂ => ?_)
+  conv_rhs => rw [PMF.bind_comm (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))]
+  refine congrArg _ (funext fun choiceOut => ?_)
+  by_cases h : (isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)) &&
+      isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true
+  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
+  · simp only [h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, PMF.bind_const]
+
+/-- **Game 2** ([BonehShoup2023], Section 12.5.3, printed p. 490, adapted to
+$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{MCS}}$): replace the Diffie–Hellman challenge pair
+`(v, w) = (β • g, (α * β) • g)` by an independent random pair `(v, w) = (β • g, γ • g)` with
+uniform `γ : ZMod (F.order d)`. -/
+noncomputable def cramerShoupGame2

+private theorem advantage_four_le (g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ : Game) {n : ℕ}
+    (h₁ : Game.advantage g₂ g₁ ≤ 6 / 2 ^ n) (h₂ : Game.advantage g₃ g₄ ≤ 6 / 2 ^ n) :
+    Game.advantage g₁ g₄ ≤ Game.advantage g₂ g₃ + 12 / 2 ^ n := by
+  have htri1 := Game.advantage_triangle g₁ g₂ g₄
+  have htri2 := Game.advantage_triangle g₂ g₃ g₄
+  rw [Game.advantage_comm g₁ g₂] at htri1

+    (add_le_add h₁ (add_le_add le_rfl h₂))).trans_eq (by ring)

+        (F.ddhIdealGame setup
+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary bit) n) +

+private noncomputable def cramerShoupExactCollisionGame
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool) (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Game := do
+  let d ← setup n

+  let γ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₁ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let σ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let τ₂ ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let u := F.encode d (α • F.generator d)
+  let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+  let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d u sk
+  let choiceOut ← ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())

+  let m₁ := encodeMsg (d, choice.1.2)

+    let m := if bit then m₁ else m₀
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    runFinderOracle (F.cramerShoupCollisionPhase2Reply H isElem d sk ct)
+      (fun req => F.isCramerShoupCollision H d req ct) extractCramerShoupTriple
+      (adversary.guess n choice.2 ct) none
+      (fun cand => isCollisionFor (F.cramerShoupHashMod H) (fun _ _ _ => true) n d
+        cand (extractCramerShoupTriple ct))

+private theorem advantage_cramerShoupGame2_game3_le_exactCollision
+    {Msg : Type} (encodeMsg : F.Desc × Msg → List Bool) (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)

+  simp only [PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]

+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun α => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun β => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun γ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun σ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun τ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun σ₁ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun τ₁ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun σ₂ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun τ₂ => ?_
+  refine bind_apply_le_add_bind_apply _ _ _ _ true fun choiceOut => ?_

+      isElem (d, encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2))) = true

+    let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+    let v := F.encode d (β • F.generator d)
+    let w := F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)
+    let m := if bit then encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.2) else encodeMsg (d, choiceOut.1.1.1)
+    let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupChallenge H d sk v w m
+    have hrun :
+        (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+            (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+          (adversary.guess n choiceOut.1.2 ct)).run ())).bind
+            (fun guessOut => PMF.pure guessOut.1) =
+        runStatelessOracle (F.cramerShoupPhase2Reply H isElem d sk ct)
+          (adversary.guess n choiceOut.1.2 ct) PMF.pure := rfl

+      (fun req hbad => by

+private theorem succProbability_cramerShoupExactCollisionGame_le

+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))

+        (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())).bind fun choiceOut =>
+        let choice := choiceOut.1

+private theorem length_encNat_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
+    (encNat m).length ≤ (encNat n).length := by

+/-- Every encoded group element `F.encode d x` has bit-length polynomially bounded in
+`(F.encDesc d).length`. -/
+theorem exists_length_encode_le :
+    ∃ c k : ℕ, ∀ d : F.Desc, ∀ x : F.Carrier d,
+      (F.encode d x).length ≤ c * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ k := by
+  obtain ⟨co, ko, hord⟩ := F.computableInPolyTime_order.tidy.polyBounded_length.exists_le
+  obtain ⟨cg, kg, hgen⟩ := F.computableInPolyTime_generator.tidy.polyBounded_length.exists_le
+  obtain ⟨cs, ks, hsmul⟩ := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.tidy.polyBounded_length.exists_le
+  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded
+      (fun L => cs * (2 * L + 4 * (co * (L + 1) ^ ko) + 4 * (cg * (L + 1) ^ kg) + 7) ^ ks) := by
+    fun_prop
+  obtain ⟨c, k, hck⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp hpoly
+  refine ⟨c, k, fun d x => ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := F.smul_generator_surjective d x
+  have hsmul_eq : F.encode d (α • F.generator d) =
+      F.smul (d, α.val, F.encode d (F.generator d)) := by
+    rw [F.smul_encode, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
+  rw [hsmul_eq]
+  have h1 := hsmul (d, α.val, F.encode d (F.generator d))
+  simp only [encBits_apply] at h1 hgen
+  have hα : (encNat α.val).length ≤ co * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ ko :=
+    (length_encNat_mono (Nat.le_of_lt (ZMod.val_lt α))).trans (hord d)
+  have hg := hgen d
+  have hlen :
+      (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat encBits)
+        (d, α.val, F.encode d (F.generator d))).length + 1 ≤
+      2 * (F.encDesc d).length + 4 * (co * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ ko) +
+        4 * (cg * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ kg) + 7 := by
+    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply]
+    lia
+  calc (F.smul (d, α.val, F.encode d (F.generator d))).length
+      ≤ cs * ((encPair F.encDesc (encPair encNat encBits)
+          (d, α.val, F.encode d (F.generator d))).length + 1) ^ ks := h1
+    _ ≤ cs * (2 * (F.encDesc d).length + 4 * (co * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ ko) +
+          4 * (cg * ((F.encDesc d).length + 1) ^ kg) + 7) ^ ks := by
+        gcongr

+    {setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc}
+    {H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool}
+    {isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool}
+    (hH : ComputableInPolyTime H (encPair F.encDesc encBits) encBits)
+    (hisElem : ComputableInPolyTime isElem (encPair F.encDesc encBits) encBool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (hDDH : F.DDH setup)
+    (hCR : CollisionResistantFor F.encDesc setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H))
+    {m : ℕ → ℕ} (hm0 : ∀ n, 0 < m n)
+    (hm : ∀ n, ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m n ≤ F.order d)
+    (hinv : Negligible fun n => (1 / m n : ℝ≥0))
+    (hdesc : ∃ c k : ℕ, ∀ n, ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support,

+      (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary false n)
+      (fun adversary n => F.cramerShoupMsgCCA2Game encodeMsg setup H isElem adversary true n)

+          (F.cramerShoupMsgToDDHDistinguisher encodeMsg H isElem adversary true) n) :=

+theorem DDH.cramerShoupGroupINDCCA2
+    {F : PrimeOrderGroupFamily}
+    {setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc}
+    {H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool}
+    {isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool}
+    (hH : ComputableInPolyTime H (encPair F.encDesc encBits) encBits)
+    (hisElem : ComputableInPolyTime isElem (encPair F.encDesc encBits) encBool)
+    (hmem : ∀ d x, isElem (d, x) = true ↔ x ∈ Set.range (F.encode d))
+    (hDDH : F.DDH setup)
+    (hCR : CollisionResistantFor F.encDesc setup (F.cramerShoupHashMod H))
+    {m : ℕ → ℕ} (hm0 : ∀ n, 0 < m n)
+    (hm : ∀ n, ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m n ≤ F.order d)
+    (hinv : Negligible fun n => (1 / m n : ℝ≥0))
+    (hdesc : ∃ c k : ℕ, ∀ n, ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support,
+      (F.encDesc d).length ≤ c * (n + 1) ^ k) :

+private theorem advantage_four_le_eight (g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ : Game) {n : ℕ}
+    (h₁ : Game.advantage g₁ g₂ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ n)
+    (h₂ : Game.advantage g₂ g₃ ≤ 6 / 2 ^ n)
+    (h₃ : Game.advantage g₃ g₄ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ n) :
+    Game.advantage g₁ g₄ ≤ 8 / 2 ^ n := by
+  have htri1 := Game.advantage_triangle g₁ g₂ g₄
+  have htri2 := Game.advantage_triangle g₂ g₃ g₄
+  calc Game.advantage g₁ g₄
+      ≤ Game.advantage g₁ g₂ + (Game.advantage g₂ g₃ + Game.advantage g₃ g₄) :=
+        htri1.trans (add_le_add le_rfl htri2)
+    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ n + (6 / 2 ^ n + 1 / 2 ^ n) :=
+        add_le_add h₁ (add_le_add h₂ h₃)
+    _ = 8 / 2 ^ n := by ring
+
+private noncomputable def cramerShoupCCA2InnerB
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (d : F.Desc) (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ)
+    (α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂ : ZMod (F.order d))
+    (choiceOut : ((List Bool × List Bool) × List Bool) × Unit)
+    (β : ZMod (F.order d)) : Game :=
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pkVal := F.cramerShoupPublicKey d α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let m := if bit then choiceOut.1.1.2 else choiceOut.1.1.1
+  let ct := F.encodeCramerShoupEncrypt H d
+    (F.encode d pkVal.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.1,
+      F.encode d pkVal.2.2.1, F.encode d pkVal.2.2.2) m β.val
+  (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase2Oracle H isElem d sk ct))
+    (adversary.guess n choiceOut.1.2 ct)).run ())).bind (fun guessOut => PMF.pure guessOut.1)
+
+private noncomputable def cramerShoupCCA2InnerSK
+    (H : F.Desc × List Bool → List Bool)
+    (isElem : F.Desc × List Bool → Bool)
+    (d : F.Desc) (adversary : WordCCA2Adversary) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ)
+    (α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂ : ZMod (F.order d)) (useExactB : Bool) : Game :=
+  let sk := F.skNatOfZMod d σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂
+  let pk := F.encodeCramerShoupPublicKey d (F.encode d (α • F.generator d)) sk
+  (ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
+    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
+      (F.cramerShoupPhase1Oracle H isElem d sk))
+    (adversary.choose n pk)).run ())).bind fun choiceOut =>
+    if isElem (d, choiceOut.1.1.1) && isElem (d, choiceOut.1.1.2) then
+      if useExactB then
+        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β =>
+          F.cramerShoupCCA2InnerB H isElem d adversary bit n α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂ choiceOut β
+      else
+        (ProbComp.eval (F.sampleCramerShoupExp n d)).bind fun b =>
+          F.cramerShoupCCA2InnerB H isElem d adversary bit n α σ τ σ₁ τ₁ σ₂ τ₂ choiceOut
+            (b : ZMod (F.order d))
+    else
+      PMF.pure false
